example.cn: 我们已经决定本周末自己来装饰我们的新房子。

example.en: Mr. Chen hasn't decided what to do next.
example.cn: 陈先生尚未决定下一步要做什么。

name: decision
trans: n. 决定； 决心； 抉择
词组 make a decision做出决定

example.en: For many students, choosing a job is the most important life decision they must make at school.
example.cn: 对于很多学生来说，择业是他们在学校必须做的最重要的人生决定。

example.en: My mother likes to decorate rooms with flowers.
example.cn: 我妈妈喜欢用花装饰房间。

example.en: The river is not deep;we can walk through it.
example.cn: 这河不深，我们可以涉水过去。

example.en: The deep rumble of thunder echoed through the valley.
example.cn: 低沉的隆隆雷声在山谷中回荡。

name: degree
trans: n. 程度； 度； 度数； 学位

example.en: It's at 10 degrees centigrade.
example.cn: 气温是10℃.

example.en: I have already got my master's degree of Education.
example.cn: 我已经获得了教育硕士学位。

name: delay
trans: v. & n.拖延， 延误， 延期
点拨 delay是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道: delay= put off“延期”。

example.en: It is getting late,don't delay.
example.cn: 时间已晚，不要耽搁了。

example.en: His delay made the teacher angry.
example.cn: 他的迟到使老师生气了。

name: delicious
trans: adj. 美味的， 可口的；令人开心的， 令人愉快的， 宜人的

example.en: Thank you for your delicious dinner,Tony.
example.cn: 谢谢您的美味晚餐，托尼。

example.en: The delicious aroma of flowers filled the sitting room.
example.cn: 宜人的花香充满了整个起居室。

name: deliver
trans: v. 投递（信件、邮包等）； 传送； 递送； 分发

example.en: Will you take the goods with you or shall we deliver them to your house?
example.cn: 你随身带走货物还是我们把货物送到你家？

example.en: The guest professor delivered an inspiring speech about youth and creativity.
example.cn: 客座教授发表了一场关于青春与创造力的鼓舞人心的演讲。

example.en: I have got a toothache, so I must go to a dentist.
example.cn: 我牙疼， 必须去看牙医。

name: deny
trans: 点拨 deny是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法： deny后面跟动名词。

example.en: The driver denied causing the serious car accident during the police interview.
example.cn: 在警方问询时，司机否认自己引发了这起严重的车祸。

example.en: Within ninety minutes the ship was ready for departure.

name: depend
trans: v. 依靠， 依赖； 取决于； 根据······而定
词组 depend on依靠，依赖

example.en: Our future happiness depends on the choices we make today.
example.cn: 我们未来的幸福取决于我们今天所做的选择。

example.en: I don't know whether he can join us for dinner tonight, it depends.
example.cn: 我不知道他今晚是否和我们共进晚餐，看情况吧。

name: describe
trans: v. 描写， 叙述， 描述， 形容

example.en: About three-fifths of the students in our class can describe that place in English.
example.cn: 在我们班大约有3 的学生可以用英语描述那个地方。

example.en: He deserves a reward for his efforts.
example.cn: 他积极努力，应受奖赏。

example.en: A new car has been designed for the film The Italian Job.
example.cn: 专为电影《偷天换日》设计出一款新型汽车。

example.en: The design of the smartphone was fashionable and innovative.
example.cn: 这款智能手机的设计时尚而创新。

example.en: She has a desire of climbing mountains.
example.cn: 她想去爬山。

example.en: We all desire happiness and health.
example.cn: 我们都渴望得到幸福和健康。

example.en: The orange on the desk is for you,David.
example.cn: 桌上的橙子是给你的，戴维。

example.en: Hundreds of buildings in that area were destroyed by the terrible flood.
example.cn: 那个地区有数以百计的建筑物毁于洪水。

example.en: If you're interested in the job, I'll send you all the details.
example.cn: 如果你对这份工作感兴趣，我将把所有详细说明发给你。

example.en: Pansy didn't read many detective stories.
example.cn: 潘西看过的侦探小说不多。

example.en: The detective found that the young man took part in many bank robberies.
example.cn: 这位侦探发现那个年轻人参与过多次银行抢劫。

name: develop
trans: v. 发展；开发；培养；（使）成长；壮大

example.en: We must do our best to develop the national economy.
example.cn: 我们必须努力发展国民经济。

example.en: With the development of economy, our life is getting better and better.
example.cn: 随着经济的发展，我们的生活越来越好。

example.en: Do you often dial home?
example.cn: 你常给家里打电话吗？

example.en: They had long dialogues.
example.cn: 他们进行了长时间的对话。

name: diary
trans: 词组 keep a diary记日记

example.en: The teacher asked her students to keep an English diary every day.
example.cn: 老师要求她的学生每天写一篇英语日记。

example.en: You'd better look it up in the dictionary.
example.cn: 你最好查一下词典。

name: die
trans: 词组 die of因⋯⋯（病）而死

example.en: Many brave soldiers choose to die for honour rather than live in shame.
example.cn: 许多英勇的士兵选择为荣誉献身，而非屈辱地活着。

name: diet
trans: n. （日常）饮食；（日常）食谱；（日常）食物
词组 go on a diet节食

example.en: If you want to memorise things better, you'd better have a healthier diet.
example.cn: 要想记性好一点，你最好吃得健康点。

name: difference
trans: different adj.不同的；有差异的；有区别的；不平常的；与众不同的

example.en: The mother can easily tell the difference between the twins.
example.cn: 母亲很容易区分这对双胞胎。

name: different
trans: adj. 不同的；有差异的；有区别的；不平常的；与众不同的
词组 be different from与⋯⋯不同

example.en: My new computer is different from yours.
example.cn: 我的新电脑与你的不同。

example.en: It was difficult for human beings to predict weather in the past.
example.cn: 在过去人们很难预测天气。

example.en: Nothing is difficult to the man who will try.
example.cn: 世上无难事，只要肯登攀。

example.en: I had no difficulty in getting in touch with him.
example.cn: 我和他取得联系没有什么困难。

example.en: I haven't had dinner yet.
example.cn: 我还没有吃饭呢。

example.en: Nick was having dinner when I visited him.
example.cn: 当我去拜访尼克的时候，他正在吃饭。

name: direction
trans: n. 方向；趋势；用法说明（常用复数）
director n.导演；（某一活动的）负责人；主任，主管，经理

example.en: On your way to success, you must keep your direction.
example.cn: 在通往成功的路上，你必须坚持你的方向。

example.en: Follow the directions on the package to cook the noodles properly.
example.cn: 按包装上的说明操作，面条才能煮得恰到好处。

example.en: But even if some don't ask it directly, you can feel it.
example.cn: 即使一些人没有直接问出来，你仍然能够感觉到。

name: director
trans: n. 导演；（某一活动的）负责人；主任，主管，经理

example.en: Tim wants to be a great director like Zhang Yimou when he grows up.
example.cn: 蒂姆希望长大后，能像张艺谋一样成为一名大导演。

example.en: Even in the dirtiest weather, they were driven to go out to sea.
example.cn: 即使是最恶劣的天气，他们也被迫出海。

name: disabled
trans: adj.丧失能力的；有残疾的；无能力的

example.en: It is our bounden duty to help the disabled.
example.cn: 帮助残疾人士是我们义不容辞的责任。

example.en: Some voluntary organisations run workshops for disabled people.
example.cn: 一些志愿组织为残疾人士开办作坊。

name: disadvantage
trans: n. 不利（因素），劣势，短处

example.en: The children from poor families were at a distinct disadvantage.
example.cn: 来自贫困家庭的孩子们处于明显的不利地位。

example.en: Some rainforests are likely to disappear if we don't take action to protect them.
example.cn: 如果我们不采取行动进行保护，一些热带雨林有可能就会消失。

example.en: The black car drove away from them and disappeared.
example.cn: 那辆黑色轿车驶离了他们的视线，不见了。

example.en: He was disappointed at the result.
example.cn: 他对这样的结果感到失望。

example.en: These natural disasters have warned us that everyone should start to protect the environment immediately.
example.cn: 这些自然灾害警示我们，每个人都应该立即行动起来保护环境。

example.en: A good education will help you discover and develop your talents.
example.cn: 良好的教育，将有助于你发现和发挥你的才华。

example.en: All your suggestions will be discussed carefully before we come to a decision.
example.cn: 在我们做决定之前，您的建议将会被仔细地讨论。

example.en: He never contributes to the discussion.
example.cn: 他在讨论时从不发表意见。

name: dish
trans: n. 盘，碟；盘装菜；盘形物
词组 side dish（随同主菜一起上的）配菜

example.en: Please remember to bring your dishes and cakes to Tom's birthday party.
example.cn: 请记得带上你的菜和蛋糕去汤姆的生日聚会。

name: dishonest
trans: adj. 不诚实的，欺骗性的

example.en: Don't be dishonest with your friends, or you may lose their trust.
example.cn: 不要对朋友不诚实，否则你可能会失去他们的信任。

example.en: We like him personally, but dislike his way of living.
example.cn: 我们喜欢他这个人，但不喜欢他的生活方式。

example.en: I have walked half the distance.
example.cn: 我走了一半的距离。

example.en: We do not want to disturb what we have got.
example.cn: 我们不想打乱我们现有的东西。

name: divide
trans: v. 分，划分；（算数用语）除

example.en: The chef divided the cake into equal slices for the guests.
example.cn: 主厨把蛋糕平分成几块给顾客。

example.en: By the end of fifth grade, they should be able to multiply and divide.
example.cn: 到五年级结束，他们应该有能力计算乘法和除法。

example.en: The generation gap often leads to a divide in understanding between parents and children.
example.cn: 代沟通常会导致家长和孩子间的理解差异。

name: do
trans: v. & aux. v.做，干（用以构成疑问句及否定句；第三人称单数现在时用does）
词组 do harm to对…有害；损害
词组 do one's best尽最大努力
词组 do sb.a favour帮某人忙
词组 do some shopping买东西

example.en: Tom very soon decided what he would do next(=what to do next).
example.cn: 汤姆很快决定下一步他会做什么。

example.en: I'm sure that you will do well in your interviews.
example.cn: 我相信你在采访中会做得很好。

example.en: Do you remember getting some medicine for her last week?
example.cn: 你还记得上星期给她买药的事吗？

example.en: Never do things by halves.
example.cn: 凡事不要半途而废。

example.en: The doctor told my grandpa not to eat too much fat.
example.cn: 医生告诉我的爷爷，不要吃太多的脂肪。

example.en: The clever dog can open the gate of the garden by itself.
example.cn: 这条聪明的狗自己能打开花园的门。

name: dollar
trans: n. 元（美国、加拿大、澳大利亚等国货币单位）

example.en: Let me change the dollar bill for coins.
example.cn: 让我把这张美元纸钞换成硬币。

example.en: Do you know the man over there by the door?
example.cn: 你认识站在门边的那个男人吗？

example.en: We cannot pay double(of)this amount.
example.cn: 我们不能付双倍的数目。

example.en: He carefully doubled the map to fit it into his pocket.
example.cn: 他仔细地对折了地图，以便把它放进口袋。

example.en: We're going down a mountain.
example.cn: 我们正在下山。

example.en: Danny put down his glass.
example.cn: 丹尼放下他的玻璃杯。

example.en: You can also use the interface to download, copy, or delete objects.
example.cn: 您还可以使用界面来下载、复制或删除东西。

example.en: Are the children downstairs?
example.cn: 孩子们在楼下吗？

example.en: He drew pictures worse than me.=He didn't draw pictures as well as I.
example.cn: 他画得比我更糟糕。

example.en: In the end they had to draw lots to decide who would take part in the competition.
example.cn: 最后他们不得不抽签决定谁去参加比赛。

name: dream
trans: 词组 dream of梦想；想到

example.en: Hard work pays off. I believe you will enter your dream school.
example.cn: 努力学习是有回报的。我相信你会考入你梦想中的学校。

example.en: Many young people dream of becoming top models.
example.cn: 许多年轻人梦想成为顶级模特儿。

name: dress
trans: n. 女装，连衣裙；（统指）服装；童装
词组 dress up（穿着）打扮

example.en: —You look so beautiful in your new dress.
My sister likes to dress in bright colours.
example.cn: 我妹妹喜欢穿颜色鲜艳的衣服。

example.en: The nurse helped to dress the patient.
example.cn: 护士帮助病人穿衣服。

example.en: Drinking too much fruit juice can be harmful to children's teeth.
example.cn: 喝太多果汁对孩子的牙齿有害。

example.en: Coca-Cola is a soft drink.
example.cn: 可口可乐是一种软饮料。

example.en: If I fail the driving test, I will have another try.
example.cn: 如果我驾驶考试失败了，我会再试一次。

example.en: Drivers must obey the traffic rules at any time when they are driving.
example.cn: 司机在任何时候驾驶，都必须遵守交通规则。

name: drop
trans: v.降低；减少；掉下，落下；扔掉；放弃

example.en: Even a drop of water mustn't be wasted because it is so important to all the living things.
example.cn: 即使是一滴水也不能浪费，因为水对所有生命是如此重要。

example.en: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night.
example.cn: 晚上气温能降到零度。

example.en: The medicine must be kept in a cool and dry place.
example.cn: 药必须存放在干燥阴凉的地方。

example.en: Dry the dishes before putting them away in the cupboard.
example.cn: 在把盘碟放进橱柜前先把它们擦干。

example.en: The children love to feed the ducks at the lake.
example.cn: 孩子们喜欢喂湖里的鸭子。

example.en: Art is not as important as life, but life without art is dull.
example.cn: 艺术远远没有生命重要，但是没有艺术的生活是多么乏味呀！

example.en: Kitty said she enjoyed herself during the summer holiday.
example.cn: 姬蒂说在暑假期间她过得很开心。

example.en: Inside I saw the head nurse, who said Miss Barkley was on duty.
example.cn: 我在里面见到了护士长，她说巴克莱小姐正在值班。

name: each
trans: adj. &pron.每人；每个；每件；（两个或以上的人或物中）各自，各个
词组 each other互相；彼此

example.en: Each bird loves to hear itself sing.
example.cn: 每只鸟都喜欢听自己唱歌。

example.en: We each have different needs and interests.
example.cn: 我们每个人都有不同的需要和兴趣。

example.en: Each age offers its own men of parts.
example.cn: 江山代有才人出。

example.en: Recently, more and more people are eager to learn the traditional skills.
example.cn: 最近，越来越多的人渴望学习这些传统技艺。

example.en: Julia sang too terribly for me to believe my ears.
= Julia sang so terribly that I couldn't believe my ears.
example.cn: 朱丽亚唱得太糟糕了，以至于我简直不敢相信我的耳朵。

name: early
trans: 谚语 早睡早起会使人健康、富有和聪明。
点拨 early是常考单词，常出现在词形变化练习中，所以学生一定要牢记中考考纲中6个拼写同形的形容词和副词。它们是: early,fast,hard,high,late,straight.

example.en: The policeman asked Mary whether she always caught such an early train.
example.cn: 警察问玛丽她是否总是赶这么早的火车。

example.en: He did the work as quickly as he could so as to go back home early.
example.cn: 他尽快干活，以便可以早点回家。

example.en: The more quickly he walks, the earlier he will get there.
example.cn: 他走得越快，就能越早到那里。

example.en: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.

name: earth
trans: n. 地球； 土， 泥； 大地

example.en: My brother studies in a university and he knows a lot about the Earth.
example.cn: 我的哥哥在大学学习，他知道很多关于地球的事情。

example.en: I was watching TV when the earthquake happened in Shanghai half a month ago.
example.cn: 半个月前上海发生地震，当时我正在看电视。

example.en: With the help of the app, we found the address of the theatre easily.
example.cn: 在这款应用程序的帮助下，我们很容易找到了这家剧院的地址。

name: east
trans: adj. 东方的； 东部的

example.en: a bitter east wind
example.cn: 一阵刺骨的东风

example.en: The room faces east.
example.cn: 这间房朝东。

example.en: There has been heavy rain in the east today.
example.cn: 今天东边下了场大雨。

name: easy
trans: adj. 容易的， 不费力的

example.en: Nobody thought it easy to finish so much work in two days' time.
example.cn: 没有人认为在两天之内完成这么多工作是件容易的事。

example.en: Easier said than done.
example.cn: 说起来容易做起来难。

example.en: It's selfish of Jim to eat the whole cake and it's necessary for us to think more of others.
example.cn: 吉姆真自私，吃了整个蛋糕。我们有必要多想想别人。

name: economy
trans: economist n.经济学家；经济专家

example.en: The plan of our country is based on a rising economy.
example.cn: 我国的计划建立在不断发展的经济基础上。

example.en: His parents pay about 200,000 yuan for his college education in the UK each year.
example.cn: 父母每年为他在英国的大学教育支付20万元左右。

example.en: They hold readings, celebrations, book displays and educational events.
example.cn: 他们举办读书会、庆祝活动、图书展示和教育活动。

name: effect
trans: effective adj.产生预期结果的；有效的
词组 special effects（电影或电视节目的）特技效果

example.en: The new medicine will have a good effect on his illness, won't it?
example.cn: 这种新药会对他的病情有良好的效果，不是吗？

example.en: Jane Goodall's Roots & Shoots has had a huge effect on global youth environmental action.
example.cn: 珍妮·古道尔创办的“根与芽”组织，对全球青少年的环保行动产生了巨大影响。

name: effective
trans: adj. 产生预期结果的；有效的

example.en: This Chinese medicine proved to be highly effective in curing the cold.
example.cn: 这种中药被证明对治疗感冒非常有效。

example.en: Her success here depends upon effort and ability.
example.cn: 她在这里的成功靠的是努力和能力。

example.en: She has an egg for breakfast every day, doesn't she?
example.cn: 她每天早餐吃一个鸡蛋，不是吗？

name: either
trans: adj. 两方任一方的； 二者之一的
adv.（用于否定句或短语后）也（不）
点拨 either是常考单词，常出现在主谓一致的练习中，所以学生一定要知道：either ... or ..., neither ... nor ..., not only ... but also ..., there be等词语在连接多个主语时，谓语动词用单数还是复数形式取决于离它最近的那个主语。

example.en: You may use either printer.
example.cn: 两台打印机中你可以随便用哪一台。

example.en: Either of them will agree to this arrangement.
example.cn: 他们两人都会同意这样的安排。

example.en: The new policy enables people to buy train tickets either from the station or on the internet.
example.cn: 新政策使人们能够从火车站或互联网上购买火车票。

example.en: Mary, you can go to the museum either by bus or by underground.
No one stayed at home,either.
example.cn: 也没有一个人待在家里。

example.en: Either you or he is going.
example.cn: 要么你去，要么他去。

example.en: Neither I nor you are wrong.
example.cn: 我和你都没有错。

name: elder
trans: adj. 年龄较大的； 前辈的； 年长的

example.en: Is the girl in blue your elder sister?
example.cn: 穿蓝衣服的那个女孩是你的姐姐吗？

name: electric
trans: electronic adj.电子的；电子设备的；电子器件的

example.en: If oil prices continue to rise, people will start driving electric cars.
example.cn: 如果油价持续上涨，人们就会开始驾驶电动汽车。

example.en: When water moves from a high place to a lower place, it can make electricity.
example.cn: 当水从高处流往低处时，它可以发电。

example.en: The new laws deprived many people of the most elementary freedoms in that country.
example.cn: 在那个国家，新法律剥夺了许多人的最基本的自由。

example.en: I saw a baby elephant drinking.
example.cn: 我看见一只小象在喝水。

example.en: Can you show me something else?
example.cn: 你可以给我看点别的吗？

example.en: We communicate with each other in many ways, such as by email or by phone.
example.cn: 我们用很多方式交流，比如通过电子邮件或打电话。

example.en: With the help of the new technology, you can email your friends by mobile phone.
example.cn: 在新技术的帮助下，你可以用手机给你的朋友发邮件。

name: embarrassed
trans: adj. 局促不安的；为难的；尴尬的；窘迫的

example.en: He looked a bit embarrassed.
example.cn: 他看起来有点尴尬。

name: emergency
trans: n. 紧急情况；突发事件

example.en: The government is taking emergency action to deal with a housing crisis.
example.cn: 政府正采取紧急措施解决住房危机。

example.en: Except for an old lady, the bus was empty.
example.cn: 这辆公共汽车除了一位老妇人之外是空的。

example.en: The garbage truck comes once a week to empty our bins.
example.cn: 垃圾车一周来一次清空我们的垃圾箱。

example.en: Good team work will enable us to get the job done on time.
example.cn: 良好的团队协作能使我们按时完成这项工作。

name: encourage
trans: 词组 encourage sb. to do sth.鼓励某人做某事

example.en: The mother always encouraged her baby to stand up by himself when he fell over.
example.cn: 当婴儿摔倒时，母亲总是鼓励他自己站起来。

name: end
trans: n. 末尾；终点；结束；尽头；末梢
词组 at the end of在······结束的时候
词组 in the end最后；终于

example.en: Kevin came from England. He had lived in Shanghai for ten years by the end of last year.
example.cn: 凯文来自英格兰。到去年年底，他在上海已经生活了10年。

example.en: The robot's sensors detected movement at the end of its mechanical arm.
example.cn: 机器人的传感器检测到了机械臂末端的运动。

example.en: The concert ended with a spectacular fireworks display.
example.cn: 音乐会在一场绚丽壮观的烟花表演中落下帷幕。

example.en: I don't know why a successful person often has many enemies.
example.cn: 我不知道为什么一个成功的人往往有许多敌人。

example.en: He brought new energy to the science department.
example.cn: 他为科学部门带来了新的活力。

example.en: The engine seems to need piles of oil.
example.cn: 这种发动机似乎需要很多油。

example.en: My father has worked as an engineer in the factory for several years.
example.cn: 我的父亲作为一名工程师在这家工厂已经工作几年了。

name: England
trans: English adj.英国的；英国人的；英语的

example.en: Do you use chopsticks in England?
example.cn: 在英格兰你们用筷子吗？

name: English
trans: adj. 英国的；英国人的；英语的
点拨 English是常考单词，常出现在对划线部分提问的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要牢记： 划线划在English要用What language提问；划线划在English orChinese要用Which language提问。

example.en: The foreign teachers in our school are mainly from some English-speaking countries.
example.cn: 我校的外籍教师主要来自一些讲英语的国家。

example.en: By the end of last term, we had learned English for four years.
example.cn: 到上学期结束时，我们已经学了4年英语。

name: enjoy
trans: v. 欣赏； 享受； 喜欢
enjoyable adj.使人愉快的；使人欢乐的；有乐趣的
词组 enjoy oneself过得快乐；玩得高兴
点拨 enjoy是常考单词，其后面一定要跟动名词。同时要牢记以下这些动词和动词词组，其后面也一定要跟动名词：
点拨 enjoy, deny, finish, keep, practise, mind, prefer, spend, be busy, be worth, be good at,be about,look forward to, keep prevent sb. from

example.en: Enjoy yourselves at the party,boys and girls.
example.cn: 孩子们，聚会上尽情地玩吧。

example.en: Billy said he enjoyed reading magazines at the beginning of his speech.
example.cn: 比利在演讲开始时说他喜欢看杂志。

name: enjoyable
trans: adj. 使人愉快的；使人欢乐的；有乐趣的

example.en: We hope you had an enjoyable holiday.
example.cn: 我们希望您度过一个愉快的假期。

example.en: I like this piece of music quite a lot. It's enjoyable.
example.cn: 我相当喜欢这首音乐。它使人愉悦。

name: enough
trans: adj. 足够的； 充分的

example.en: Of the two pairs of jeans, I chose the less expensive one because I hadn't enough money on me.
example.cn: 两条牛仔裤中，我选择了更便宜的一条，因为我带的钱不够。

example.en: He was lucky enough to win the game.= He was so lucky that he won the game.
example.cn: 他很幸运，赢得了比赛。

example.en: I think I have said enough.
example.cn: 我想我已经说得够多了。

name: enrich
trans: rich adj.富有的；有钱的；味道浓的；重油的

example.en: Sandy likes drawing very much and she believes it can enrich her whole life.
example.cn: 桑迪非常喜欢绘画，她相信绘画可以丰富她的整个人生。

name: enter
trans: 词组 enter for报名参加

example.en: Dick would rather enter a vocational school than a high school.
example.cn: 迪克宁愿进职业学校也不愿进入高中。

example.en: Television provides universal entertainment.
example.cn: 电视提供大众化的娱乐。

example.en: David will meet his friend Martin at the entrance to the museum.
example.cn: 戴维将在博物馆的入口处与他的朋友马丁碰头。

example.en: Can I use this envelope?
example.cn: 我可以用这个信封吗？

example.en: Please tell us what to do to protect our environment.
example.cn: 请告诉我们应该做什么来保护我们的环境。

example.en: We do business with all countries, big or small, on an equal basis.
example.cn: 我们同所有国家做生意，无论大国小国，都一视同仁。

example.en: Nine percent interest less seven percent inflation equals two percent.

name: escape
trans: 词组 escape from 从⋯⋯逃跑

example.en: I read love stories as an escape from reality.
example.cn: 我读爱情小说以逃避现实。

example.en: Do you know whether the Chinese seamen managed to escape from the pirates?
example.cn: 你知道中国船员是否已经设法摆脱了海盗？

example.en: Their ideas still influence us today, especially in the arts, science, literature and philosophy.
example.cn: 今天，他们的思想仍然影响着我们，尤其是在艺术、科学、文学和哲学方面。

example.en: Most students have not been to Europe, have they?
example.cn: 大多数学生都没有去过欧洲，是吗？

example.en: People like to go out on New Year's Eve.
example.cn: 人们喜欢在跨年夜出门。

name: even
trans: adv. （强调出乎意料）甚至；连（⋯⋯都）；即使；更
词组 even though 尽管；虽然
点拨 even是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握以下这些词语的用法：
点拨 even, much, far, still, a bit, a little, a lot等词语可以修饰比较级，如：a bit bigger, much better, far more useful, even earlier, still greater, a little longer.

example.en: She didn't even apologise for her mistake.
example.cn: 她甚至都没为她的错误道歉。

example.en: We hope we can cooperate even more closely in the future.
example.cn: 希望我们今后能更加密切地合作。

example.en: What an amazing performance the singer gave at the opening ceremony yesterday evening!
example.cn: 这位歌手在昨晚开幕式上的表演多么精彩啊！

name: event
trans: n. 发生的事件，大事；比赛项目；公开活动

example.en: Call the police in the event of an emergency.
example.cn: 若发生紧急事件就打电话报警。

name: ever
trans: adv. 曾经；无论何时，在任何时候；从来

example.en: Both my husband and I think it is the most amusing story we have ever heard.
example.cn: 我丈夫和我都认为这是我们听到过的最有趣的故事。

example.en: Many people are unaware of how much sugar they take in every day.
example.cn: 很多人没有意识到他们每天摄入了多少糖。

name: everybody
trans: 谚语 如果人人都献出一点爱，世界将会更美好。

example.en: Please speak louder, so that everybody in the hall can hear you clearly.
example.cn: 请大声点说，让在大厅里的每个人都听清楚。

name: everyday
trans: adj. 每日的； 日常的
点拨 everyday是常考单词，学生一定要掌握everyday和every day的用法区别：everyday是形容词，意思是“每天的，日常的”。
点拨 every day是表示时间的短语，作状语，意思是“每天”。

example.en: These are my everyday shoes, not my best ones.
example.cn: 这些是我平常穿的鞋，不是最好的鞋。

example.en: Computers are part of everyday life.
example.cn: 电脑是日常生活的一部分。

name: everything
trans: pron. 每件事，事事，每样事物

example.en: Kevin is so independent that he always tries to do everything by himself.
example.cn: 凯文是如此独立，以至于他总是设法自己去做每一件事。

example.en: Where have you been?I looked everywhere for you.
example.cn: 你去哪儿了？ 我到处找你。

name: exactly
trans: adv. 确切地； （表示赞同的回答）确实如此

example.en: What are you busy with exactly?
example.cn: 那你究竟在忙什么？

name: exam
trans: n. （笔头、口头或操作）考试， 测   试；检查
examine v.检查，细查；对······进行考试

example.en: After we pass the exams, we will celebrate by having a party next week.
example.cn: 我们通过考试后，下周将举办个派对庆祝一下。

name: examine
trans: v. 检查， 细查； 对······进行考试

example.en: The officers at the airport examine every traveler's passport carefully.
example.cn: 机场工作人员仔细检查每一个旅客的护照。

name: example
trans: n. 例子； 榜样； 实例

example.en: I don't quite understand what you said. Would you please give us another example?
example.cn: 我不明白你说什么。请给我们另外举一个例子好吗？

name: excellent
trans: adj. 极好的，优秀的；杰出的

example.en: An excellent story is the key to making a successful film.
example.cn: 一个优秀的故事是拍一部成功电影的关键。

name: except
trans: 点拨 except是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握besides,except,except for之间的用法区别：
点拨 besides作“除······之外”时，表示“另外附加”的含义，相当于“加法”。
点拨 except用于表示同类事物之间的关系，其意为“除⋯⋯以外”“除去”。常用在all, whole, any, every, no, anything, anybody, anyone, everything, everybody,everyone等词之后，相当于“减法”。
点拨 except for不表示同类事物之间的关系，for后面的词，往往是补充说明主语的某个方面。可以理解成有点“美中不足”的意思，肯定了一个事物的大部分属性，只否定其中的一小部分。

example.en: I think no one can help me except you.
example.cn: 我想除了你之外没有人能帮助我。

example.en: Everyone in our class has brought his dictionary to class except me.
example.cn: 除了我以外，我们班上每个人都带了词典到教室。

example.en: We all went fishing except Tom.
example.cn: 除了汤姆，我们都去钓鱼了。

example.en: The article is excellent, except for a few grammar mistakes.
Smith is a good man, except for his bad temper.

name: exchange
trans: n. & v.交换； 互换； 交流

example.en: The Italian exchange student was thankful to the host for his care and help.
example.cn: 这位意大利的交换学生感谢接待方对他的关心和帮助。

example.en: The students exchanged ideas during the group project.
example.cn: 学生们在小组项目中交换了想法。

name: excited
trans: exciting adj.令人兴奋的；令人激动的

example.en: Users have been very excited about the development of this AI model.
example.cn: 用户们对这款人工智能模型的发展感到十分兴奋。

name: exciting
trans: adj. 令人兴奋的； 令人激动的
点拨 excited和exciting都是与excite相关的形容词，但它们的含义和用法有一定区别：
点拨 excited表示“感到兴奋的；激动的”，通常用来修饰人，或与人的感受、表情、行为等相关的名词，如voice,face等，强调人自身因为某件事或物而产生兴奋、激动的情绪；也可作表语，说明主语的状态。
点拨 exciting表示“令人兴奋的；使人激动的”，主要用于修饰事物，说明该事物具有能够引起他人兴奋、激动的特性；可作定语放在名词前，或作表语说明主语的性质。

example.en: How exciting it is to travel around the world by bike!
example.cn: 骑自行车环游世界，这是多么令人兴奋啊！

example.en: The football game was really exciting.
example.cn: 这场足球比赛真的很令人兴奋。

example.en: It's an exciting opportunity for her.
example.cn: 对她来说，这是一个令人兴奋的机会。

name: excuse
trans: 词组 excuse me（因打扰别人或失礼表示歉意）对不起；劳驾

example.en: Excuse me,what time is it now?
example.cn: 对不起，请问现在几点了？

example.en: There's no excuse for behaviour like that.
example.cn: 别为那样的行为找借口。

name: exercise
trans: n. 锻炼； 做操； 练习； 习题
点拨 exercise是常考单词，它既是可数名词，也是不可数名词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
点拨 1) exercise表示“体育锻炼，训练，运动”的时候，它是不可数名词。
点拨 Swimming is one of the healthiest forms of exercise.
点拨 2) exercise表示“做操”或“练习（题）”的时候，它是可数名词，要用复数形式。

example.en: To keep fit, we should get rid of unhealthy eating habits and do more exercise.
example.cn: 为了强身健体，我们应该摒弃不健康的饮食习惯，多做运动。

example.en: You should exercise more.
example.cn: 你应该多多锻炼。

example.en: I walk to work every day because it is good exercise.
Do more exercise every day and you' ll be stronger than before.
We won't do morning exercises if it rains tomorrow.
We do English exercises to help us learn good English.
He is doing an exercise in English grammar.
example.cn: 他在做英语语法练习。

example.en: Although it was getting dark, many people were still waiting outside the Shanghai Museum to visit the exhibition.
example.cn: 虽然天渐渐黑了，上海博物馆外还有许多人等着参观展览。

example.en: Does life exist on Mars?
example.cn: 火星上有生命吗？

example.en: The customer starts walking to the exit nearest where he parked.
example.cn: 顾客开始走向距离他的停车点最近的出口。

example.en: At the end of the third scene the actress exits.
example.cn: 这位女演员于第三场结束时退场。

name: expect
trans: v. 预料； 期望， 期待； 认为
点拨 expect是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: expect与look forward to意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 =I'm looking forward to hearing from you.

example.en: Ben and Lily have one child and they are expecting the second one in July.
example.cn: 本和莉莉有一个孩子，他们预计7月份迎来第2个孩子。

example.en: Grandparents just called to say that they expected us to visit them very often.
example.cn: 爷爷奶奶刚打电话来，说希望我们能经常去看望他们。

example.en: I'm expecting to receive a letter from you.

name: expensive
trans: adj. 昂贵的； 价格高的

example.en: This beautiful skirt is as expensive as that red scarf.

name: experience
trans: experienced adj.有经验的；熟练的；有见识的
谚语 经验是智慧之父，记忆是智慧之母。
点拨 experience是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道experience作“经验”解时，是不可数的；作“经历”解时，是可数的。

example.en: He had little experience in managing a team, but he learned quickly and soon became good at it.
example.cn: 他几乎没有管理团队的经验，但学得很快，不久就驾轻就熟了。

example.en: The experience in Australia in July was truly unforgettable.
Experience is the father of wisdom and memory the mother.
He has a lot of experience in the research.
example.cn: 在这项研究上他很有经验。

example.en: He has a lot of experiences of travelling.
example.cn: 他有很多旅游的经历。

name: experiment
trans: 词组 do interesting experiments and projects做有趣的实验和项目

example.en: Now the good method is widely used in the experiments.
example.cn: 现在这个好方法被广泛应用在实验中。

example.en: It is better to learn how to do the experiment right now.
example.cn: 现在最好立刻学习如何做实验。

example.en: Do I really have to explain this?
example.cn: 我真的需要对此做出解释吗？

example.en: Byrd explored the region around the South Pole.
example.cn: 伯德探测了南极地带。

example.en: Language is how you express yourself and your culture.
example.cn: 语言是表达自我和表达自身文化的方式。

example.en: He had boarded an express for Rome.
example.cn: 他已经登上了前往罗马的特快列车。

example.en: You need to be extra careful not to make any mistake.
example.cn: 你要格外小心，别犯错误。

example.en: What should we do with this extra income?
example.cn: 我们应该如何处理这笔额外的收入呢？

example.en: Reading can open up my eyes to the outside world. And books are like teachers that introduce different countries to me.
example.cn: 读书能够开拓我的视野，并且，书也像老师一样把不同的国家介绍给我。

example.en: Class, I'm going to tell you a fable.
example.cn: 同学们，我要给你们讲一则寓言。

example.en: Fancy is a pleasant girl with a cheerful face. She is a good friend of mine.
example.cn: 范西是一个可爱的女孩，她脸上总是洋溢着喜悦。她是我的好朋友。

example.en: The British government is faced with a sharp increase in refugee issues.
example.cn: 英国政府面临着难民问题的急剧增加。

name: fact
trans: n. 事实；现实；实际情况
词组 in fact事实上；实际上

example.en: The fact that I didn't have enough experience was really a big disadvantage.
example.cn: 我没有足够的经验，这确实是一个很大的劣势。

example.en: The people there did not allow them to set up a factory so as not to pollute the water in the river.
example.cn: 为防止污染河水，那里的人不允许他们在那儿建立工厂。

example.en: Hollywood was on strike because labor and management failed to reach a new deal.
example.cn: 由于劳方和资方未能达成新的协议，好莱坞陷入了停工状态。

example.en: You will fail the English exam unless you practise it more after class.
=You will fail the English exam if you don't practise it more after class.
example.cn: 如果课后不多练习，你英语考试会不及格。

example.en: Your brother failed the English test last week, didn't he?
example.cn: 上周你弟弟的英语考试不及格，是吗？

name: fair
trans: adj. 公平的，合理的；（头发或皮肤）浅色的；白皙的

example.en: She tries to be fair to all her employees.
example.cn: 她尽量公平对待所有雇员。

example.en: She had fair skin that burned easily in the sun.
example.cn: 她皮肤白皙，在阳光下容易晒伤。

example.en: A book fair is held here each year.
example.cn: 每年这里都要举办书展。

name: fall
trans: v. 落下；降落；（突然）倒下；跌倒
词组 fall asleep 入睡

example.en: The leaves will fall from the trees.
example.cn: 树叶会从树上落下。

example.en: He was elected a judge in the fall of 2024.
example.cn: 他于2024年秋天当选为法官。

example.en: Fall into a pit, a gain in your wit.
example.cn: 吃一堑，长一智。

name: familiar
trans: 词组 be with对······熟悉；通晓

example.en: Since you have been in Beijing for many years, you must be quite familiar with the city.
example.cn: 既然你已经在北京待了很多年，你一定很熟悉这座城市。

example.en: Pan Zhanle is a world-famous sports star. His name is familiar to almost everybody in China.
example.cn: 潘展乐是世界著名的体育明星。他的名字在中国家喻户晓。

name: family
trans: n. 家庭； 家族；家人
点拨 family是常考单词，所以学生一定要正确使用这个词。
点拨 1) family若被看作整体时，后接单数动词。
点拨 2) family若被看作组成该集体的各个成员时，后接复数动词。
点拨 例如: The family is a very happy one.这户人家很幸福。

example.en: I will take a holiday with my family as I finish all the exams.
example.cn: 考试一结束，我就会与家人一起去度假。

example.en: The family are very pleased about the news.

name: famous
trans: infamous adj.声名狼藉的；臭名远扬的
词组 be famous for以……而著名

example.en: We are surprised to learn the death of the famous French actor.
example.cn: 我们惊讶地获悉那位法国著名影星的死讯。

name: fan
trans: n. （电影、运动等的）迷；热心的爱好者（支持者）；扇子

example.en: His fans are satisfied with his latest work.
example.cn: 他的粉丝对他的新作感到满意。

example.en: It was far from my home.
example.cn: 那个地方离我家很远。

example.en: Tom checked his homework far more carefully than me.
example.cn: 汤姆检查作业比我仔细得多。

example.en: What's the first-class fare from Chicago to Los Angeles?
example.cn: 从芝加哥到洛杉矶的头等舱费用是多少？

example.en: Uncle Tom is a farmer. He keeps many sheep on his farm and leads a happy life.
example.cn: 汤姆叔叔是个农民。他在农场养了许多羊，且过着幸福的生活。

example.en: The farmer looked sadly at the flooded field and he became sadder and sadder.
example.cn: 这个农民忧郁地望着被洪水淹没的田地，他变得越来越悲伤。

example.en: Don't easily follow a fashion. Being yourself is the best rule.
example.cn: 不要轻易跟风（跟着时尚走），做你自己是最好的准则。

example.en: Simon is a fast runner. John runs even faster. But Liu Xiang runs fastest.
example.cn: 西蒙跑得很快。约翰跑得更快。但刘翔跑得最快。

example.en: That clock's an hour fast.
example.cn: 那个钟快了一个小时。

example.en: She got quickly into her car and fastened the seat-belt.
example.cn: 她迅速钻进她的车里并系紧安全带。

example.en: You will become fatter and fatter if you don't go on a diet.
=You will become fatter and fatter unless you go on a diet.
example.cn: 如果你不节食，会变得越来越胖。

example.en: I don't eat much fat, for example, fatty meat.
example.cn: 我吃的脂肪不多，比如肥肉。

example.en: Wendy's father helped her invent a new way of doing business.
example.cn: 温迪的父亲帮助她发明了一种新的经商方式。

name: favour
trans: 词组 in favour of赞成

example.en: Could you please do me a favour?
example.cn: 你能帮我个忙吗？

example.en: National Treasure is one of my favourite TV shows.
example.cn: 《国家宝藏》是我最喜欢的电视节目之一。

example.en: Chocolate ice cream is Helen's favourite.
example.cn: 巧克力冰淇淋是海伦的最爱。

example.en: Bob seldom has meals in restaurants for fear of spending too much money, does he?
example.cn: 鲍勃因怕花费太多很少在餐馆吃饭，是吗？

example.en: My birthday is in February.
example.cn: 我的生日在2月。

name: feed
trans: v. 喂养；饲养；给（人或动物）食物

example.en: Everyday after dinner the kind girl often goes to our campus to feed homeless cats.
example.cn: 每天晚饭后，这个善良的女孩经常去我们的校园喂流浪猫。

example.en: She felt terribly guilty for forgetting her best friend's 15th birthday.
example.cn: 她因为忘了最好朋友的15岁生日而深感愧疚。

name: female
trans: adj. 女的；女性的；雌性的

example.en: She won the award for best female artist.
example.cn: 她荣膺最佳女艺术家奖。

example.en: The boy vaulted over the fence.
example.cn: 男孩翻身跳过围栏。

example.en: I haven't decided which ferry I shall take to Hong Kong Island.
=I haven't decided which ferry to take to Hong Kong Island.
example.cn: 我还没有决定坐哪一班渡轮去香港岛。

example.en: Thousands of people went travelling during the Spring Festival.
example.cn: 成千上万的人在春节期间去旅行了。

example.en: My uncle Jim had a high fever.
example.cn: 我叔叔吉姆发高烧了。

example.en: Few of the beach houses still had lights on.
example.cn: 海滩上的房子几乎没有亮着灯的。

example.en: With the help of their teachers, they have made fewer mistakes this term than before.
example.cn: 在老师的帮助下，他们这学期犯的错误比以前少多了。

example.en: There are so many heroes from different fields working together.
example.cn: 有那么多来自不同领域的杰出人物在一起工作。

name: fight
trans: v. & n.打仗；打架，打斗；战斗；争论

example.en: The two armies fought together for freedom and independence.
example.cn: 这两支军队为了自由与独立并肩作战。

example.en: She has a fight with her mum about staying out late.
example.cn: 她因为在外面待得太晚和她妈妈吵了一架。

name: figure
trans: 词组 figure out弄懂；弄明白

example.en: The dress she wore highlighted her elegant figure.
example.cn: 她穿的那条裙子突显了她优雅的体形。

example.en: She quickly figured the final budget for the event.
example.cn: 她很快计算出了活动最终预算。

name: fill
trans: v. 填空；（使）装满；充满；注满
词组 fill in填充；填写

example.en: Now, please fill out this form.
example.cn: 现在请您完整填写这张表格。

name: film
trans: 词组 make a film拍电影

example.en: Could you tell me when the film will start tomorrow evening?
example.cn: 你能否告诉我明天晚上的电影什么时候放映？

name: final
trans: adj. 最后的，最终的；终极的

example.en: In some cases, you can hardly tell who is the final winner.
example.cn: 在某些情况下，你很难分辨出谁是最后的赢家。

example.en: Finally, Grace made up her mind to live abroad with her daughter.
example.cn: 最后，格雷丝决定去国外与女儿一起生活。

example.en: Finally, many readers are already trying to guess what will happen in Harry Potter.
example.cn: 最后，许多读者已经开始猜测《哈利·波特》中会发生什么。

name: find
trans: v. 找到； 发现； 发觉
词组 find out找出；查明；了解
点拨 find是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握find,keep,make,leave,get,set等单词+名词+形容词，表示状态的搭配用法。
点拨 例如: find the man dead发现那个人死了
点拨 keep the room clean保持房间清洁
点拨 make the city greener使城市更绿
点拨 leave the door open让门开着
点拨 get everything ready准备好一切
点拨 set the man free让人自由

example.en: The detective wants to know what Mr. Jones found in the room.
example.cn: 侦探想知道琼斯先生在房间里找到了什么。

example.en: Join us, and you' ll find learning English can be enjoyable and wonderful.
example.cn: 加入我们，你会发现学习英语相当有趣和快乐。

example.en: This was her fourth time to visit the Great Wall, but she still found it amazing.
example.cn: 这是她第四次游览长城，可她依旧觉得这里令人惊叹。

name: fine
trans: adj. 晴朗的； 美好的； （身体）健康的

example.en: It is a fine Wednesday morning.
example.cn: 这是一个晴朗的周三早晨。

example.en: One of his fingers was wounded. What about the others?
example.cn: 他的一根手指受伤了。其他的呢？

name: finish
trans: v. （使）结束； 做好； 完成
近义 be over; come to an end
点拨 finish是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其用法： finish后面跟动名词。

example.en: Jenny can ask her teacher for help if she can't finish writing the report by herself.
example.cn: 如果珍妮自己不能完成报告的话，她可以求助于她的老师。

name: fire
trans: n. 火； 火炉； 火灾
词组 make a fire生火

example.en: Without fires, the oldest and largest trees would stop sunlight from reaching the forest floor. Fires can get rid of some of these old trees.
example.cn: 没有火，那些古老而高大的树会阻挡阳光透入森林，而火恰恰能烧掉这些老树。

example.en: The officer ordered his men to fire at the enemy.
example.cn: 军官命令士兵向敌人开火。

example.en: There is no smoke without fire.
example.cn: 无风不起浪。

example.en: A fireman usually helps people put out the fire.
example.cn: 消防员通常帮助人们把火扑灭。

example.en: There are also fabulous fireworks displays.
example.cn: 还有精彩的烟火表演。

name: first
trans: 词组 at first起先；开始的时候

example.en: That band was the first rock band to perform at the Bird's Nest.
example.cn: 那支乐队是第一支在鸟巢演出的摇滚乐队。

example.en: The Battle of Shanghai was first performed by Shanghai Acrobatic Troupe and Shanghai Circus School in 2019.2019
example.cn: 年，《战上海》首次由上海杂技团和上海马戏学校演出。

example.en: From the very first, we knew the project would be a success.
example.cn: 从一开始，我们就知道这个项目会成功。

name: fish
trans: fisherman n. 渔夫，渔民；钓鱼的人
点拨 fish是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其用法。当指许多鱼时，其复数一般用fish，但当指不同品种的鱼类时，用fishes.作“鱼肉”解时，fish是不可数名词。

example.en: Damin taught his grandsons how they could catch more fish.
= Damin taught his grandsons how to catch more fish.
example.cn: 达明教他的孙子如何能捕到更多的鱼。

example.en: It is better to teach a man to fish than to give him fish.
example.cn: 授人以鱼，不如授人以渔。

name: fisherman
trans: n. 渔夫， 渔民； 钓鱼的人

example.en: Did you see several fishermen sitting on the beach, repairing their nets?
example.cn: 你看到几个渔夫坐在海滩上修补渔网了吗？

name: fit
trans: 词组 keep fit保持健康

example.en: Do you have any ready-made clothes that will fit me?
example.cn: 你们这儿有适合我穿的成衣吗？

example.en: You look very fit.
example.cn: 你看上去很健康。

name: fix
trans: v. 修理； 安装； 确定； 安排； 解决

example.en: Perhaps Sam can fix your TV set.
example.cn: 或许萨姆能修好你的电视机。

example.en: We mixed up our basket with theirs, but we soon fixed it.
example.cn: 我们把自己的篮子和他们的弄混了，但很快就分清了。

name: flag
trans: n. 旗； （体育运动的）信号旗；标志旗

example.en: Our flag is red and yellow.
example.cn: 我们的旗帜是红黄两色的。

name: flash
trans: n. 闪； 闪光； 转瞬间； 动画

example.en: Everything will be all right in a flash.
example.cn: 转瞬间什么事情都会好的。

name: flat
trans: n. 一套房间； 公寓

example.en: My uncle lives on the twentieth floor. The flat has a nice view of the Huangpu River.
example.cn: 我叔叔住在20楼。这套房间能看到黄浦江的美景。

example.en: The road was flat and easy to drive on.
example.cn: 道路平坦且易于驾驶。

name: flexible
trans: adj. 能适应新情况的；灵活的； 可变动的；柔韧的；有弹性的

example.en: Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater
example.cn: （满足）for the needs of everyone.

name: flight
trans: fly v.飞，飞行；乘飞机旅行；（旗帜等）飘动；放（风筝、飞机模型等）

example.en: Would you please find out the time of my flight for me?
example.cn: 请帮我查一下这个航班的起飞时间，好吗？

example.en: The flood deposited a layer of mud.
example.cn: 洪水过后沉积了一层泥浆。

name: floor
trans: n. 地面；地板；（楼房的）层

example.en: I have bought a new flat and it's on the eighth floor of the building.
example.cn: 我买了一套新公寓，它在这栋楼的8楼。

example.en: There were so many beautiful flowers on show at the park yesterday.
example.cn: 昨天在公园有这么多美丽的鲜花展示。

example.en: He had come down with the flu before he could board his flight.
example.cn: 他在登机前染上了流感。

name: fly
trans: v. 飞，飞行；乘飞机旅行；（旗帜等）飘动；放（风筝、飞机模型等）

example.en: My parents spent two hours flying to Beijing.
I can fly a kite.
example.cn: 我会放风筝。

example.en: You can see lots of flies flying inside the dirty restaurant.
example.cn: 你可以在那家脏乱的餐馆里看到许多苍蝇飞来飞去。

name: focus
trans: v. 集中（注意力、精力于）

example.en: Their talks are expected to focus on arms control.
example.cn: 他们的会谈预计会聚焦于军备控制问题。

name: follow
trans: v. 听从；遵循；跟随；仿效；跟得上
following adj. 下列的；接着的；以下的

example.en: I would follow your advice.
example.cn: 我会听从你的劝告。

name: following
trans: adj. 下列的；接着的；以下的

example.en: I had my first date with Polly the following evening.
example.cn: 第二天晚上，我和波丽有了第一次约会。

name: fond
trans: 词组 be fond of爱好

example.en: I'm very fond of country music.
example.cn: 我非常喜欢乡村音乐。

example.en: This truck is used to deliver frozen food from the factory to the supermarket.
example.cn: 这辆卡车是用来将冷冻食品从工厂运送到超市的。

example.en: Is it possible that I am a fool?
example.cn: 难道我是一个傻瓜吗？

example.en: I've been fooled!
example.cn: 我被骗了。

example.en: I was very foolish to believe him and lend him the money.
example.cn: 我真蠢，竟相信了他，还借钱给他。

example.en: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
example.cn: 求知若饥，虚心若愚。

name: foot
trans: 词组 on foot 步行；走路

example.en: My feet hurt awfully.
example.cn: 我的脚很痛。

example.en: How about playing football now?
example.cn: 现在踢足球怎么样？

name: for
trans: prep. （表示目的、用途等）为了⋯⋯；（表示方向）向⋯⋯；（表示时间、距离等）达；计；（表示原因）因为⋯⋯；（表示对象）对⋯⋯来说conj. 因为，由于
词组 for the first time 第一次
词组 for the time being 暂时；眼下

example.en: The postman cried out downstairs,"Mr. Anderson, here is a letter for you."
example.cn: 邮递员在楼下大叫：“安德森先生，这里有你的信。”

example.en: They made a rush for the exit.
example.cn: 他们猛然冲向出口处。

example.en: By the end of last year, Ben had worked as a postman for ten years.
example.cn: 到去年年底，本作为一名邮递员已工作了10年。

example.en: For this, he failed.
example.cn: 由于此原因他失败了。

example.en: Fortunately for him, he can swim.
example.cn: 幸亏他会游泳。

example.en: Prepare to alight, for we are almost there.
example.cn: 我们马上要到了，准备下车吧。

example.en: What's the weather forecast today?
example.cn: 今天的天气预报怎么说？

example.en: We'll forecast the weather.
example.cn: 我们将预报天气。

example.en: Most foreign students in our school are used to the changeable weather in Shanghai.
example.cn: 我们学校的大多数外国学生习惯了上海的易变天气。

example.en: With the development of China, more and more foreigners will choose to invest in China in the future.
example.cn: 随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国人将会选择在中国投资。

example.en: The air in the forest is much fresher than that in the city.
example.cn: 森林里的空气比城市中的要清新得多。

example.en: This moment will stay in my memory forever.
example.cn: 这一刻将永远留在我的记忆中。

name: forget
trans: v. 忘记， 忘掉； 遗忘
点拨 forget是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握forget doing和forget to do的用法区别：
点拨 forget doing表示忘记做过的某事（已做）。
点拨 forget to do表示忘记去做某件事（没做）。

example.en: Never forget to say"Thanks".
example.cn: 永远别忘了说“谢谢”。

example.en: I' ll never forget meeting my school headmaster for the first time.
The light in the office is still on. I forgot to turn it off.
As time passes, he is getting more and more forgetful.
example.cn: 随着时间的推移，他正变得越来越健忘。

example.en: Forgive me,I don't mean to insult you.
example.cn: 请原谅，我并非有意侮辱你。

example.en: There is a fork in my one hand, and a knife in my other hand.
example.cn: 我一手拿叉， 另一手拿刀。

example.en: A test is a form of measuring what students have learned.
example.cn: 测验是检验学生学习成果的一种方式。

example.en: Over time,a strong bond formed between the two friends.
example.cn: 久而久之，一条牢固的纽带在两位朋友之间形成了。

example.en: We must only look forward.
example.cn: 我们必须只向前看！

example.en: Keep going past the fountain.
example.cn: 一直走，经过那个喷泉。

name: France
trans: French adj.法国的；法国人的；法语的

example.en: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
example.cn: 巴黎是法国的首都和第一大城市。

name: free
trans: adj. 自由的；空闲的；免费的

example.en: After six months in prison, the famous music producer and director was set free.
example.cn: 经过6个月的监禁，这位著名的音乐制作人兼导演被释放了。

example.en: We're old enough to have the freedom to do what we like.
example.cn: 我们已长大，有自由去做我们喜欢做的事。

name: freeze
trans: v. 结冰；（使）冻结；（屏幕）冻结

example.en: I left water outside last night and it froze solid.
example.cn: 我昨晚把水放在外面，结果它冻得结结实实的。

example.en: If your phone freezes, try holding down the power button to restart it.
example.cn: 如果手机屏幕卡住了，可以长按电源键重启。

example.en: I won't feel very cold in freezing weather.
example.cn: 在极冷的天气下，我也不会感到很冷。

name: French
trans: adj. 法国的；法国人的；法语的

example.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous French landmark.
example.cn: 埃菲尔铁塔是一个著名的法国地标。

example.en: The French take great pride in their cultural heritage.
example.cn: 法国人对他们的文化遗产深感自豪。

example.en: With the help of apps and textbooks, these students teach themselves French.
example.cn: 在应用程序和课本的帮助下，这些学生自学法语。

example.en: She kept the windows open to let the fresh air in.
example.cn: 她把窗户打开，让新鲜空气进来。

example.en: We moved into the flat last Friday.
example.cn: 我们是上星期五搬进公寓的。

example.en: There is some bread in the fridge. It is not necessary to go to the store today.
example.cn: 冰箱里有一些面包。今天没有必要去商店了。

example.en: The main dish is a fried steak.
example.cn: 主菜是煎牛排。

name: friend
trans: friendly adj.朋友般的；友好的；友爱的
词组 make friends with与⋯⋯交朋友

example.en: The lady over there is a friend of mine.
example.cn: 那边的那位女士是我的一个朋友。

example.en: A friend of hers visited Beijing three days ago.
example.cn: 她的一位朋友3天前游览了北京。

example.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
example.cn: 患难见真情。

name: friendly
trans: adj. 朋友般的；友好的；友爱的
点拨 friendly是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记在中考考纲中有4个以-ly结尾的形容词,friendly是其中的一个，其他三个是: lovely,silly,early.

example.en: When we were visiting the small town, the people there were very friendly to us.
example.cn: 我们参观小镇时，那里的人们对我们很友好。

example.en: Jenny likes the new neighbourhood because people here are friendly.
example.cn: 珍妮喜欢新小区，因为这儿的人很友好。

example.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
example.cn: 真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

example.en: What makes you happy in life? Perhaps it is the love of your family or the friendship of your classmates.
example.cn: 是什么使你的生活快乐？也许是你家人的爱或是同学的友谊。

example.en: Even a mouse can frighten a guilty man.
example.cn: 做贼心虚。

name: frightened
trans: adj. 受惊吓的； 吃惊的

example.en: My dog is gentle and never bites, so you needn't be frightened.
example.cn: 我的狗很温驯，从不咬人，所以你不必害怕。

name: frightening
trans: 点拨 frightened是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与frightening的用法区别：
点拨 frightened用于形容人的感受,frightening用于形容事物。

example.en: My trip to Phuket Island was really a frightening experience.
example.cn: 我的普吉岛之旅真是一次可怕的经历。

example.en: The forest was very dark and frightening.
example.cn: 森林很黑暗恐怖。

name: from
trans: prep. （表示起点）从； 自； （表示时间）从······开始； （表示距离）离······； 距……；（表示来源）来自
词组 from then on从那时起
词组 from time to time不时；有时

example.en: How far is it from the office to your home?
example.cn: 从办公室到你家有多远？

example.en: One starry night, when the seven little dwarfs went back home from work, they found something unusual at once.

example.cn: 我想我不喜欢冷冻食品。它不新鲜。

name: full

example.cn: 如果你充满自信，你会一直开开心心。

词组 make fun of拿……开玩笑

example.en: What great fun it is to have a barbecue in the park on such a sunny day!
example.cn: 在这样一个晴朗的日子，在公园烧烤是多么有趣啊！

example.en: It is not nice to make fun of someone because of their appearance.

example.cn: 马克·吐温的故事很有趣，里面都是他童年时期的奇闻趣事。

example.en: I wonder if the floor can support such a weight of furniture.
example.cn: 我不知这地板能否承受住这样重的家具。

name: further
trans: adv. 较远，更远；进一步；而且

example.cn: 通过实践获得知识比从书本上学更有价值。

example.cn: 一份耕耘，一份收获。

example.cn: 网络游戏很有趣，但我们不能花太多时间。

example.cn: 足球是一项团队运动。

example.cn: 比赛进行了两个小时。

name: garden

example.cn: 小汤米和他的表弟在花园里玩耍多么快乐！

example.cn: 有许多气体是有害的。

example.cn: 他们的一个朋友正在公司门口等经理。

name: general
trans: adj. 大体的，笼统的；总的；全体的；普遍的

example.cn: 这是总体趋势。

example.en: A soldier who doesn't want to be a general is not a good soldier.
example.cn: 不想当将军的士兵不是好士兵。

example.en: Some famous speeches in history have left a lasting impact on future generations.
example.cn: 历史上一些著名的演讲对后世产生了深远的影响。

name: generous
trans: adj. 慷慨的， 大方的

example.en: She is a warmhearted,generous old lady.
example.cn: 她是一位热心、慷慨的老太太。

name: gentle
trans: adj. 温柔的； 文静的； 轻轻的

example.cn: 我想和那只温驯的猫玩耍。

example.en: I am a gentleman.
example.cn: 我是一个绅士。

name: gently
trans: 点拨 gently 是常考单词，是由形容词 gentle 转换而来。学生一定要牢记在中考考纲中有些形容词去e再加y 即可转换为副词， 如: possible————possibly（可能，也许）,simple————simply（简单地）,terrible————terribly（可怕地）。

example.cn: 他小心翼翼地捡起受伤的小鸟。

example.cn: 地理是一门很重要的学科。

name: German
trans: adj.德国的；德国人的；德语的

example.en: They are Germans,so they can speak German.
example.cn: 他们是德国人，所以他们会说德语。

example.cn: 你认为德国人聪明吗？

example.cn: 我们在德国餐厅吃午饭好吗？

example.cn: 你知道德国的人口是多少？

name: get

词组 get away走开，离开；逃走

词组 get rid of摆脱
词组 get tired of对⋯⋯感到厌倦

example.en: After taking tennis classes, Tim is getting much stronger than he was one year ago.
example.cn: 上了网球课之后，蒂姆比一年前强壮多了。

example.en: —She got a"D"in English.
I got to the station at half past four.
example.cn: 我于4点半到达车站。

example.en: Lucy has got a lovely pet dog. Its name is Taffy.
example.cn: 露西有一条可爱的宠物狗。它的名字叫“太妃糖”。

example.en: It's our family tradition to exchange gifts on New Year's Eve.
example.cn: 在除夕夜交换礼物是我们家的传统。

example.en: It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes.
example.cn: 对于这样一个小女孩，在10分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，太不寻常了。

example.en: What a useful suggestion you have given me!
example.cn: 你给我的建议是多么有用啊！

example.en: On leaving school, all the students felt thankful to the teachers for giving them a good education.
example.cn: 离开学校时，所有的学生都感谢老师给了他们良好的教育。

name: glad
trans: adj. 高兴的；乐意的；愉快的

example.en: I am glad to hear from you.
example.cn: 我很高兴收到你的来信。

example.en: I will be glad to do it for you.
example.cn: 我很乐意为你做这件事。

name: glass
trans: n. 玻璃杯；玻璃；（复）眼镜

example.en: It is said that eight glasses of water a day can help you keep fit.
example.cn: 有人说，每天8杯水可以帮助你保持健康。

example.en: The glasses are made of fine glass.
example.cn: 眼镜是由优质玻璃制成的。

name: go
trans: 词组 go for it加油，大胆尝试
词组 go hiking去远足；去徒步旅行
词组 go in for参加；从事于；酷爱
词组 go on a diet节食
词组 go on a picnic去野营；去野餐
词组 go on with 继续做某事
词组 go out外出；熄灭
词组 go over复习；仔细地再读一遍
词组 go sailing去航海，去航行
词组 go to bed就寝
词组 go to college上大学
词组 go to(the)hospital去医院（看病）
词组 go to school上学
词组 go to sleep入睡
词组 go to the cinema 去看电影
点拨 go是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握have gone to, have been to, have been in的用法区别：
点拨 have gone to意为“到某地去”，说话时该人不在现场，一般不用第一人称和第二人称代词作句子的主语。
点拨 例如: ————Where is Jim?吉姆在哪里？
点拨 ————He has gone to England.他去英国了。（尚未回来）
点拨 have been to意为“曾经去过某地”，现在已不在那里了。后可接表示次数的词，如once, twice, three times等， 也可和before, just, never, ever等词连用。
点拨 have been in表示“在某地待了多少时间”，句尾常接for +时间段， 或 since +时间点，或句首有How long.

example.en: Mike hurt one of his feet in an accident yesterday. Shall we go and see him after school?
example.cn: 昨天的事故中迈克伤了一只脚。放学后我们去看看他好吗？

example.en: I won't go to the party unless I'm invited.
example.cn: 除非我受到邀请，否则我不会去参加聚会。

example.en: Pride goes before a fall.
example.cn: 骄者必败。

name: goal
trans: n. 目标； 进球得的分； 球门

example.cn: 最后，杰克实现了他的目标，成为了一家公司的老板。

example.en: She kicked the ball into the net, scoring a goal for her team.
example.cn: 她把球踢进球网，为球队得了分。

example.en: Fire is the test of gold.
example.cn: 真金不怕火炼。

example.en: Her hair is golden.
example.cn: 她的头发是金黄色的。

trans: 词组 be good at擅长于

All things in their being are good for something.
example.cn: 天生我材必有用。

example.en: The government is going to widen the road this coming summer.
example.cn: 政府打算今年夏天拓宽道路。

name: grade
trans: n. 等级； （中小学的）学年， 年级； 成绩， 分数

example.cn: 姬蒂读八年级。

example.cn: 他得了一个不及格的成绩。

example.cn: 妈妈自2000年大学毕业后就一直在这所学校工作。

example.cn: 李芳是一名复旦大学的毕业生。

example.cn: 我的爷爷很健忘，他总是到处丢东西。

example.cn: 葡萄酒由葡萄酿制而成。

trans: adj. 伟大的；重要的；〈口〉好极了，很好

example.cn: 远大的理想造就伟大的人物。

example.cn: 交通信号灯变绿之前，不要启动汽车。

example.cn: 当你第一次见到面试官时，必须有礼貌地向他或她打招呼。

example.cn: 小心！地上有一只死猫！

example.cn: 我们学校的STEM课程要求学生分组完成一些项目。

example.cn: 她长大了！

example.cn: 爷爷在他的园子里种了蔬菜。

example.cn: 他对比赛结果的猜测是正确的。

example.cn: 所有的客人都对这家餐厅的优质服务表示满意。

example.cn: 你能将旅行指南递给我吗？

example.cn: 在陌生的城市里，导航系统将我们安全引到了目的地。

example.cn: 我们将在4点半集合。

example.cn: 凡事不要半途而废。

trans: n. 大厅， 会堂， 礼堂

example.cn: 你想吃一个汉堡吗？

example.cn: 他把玻璃杯递给了我。

example.cn: 请交上来！

example.cn: 他是这个国家里最后一个因谋杀被处绞刑的人。

example.cn: 这幅画以前挂在这儿，墙上还有些痕迹呢。

trans: 词组 happen to do碰巧做
词组 happen to sb.发生到某人身上

example.en: The fight happened so quickly that nobody could describe the start and the finish of it.
example.cn: 这场打斗发生得太快，以至于没人能描述它是怎么开始和结束的。

example.cn: 他们昨天碰巧在机场看到了那位著名的中国网球运动员。

name: happily

example.cn: 玛丽和彼得快乐地玩耍着。

example.cn: 我想生活幸福。

example.en: Diligence is the path leading to happiness.

name: happy
trans: adj. 幸福的；快乐的，高兴的

example.en: ——Happy birthday! Here is a present for you.

name: hard
trans: adv. 努力地；使劲；猛烈地

example.en: Every student in Grade Nine is studying hard to achieve more.
example.cn: 为了获得更多的知识，九年级的每一位学生都在努力学习。

example.en: It's hard to eat the hard bread.
example.cn: 硬面包不好啃。

example.en: Becoming a better person would not be hard if you follow all these instructions.
example.cn: 如果你遵循这些指示，要成为一个更好的人是不难的。 H

name: hardly
trans: adv. 几乎不； 几乎没有
点拨 h a r d l y 是 常 考 单 词 ， 常 出 现 在   疑 问 句 中 ， 所 以 学 生 一 定 要 知 道 ：
点拨 1) 陈述部分含有hardly, never, none, seldom, rarely, little, few, no, neither, nobody,no one,nothing,too ... to ...表示否定意义的词时，疑问部分要用肯定形式。
点拨 2)陈述部分含有否定前、后缀构成的词时，作肯定句处理，疑问部分要用否定形式。
点拨 He is unhappy 他不高兴 不诚实， 不是吗？
点拨 3) 当陈述部分是I think,I believe,I guess等主句后跟that从句时（当主句的主语是第一人称），疑问部分应该与从句保持一致，并且要注意否定的转移。

example.cn: 不要在昏暗的灯光下看书，以免损伤眼睛。

example.en: It wouldn't do any harm to ask for advice.
example.cn: 向别人征询建议是不会有任何害处的。

name: harmful

example.cn: 我们成了最好的朋友，他深深地影响了我。

name: information
trans: n. 信息；消息；情报；资料；资讯

example.en: It is impossible for us to memorise so much information by just reading once.
example.cn: 要记住这么多的信息，只读一次对我们来说是不可能的。

example.en: Don't write your exercise in red ink.
example.cn: 不要用红墨水做练习。

name: inside
trans: prep. 在（或向）······里面；在（或向）······内

example.en: The mouse is inside the box.
example.cn: 老鼠在盒子中。

example.en: Do you mind turning on the electric fan? It is a bit hot inside.
example.cn: 你介意打开电风扇吗？里面有一点热。

name: instead
trans: 词组 instead of代替；而不是

example.en: You can have pizza for dinner, or you can try the noodles instead.
example.cn: 你晚餐可以吃比萨饼，或者可以试试面条。

example.en: Instead of going further, the tourists took a rest in the hotel nearby.
example.cn: 游客没有走得更远，就在附近的酒店休息了。

name: instruction
trans: n. 用法说明；命令，指令；指示；指导

example.en: Follow the safety instructions, or you could end up in a dangerous situation.
example.cn: 遵循安全指示，否则你可能会陷入危险境地。

example.en: In the end, he lost interest in learning Japanese.
example.cn: 最终，他对学习日语失去了兴趣。

name: interested
trans: 词组 be interested in对······感兴趣

example.en: I'm interested in playing basketball.
example.cn: 我的爱好是打篮球。

example.en: What an interesting story!
example.cn: 多有趣的故事啊！

example.en: Pudong International Airport is one of the biggest airports in the world.
example.cn: 浦东国际机场是世界上最大的机场之一。

name: internet
trans: 词组 surf the internet 上网

example.en: Please show me how to use WeChat to talk with each other on the internet.
example.cn: 请告诉我如何使用微信在网上互相交谈。

example.en: Then you will possibly understand your questions better and get right answers on the day of the interview.
example.cn: 这样你可能在面试那天更好地理解问题并正确回答。

example.en: I'll interview you about your research work.
example.cn: 我将就您的研究工作采访您。

name: into
trans: prep. 到······里；向内；（表示状态的变化）变成；进入

example.en: It turned into ice.
example.cn: 它变成了冰。

example.en: Could you introduce three historical events in the Tang dynasty to us?
example.cn: 你能向我们介绍唐朝的3个历史事件吗？

example.en: Since the new rules were introduced, many complaints have been made.
example.cn: 自从新规出台以来，已经出现了诸多投诉。

example.en: Edison invented quite a lot of things during his life.
example.cn: 爱迪生在他一生中发明了很多东西。

example.en: Making paper is one of the greatest inventions of ancient Chinese people.
example.cn: 造纸是中国古代人民最伟大的发明之一。

example.en: The internet is a great invention. It makes the world"smaller".
example.cn: 互联网是一项伟大的发明。它使世界变“小”了。

example.en: The machine is named after its inventor.
example.cn: 这台机器是以其发明者的名字命名的。

example.en: The police took the case seriously and began investigating immediately.
example.cn: 警方严肃对待这个案件，并立即展开了调查。

example.en: We received Peter's invitation and went to his birthday party happily.
example.cn: 我们收到了彼得的邀请，并愉快地参加他的生日聚会。

example.en: Thank you very much for your invitation.
example.cn: 非常感谢你的邀请。

example.en: The young artist often invites children to join his art activities, helping them develop an interest in painting.
example.cn: 这位年轻的艺术家经常邀请孩子们参与他的艺术活动，助力他们培养绘画兴趣。

example.en: Iron and wood have different natures.
example.cn: 铁和木头的性质不同。

example.en: Taiwan is the biggest island of China. I hope to visit it soon.
example.cn: 台湾是中国最大的岛屿。我希望不久能参观这座岛。

name: Italian
trans: adj. 意大利人的；意大利语的

example.en: The Italian Prime Minister paid her first visit to China last July.
example.cn: 去年7月意大利总理首次访华。

example.en: I can speak Italian.
example.cn: 我会说意大利语。

name: Italy
trans: Italian adj.意大利人的；意大利语的

example.en: Last summer I went to France. This year I'm going to Italy instead.
example.cn: 去年夏天我去了法国，而今年我要去意大利。

name: item
trans: n. 项目；节目；一件商品（物品）；一则

example.en: I think we ought to pass on to the next item.
example.cn: 我想我们应该接着开始下一个项目。

example.en: I'd like to buy that jacket, but the colour is not my first choice.
example.cn: 我想买那件夹克，但颜色不是我的首选。

example.en: I like to eat jam.
example.cn: 我喜欢吃果酱。

example.en: I'm sure there will be fewer traffic jams in the future.
example.cn: 我确信未来交通堵塞的情况会越来越少。

example.en: It happened on January the seventeenth.
example.cn: 事情发生在1月17日。

name: Japan
trans: Japanese adj. 日本的； 日语的； 日本人的

example.en: Thousands of lives were lost in the terrible earthquake that happened in Japan.
example.cn: 在日本发生的可怕地震中，有成千上万的人失去了生命。

name: Japanese
trans: adj. 日本的； 日语的； 日本人的

example.en: I am fond of Japanese food. It's light and delicious.
example.cn: 我很喜欢日本的食物。它清淡而美味。

example.en: I am a Japanese so I can speak Japanese.
example.cn: 我是日本人，所以我会说日语。

example.en: I don't want to buy the jeans because neither the colour nor the size fits me.
example.cn: 我不想买那条牛仔裤，因为颜色和尺码都不适合我。

name: job
trans: 词组 get a job找到一份工作
词组 lose one's job失业
点拨 job是常考单词，学生一定要掌握其与work的用法区别：

example.en: The local government is planning to create more jobs for young people.
example.cn: 当地政府正计划为年轻人创造更多的就业机会。

example.en: He got a job as a waiter.
example.cn: 他找到一份服务员的工作。

example.en: Cooking is not an easy job.
example.cn: 做饭不是一件容易的事。

name: join
trans: v. 参加， 加入； 连接
点拨 join是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法。join与attend,enterfor,join in,take part in都有“参加”的意思，学生需知道它们的用法区别：
点拨 join指加入某个组织、团体，并成为其中一员，也可用于表示加入某人做某事。
点拨 attend常用于表示参加会议、婚礼、讲座、课程等较为正式的活动，强调出席这一动作。
点拨 enter for主要用于表示报名参加竞赛、考试等活动。
点拨 join in更强调加入到他人正在进行的活动中，通常指小规模的活动，可与takepart in互换。
点拨 take part in侧重于参加活动并在其中发挥作用、承担角色，通常用于参加会议、比赛、活动等。

example.en: It must be fantastic if more students join in the charity show tomorrow.
example.cn: 要是有更多的学生参加明天的慈善演出，那一定很棒。

example.en: She joined the club two years ago.
example.cn: 她两年前加入了这个俱乐部。

example.en: Will you join us for dinner?
example.cn: 你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

example.en: Can I join in the game?
example.cn: 我能加入这个游戏吗？

name: joke
trans: 词组 make jokes about开玩笑，取笑某人

example.en: We had better treat it as a joke.
example.cn: 我们最好把它当作玩笑。

example.en: I like to joke.
example.cn: 我喜欢开玩笑。

name: journalist
trans: n. 记者， 新闻工作者

example.en: I want to be a journalist after graduation.
example.cn: 毕业后我想当记者。

example.en: Do you know if they had a good journey home?
example.cn: 你知道他们回家的旅途是否愉快？

name: joy
trans: n. 欢乐； 高兴； 乐趣； 愉快； 喜悦

example.en: To my great joy,my lost watch was found.
example.cn: 使我极为高兴的是，我丢失的手表找到了。 常用词组

example.en: to one' s joy
example.cn: 使某人高兴的是

example.en: jump for joy
example.cn: 欢呼雀跃

name: judge
trans: n. 裁判； 审判员； 法官

example.en: The judge sentenced the bad egg to death.
example.cn: 法官判这个混蛋死刑。

example.en: Teachers always judge their students on the final examination.
example.cn: 老师常根据期末考试来评价他们的学生。

example.en: Judge not of men and things at first sight.
example.cn: 评人论事，莫靠初见。

example.en: —Let's go to get a pizza and a glass of orange juice.
We'll take our holiday sometime in July, I think.
example.cn: 我想我们大概会在7月休假。

name: jump
trans: 词组 jump to a conclusion贸然断定；草率决定

example.en: His jump shot is very accurate.
example.cn: 他的跳投非常精准。

example.en: Don't jump to a conclusion! Let's discuss the problem first.
example.cn: 不要妄下结论！让我们先讨论这个问题。

example.en: I arrived on a hot June morning.
example.cn: 我是在6月的一个炎热的上午到达的。

name: junior
trans: n.年少者；较年幼者；年资较浅者

example.en: Many Junior Three students give up their hobbies because of their busy school work.
example.cn: 许多初三学生放弃自己的兴趣爱好，因为他们忙于学校作业。

example.en: The junior in the office was responsible for organising the team-building event.
example.cn: 办公室里的年轻员工负责组织团建活动。

name: just
trans: adv. 刚才；恰好；不过；仅；只是

example.en: Just then a friend drove up and gave me a ride.
example.cn: 正在那时，一个朋友开车过来，让我搭了他的车。

name: keen
trans: 词组 be keen on喜爱

example.en: About one-third of the students in our class are keen on pop songs.
example.cn: 我们班大约有三分之一的学生热衷于流行歌曲。

name: keep
trans: v. 保持；保存； 继续不断； 培育， 饲养
词组 keep doing sth.继续做某事
词组 keep from阻止；使……免于
词组 keep off阻挡；不让……接近
点拨 keep主要有以下三种用法：
点拨 1) keep sth.+形容词使某物保持某种状态
点拨 2) keep a dog(= raise a dog)养一只狗
点拨 3) keep doing sth.继续做某事
点拨 keep作为常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型或词语转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: keep doing与go on doing 意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Amazing new products are developed constantly to keep customers excited.
example.cn: 令人惊叹的新产品不断研发出来，让顾客保持兴奋。

example.en: You are lucky enough to keep the book for a week.
example.cn: 你够幸运，这本书你可以借一周。

example.en: The poor baby has kept crying for a long time because he can't find his mother.
example.cn: 可怜的宝宝一直哭了很久，因为他找不到他的母亲。

example.en: Keeping pet dogs can help people learn more about life and death.
example.cn: 养宠物狗可以帮助人们更了解生命和死亡。

example.en: Keeping is harder than winning.
example.cn: 创业不易，守业更难。

example.en: Jimmy kept talking with others in the Maths lesson yesterday.

name: key
trans: n. 钥匙； 答案； 关键
点拨 key是常考单词，key后常用介词to表示用途。例如：
点拨 the key to success成功的关键
点拨 key to the door房门钥匙
点拨 the key to the question答案要点

example.en: I searched every corner of the house for the key, but couldn't find it.
example.cn: 我找遍了房子的每一个角落，却还是没找到那把钥匙。

name: keyboard
trans: n. （计算机或打字机的）键盘

example.en: The keyboard is used to put information into the computer.
example.cn: 键盘用于把信息输入电脑。

example.en: In winter, Chinese students like to kick the Jianzi to keep themselves warm.
example.cn: 在冬天，中国学生喜欢踢毽子取暖。

example.en: It's a corner kick.
example.cn: 这是一个角球。

example.en: I am kidding.
example.cn: 我在开玩笑。

example.en: I don't go out much, mainly because I have to look after the kids.
example.cn: 我不太出去，主要是因为我要照顾孩子。

example.en: Tornadoes swept across the South America last month. At least 28 people were killed.
example.cn: 上个月龙卷风横扫南美洲，至少有28人死亡。

example.en: Apples cost eighteen yuan a kilogram.
example.cn: 苹果每公斤18元。

example.en: My home is half a kilometre away from here.
example.cn: 我家离这儿有半公里。

name: kind
trans: 词组 a kind of一种；一类

example.en: Most tomatoes are red when ripe, but some kinds are yellow.
example.cn: 大多数西红柿成熟时是红色的，但有些品种是黄色的。

example.en: It's very kind of you to help me with my English.
example.cn: 你真好，帮我学英语。

example.en: Most girls in our kindergarten like to play with dolls.
example.cn: 我们幼儿园大多数女孩子喜欢玩洋娃娃。

example.en: Your smile is the best way to show people your kindness.
example.cn: 你的微笑是向人们展示你善意的最好方式。

example.en: The story goes that long ago there lived a king.
example.cn: 传说很久以前那儿有个国王。

example.en: Billy, is your mother cooking meat in the kitchen? It smells so nice!
example.cn: 比利，你妈妈是不是在厨房炖肉？味道很香！

example.en: My brother is flying a kite in the park.
example.cn: 我的弟弟在公园里放风筝。

example.en: The children learned to put their knives and forks down on the plates after eating.
example.cn: 孩子们学会用完餐后，把刀叉放在盘子上。

example.en: They heard a knock at the front door.
example.cn: 他们听到前门有人敲门。

example.en: We can knock the wall through to make a new entrance.
example.cn: 我们可以把墙打通开扇新门。

name: know
trans: v. 知道；了解；认识；懂得

example.en: Lily and Mary have known each other for seven years.
example.cn: 莉莉和玛丽相识已有7年了。

example.en: Maria is known as an honest girl, and her word is always trusted.
example.cn: 玛丽亚是出了名的诚实女孩，大家一直都信任她的话。

name: knowledge
trans: 谚语 Knowledge is power.知识就是力量。

example.en: He has a wide knowledge of history and can answer almost any question about it.
example.cn: 他有渊博的历史知识，几乎能回答任何有关历史的问题。

example.en: We usually have Science in the science lab.
example.cn: 我们通常在科学实验室里上科学课。

example.en: Who is that beautiful young lady?
example.cn: 那位漂亮的年轻女士是谁呀?

example.en: The lake looks beautiful in the moonlight. I often take a walk around it.
example.cn: 在月光下湖看起来很漂亮。我经常沿着湖散步。

example.en: The lamp is powered by two small batteries.
example.cn: 这盏灯由两节小电池供电。

example.en: We will fly over the sea to our beautiful land.
example.cn: 我们将飞越海洋到我们那片美丽的土地。

example.en: It was sent flying into the air and landed 20 feet away.
example.cn: 它被抛入空中，在20英尺以外落地。

example.en: It goes without saying that studying vocabulary is a key part of language learning.
example.cn: 不用说也知道，学习词汇是学习语言的一个主要部分。

example.en: There is an ice lantern show in Harbin every year in winter.
example.cn: 每年冬天，哈尔滨都有一次冰灯展。

name: large
trans: adj. 大的；巨大的；大规模的；大量的

example.en: With an area of 200,000 square metres, the new National Museum has become the largest museum in the world.
example.cn: 新的国家博物馆占地面积20万平方米，已成为世界上最大的博物馆。

name: last
trans: adj. 最近刚过去的；最后的
词组 at last最后；终于

example.en: In the last few months we have been very busy.
example.cn: 最近几个月我们一直都很忙。

example.en: Last but not least, I want to be able to spend more time with family and friends.
example.cn: 最后同样重要的是，我希望能够花更多的时间与家人和朋友在一起。

example.en: You are always the last to finish.
example.cn: 你总是最后完成的那一位。

example.en: The snowstorm will last till tomorrow afternoon.
example.cn: 暴风雪将持续到明天下午。

name: late
trans: 词组 be late for⋯⋯迟到

example.en: I'm sorry I'm late. I was kept at the office.
example.cn: 对不起，我迟到了。我在办公室有点事儿被耽搁了。

example.en: It is unhealthy to stay up late and go to work without having breakfast.
example.cn: 熬夜和不吃早饭上班是不健康的。

example.en: It is never too late to mend.
example.cn: 亡羊补牢，未为迟也。 改过不嫌晚。

example.en: All data are recorded on magnetic tape for later detailed analysis.
example.cn: 全部数据记录在磁带上，以便稍后作详细分析。

example.en: The young man fell in love with a lovely girl and they got married two months later.
example.cn: 这个年轻人爱上了一个可爱的女孩，两个月后，他们结婚了。

example.en: The movie was so funny that all the children laughed a lot.
example.cn: 这部电影如此有趣，引得所有孩子都开怀大笑。

example.en: Lysenko gave a deep rumbling laugh at his own joke.
example.cn: 李森科被自己讲的笑话逗得哈哈大笑。

example.en: He who laughs last laughs best.
example.cn: 谁笑到最后，谁笑得最好。

example.en: Courts are constituted by law.
example.cn: 法庭是依法设立的。

example.en: The groom is a lawyer.
example.cn: 新郎是一位律师。

name: lay
trans: 词组 lay the table（饭前）摆好餐具

example.en: How many eggs does this hen lay each week?
example.cn: 这只母鸡一星期下多少个蛋？

example.en: He is a lazy boy.
example.cn: 他是个懒家伙。

example.en: Lazy days are ideal for taking leisurely walks in the park.
example.cn: 悠闲的日子最适合在公园里从容地散步。

name: lead
trans: n.（戏剧、电影等中的）主角；（竞赛中的）领先地位
词组 lead to 导致

example.en: He led us to his home.
example.cn: 他带我们去他家。

example.en: Their team lost the lead in the competition after the second round.
example.cn: 他们队在第二轮后失去了领先地位。

example.en: All roads lead to Rome.
example.cn: 条条大路通罗马。

name: learn
trans: 词组 learn… from 向⋯⋯学习

example.en: In some English classes, pictures are used to help the students learn new words.
example.cn: 在一些英语课上，图片被用来辅助学生学习新单词。

example.en: We soon learned how to grow organic vegetables.
=We soon learned how they grew organic vegetables.
example.cn: 我们很快就学会如何种植有机蔬菜。

example.en: Learn young, learn fair.
example.cn: 学习趁年轻，学就要学好。

name: leave
trans: v. 离开；把⋯⋯留下；剩下；丢弃
词组 leave a message 留个口信
词组 leave for 动身去
词组 leave (secondary) school（中学）毕业

example.en: He left China six years ago.=He's been away from China for six years.
Oh, my goodness! I left my mobile phone in the car just now.
example.cn: 哦，我的天哪！我刚才把手机落在车里了。

example.en: There was very little food left on the table.
example.cn: 桌子上没剩什么食物了。

example.en: He wants to ask for leave.
example.cn: 他想请假。

example.en: He gave us a lecture on physics.
example.cn: 他给我们作了一次有关物理学的演讲。

example.en: Put up your left hand.
example.cn: 举起左手。

example.en: Turn left!
example.cn: 向左转！

example.en: The bank is on your left.
example.cn: 银行在你的左边。

example.en: A spider has 8 legs.
example.cn: 一只蜘蛛有8条腿。

example.en: There is something wrong with my computer, so Mary lent me hers.
example.cn: 我的电脑坏了，玛丽就把她的借给了我。

name: length
trans: long adj.（时间）长的； （距离）远的

example.en: The length of that bridge is over 200 metres.
example.cn: 那座桥的长度超过了200米。

name: lesson
trans: 词组 have a lesson上课

example.en: If Tony isn't careful enough with his lesson, more mistakes will be made later.
example.cn: 托尼如果不仔细做功课，他以后将犯更多的错误。

name: let
trans: 点拨 l e t 是 常 考 单 词 ， 常 出 现 在   疑 问 句 句 型 中 ， 所 以 学 生 一 定 要 掌 握 祈 使 句 在   疑 问 句 中 的 习 惯 用 法 ：

name: none
trans: pron. 没有任何东西；没有人
点拨 none是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握none的习惯用法，及比较与neither和no one的用法区别。
点拨 none指三者及以上的人或物，表示“没有一个”的意思。另外，none后常接of短语，of后可接可数名词或代词；作主语时，谓语动词用单、复数形式皆可；of后也可接不可数名词，这时谓语动词必须用单数形式。
点拨 neither指两者中“没有一个”。
点拨 no one = nobody,只指人，表示“没有人”，不能指物，后面不能接of构成的短语。noone作主语时，谓语动词只能用单数形式。
点拨 例如: Sorry, but none of us speaks
点拨 none用来回答How many……或How much……引起的问句以及含“any(one) of+ 名词”构成的一般疑问句。
点拨 no one 用来回答Who...引起的问句及含anyone 的一般疑问句。 nothing用来回答What...引起的问句及含anything的一般疑问句。

trans: prep. （指时间等）过⋯⋯；走过某处；经过
词组 in the past在过去；从前

example.en: I arrived at half past ten.
example.cn: 我10点半到的。

example.en: Travelling by bus is more comfortable nowadays than in the past.
example.cn: 现在乘公共汽车出行比过去更舒适。

example.en: My father and I have taken a lot of photos at the same place in the past ten years.
example.cn: 在过去10年里，我和父亲在同一个地方拍了很多照片。

example.en: The earlier the treatment is given, the more likely the patient is to recover.
example.cn: 病人越早接受治疗，康复的可能性就越大。

example.en: He's a very patient man.
example.cn: 他是个很有耐心的人。

name: pay
trans: v. 付钱，给⋯⋯报酬；（与某些名词结合使用，表示将要做或付出某事物）
词组 pay attention to（对某人或某事）注意

example.en: Mr. Fermont couldn't believe that his wife paid $10,000 for just a handbag.
Twenty dollars was paid to me.
example.cn: 付给我20美元。

example.en: The workers demand a twenty percent pay rise.
example.cn: 工人要求加薪20%。

example.en: The students have three P. E. lessons a week.
example.cn: 学生们一周有3节体育课。

name: peace
trans: peaceful adj.和平的；安静的；宁静的

example.en: We live in peace with our neighbours.
example.cn: 我们与邻居和睦相处。

example.en: The pear is a delicious fruit and I like it very much.
example.cn: 梨是一种美味的水果，我非常喜欢。

example.en: The necklace is made of natural pearls.
example.cn: 这条项链是用天然珍珠做成的。

example.en: Students are required to write their exercises in pen.
example.cn: 学生被要求用钢笔做练习。

example.en: Who has taken my pencil away? I used it minutes ago.
example.cn: 谁拿了我的铅笔？几分钟前我还在用呢。

name: people
trans: 点拨 people, police, clothes, Chinese, Japanese这些集合名词作主语时，谓语动词要用复数。

example.en: It is reported that more than two thousand people have been killed in this big earthquake.
example.cn: 据报道，在这次的大地震中死亡人数已超过两千人。

example.en: The lunch is $3.50 per person.
example.cn: 午餐费是每人3.5美元。

name: percent
trans: n. , adj.& adv.百分比，百分之⋯⋯

example.en: Twenty percent of the products are exported.
example.cn: 百分之二十的产品外销。

example.en: The store is offering a fifty percent discount on prices.
example.cn: 这家商店正在5折销售产品。

example.en: Gold price rose seventy percent last year.
example.cn: 去年黄金价格上涨了百分之七十。

example.en: The length of the hiking route in the national park is perfect for a walk.
example.cn: 国家公园里这条徒步路线的长度很适合散步。

example.en: The performance of Class A students is much better than that of Class B students.
Perhaps I can help you.
example.cn: 也许我能帮你忙。

name: person
trans: 词组 in person亲自；当面

example.en: Nobody would like to make friends with those dishonest persons.
example.cn: 没有人会和那些不诚实的人交朋友。

example.en: It's all a matter of personal taste.
example.cn: 这纯粹是个人的品味问题。

example.en: Many people like to keep pet dogs because dogs will love people faithfully forever.
example.cn: 很多人都喜欢养宠物狗，因为狗会永远对人忠实。

example.en: The children were excited to pet the rabbits at the farm.
example.cn: 孩子们兴奋地在农场抚摸兔子。

name: phone
trans: 词组 by phone打电话，在通话中
词组 on the phone在打电话

example.en: Doug's 14-year-old son Jamie answered the phone.
example.cn: 道格14岁的儿子杰米接了电话。

example.en: Yesterday he phoned Laura to see if she was better.
example.cn: 昨天他打电话给劳拉，问她是不是好些了。

example.en: We took many photos at Grandpa's birthday party.
example.cn: 我们在爷爷的生日聚会上拍了很多照片。

name: physical
trans: adj. 身体的； 物理的

example.en: Playing basketball is one form of physical exercise.
example.cn: 打篮球是体育锻炼的一种形式。

example.en: Physics isn't so difficult. You needn't be disappointed. I'm sure you' ll pass it next time.
example.cn: 物理不是那么难。你不必感到失望。我确信你下一次会通过。

name: piano
trans: 点拨 piano是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道：在乐器名词前要用定冠词the.

example.en: Alice loves music. Every day she practises playing the piano for an hour.
example.cn: 爱丽丝热爱音乐。她每天练习弹钢琴一个小时。

name: pick
trans: v. 拾起； 摘； 采集； 挑选； 选择
词组 pick up捡起；拾起；增强；改善

example.en: Would you please help me pick up the umbrella on the floor?
example.cn: 请你帮我把地板上的伞拾起来好吗？

example.en: Children are often told that they mustn't pick flowers in public gardens.
example.cn: 孩子们经常被告知，他们不应该在公园摘花。

name: picnic
trans: 词组 go on a picnic去野餐

example.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will have a picnic in the park.
example.cn: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去公园野餐。

example.en: The students asked Mrs. Yang when they would have a picnic at Century Park.
= The students asked Mrs. Yang when to have a picnic at Century Park.
example.cn: 学生问杨老师他们什么时候去世纪公园野餐。

name: picture
trans: n. 图片， 图画， 照片； 影片

example.en: I had a picture taken this morning.
example.cn: 今天上午我请人给我拍了张照片。

name: piece
trans: n. 一块（片、张、件、段……）；碎片；碎块；部件
词组 a piece of一块（片、张、件、段）

example.en: Could you give me a piece of paper?
example.cn: 你能给我一张纸吗？

example.en: She was really unhappy to see her favourite vase break into pieces right in front of her.
example.cn: 看到心爱的花瓶就在眼前摔得粉碎，她非常难过。

example.en: He raises pigs for a living.
example.cn: 他以养猪为生。

example.en: Why do I have to take all these pills?
example.cn: 我为什么非得服下所有这些药丸？

example.en: Robin was once a fighter pilot during World War II.
example.cn: 罗宾在二战期间曾当过战斗机飞行员。

example.en: The secretary pinned the papers together.
example.cn: 秘书把文件钉在一起。

example.en: Mary used a pin to fasten the loose hem of her dress.
example.cn: 玛丽用针把松开的裙子下摆固定起来。

example.en: She drank a cup of pineapple juice.
example.cn: 她喝了一杯菠萝汁。

example.en: She was dressed in pink.
example.cn: 她穿着粉红色的衣服。

example.en: The pink sky in the evening means a clear day will follow.
example.cn: 傍晚粉红色的天空说明次日是晴天。

name: pioneer
trans: n. 先锋；开拓者；带头人

example.en: They were the pioneers of the American West.
example.cn: 他们是美国西部的开拓者。

name: pity
trans: n. 怜悯；同情；可惜的事；（用于表示失望）遗憾，可惜
词组 have pity on sb.怜悯某人

example.en: She never asked for pity before.
example.cn: 她过去从未乞求怜悯。

example.en: What a pity you can't come to my birthday party!
example.cn: 你不能来我的生日聚会，真可惜！

example.en: He likes to eat pizzas.
example.cn: 他喜欢吃比萨饼。

example.en: There are many interesting places for children everywhere. But Disneyland is called the happiest place on the earth.
example.cn: 有许多有趣的地方供孩子们玩。但迪士尼乐园被称为世界上最快乐的地方。

example.en: I placed the desk.
example.cn: 我放置了桌子。

example.en: Two-thirds of people said yes to the new plan.
example.cn: 三分之二的人同意这个新计划。

example.en: Wang Fang plans to take plenty of presents to her friends in New York when she goes there at Christmas.
example.cn: 王芳计划在圣诞节去纽约的时候带很多礼物给她那儿的朋友。

example.en: The pilot landed the plane safely at its home airport.
example.cn: 飞行员将飞机安全地降落在驻地机场。

example.en: The planets move around the sun.
example.cn: 行星绕着太阳转。

example.en: People had planted a lot of trees along the lake by the end of last month.
example.cn: 到上个月底，人们沿湖种植了很多树木。

example.en: These are perennial plants.
example.cn: 这些是多年生的植物。

example.en: The company sells plastic products.
example.cn: 这家公司出售塑料制品。

example.en: The toy manufacturer switched to using biodegradable plastics in their products.
example.cn: 玩具厂商转而在他们的产品中使用可生物降解的塑料。

example.en: He had a plate of beef for lunch.
example.cn: 他午餐吃了一盘牛肉。

example.en: I must put my thoughts together before I go on the platform.
example.cn: 在走上讲台讲演之前，我要把我的思绪整理一下。

name: play
trans: v. 玩；打（球）；演奏；扮演；播放
player n.运动员；选手；演奏者
词组 play a trick on捉弄
词组 play with玩耍，摆弄
词组 act in a play参演戏剧

example.en: Although Yao Ming has made himself known to the whole world for his talent in playing basketball, he still stays very humble.
example.cn: 虽然姚明已经让全世界知道他有打篮球的天赋，他依然非常谦虚。

example.en: Mike practised playing the piano for five hours a day in order to get a prize in the contest.
example.cn: 为了能在比赛中获奖，迈克每天练习5个小时钢琴。

example.en: Did you enjoy the play?
example.cn: 你喜欢那个戏剧吗？

example.en: People crowded round the player with congratulations.
example.cn: 人们簇拥着那个运动员向他祝贺。

example.en: You can find him on the playground, I think.
example.cn: 我想你去操场能找到他。

name: pleasant
trans: adj. 令人愉快的；舒适的
pleased adj.感到高兴的；感到满意的
unpleasant adj.令人不快的；不舒服的

example.en: His sister sings well. She has a pleasant voice.
example.cn: 他的姐姐唱歌唱得很好。她有一副悦耳的嗓音。

example.en: Will you please tell him the news when you see him?
example.cn: 当你看到他时，请告诉他这个消息好吗？

example.en: This book will please you.
example.cn: 这本书会让你满意的。

name: pleased
trans: adj. 感到高兴的；感到满意的
词组 be pleased with对⋯⋯满意

example.en: We are very pleased with our new house.
example.cn: 我们对自己的新居很满意。

name: pleasure
trans: 词组 with pleasure愉快地；乐意地

example.en: Mrs. Zhou always helps her students with great pleasure.
example.cn: 周老师总是非常乐意帮助她的学生。

name: plenty
trans: 词组 plenty of大量的，充足的，很多的

example.en: The garden was blooming with colourful flowers in plenty.
example.cn: 花园里开满了五颜六色的花。

example.en: He has plenty of humourous stories to tell.
example.cn: 他有许多幽默故事可讲。

example.en: Five plus two equals seven.5
example.cn: 加2等于7.

example.en: It's 1:00 p. m. now.
example.cn: 现在是下午1点。

example.en: The policeman made the thief turn out his pockets.
example.cn: 警察叫小偷把口袋都翻出来。

example.en: This poem is so wonderful.
example.cn: 这首诗太棒了。

name: point
trans: n.点；得分；分数；小数点；尖端

example.en: It's rude to point your fingers at people.
example.cn: 用手指指人是不礼貌的。

example.en: Then think about yourself——your strong points and weak ones.
example.cn: 然后想想你自己——你的优点和缺点。

example.en: We used a branch as a fishing pole.
example.cn: 我们用树枝做钓竿。

example.en: The old man was thankful to the policeman who found the lost car for him.
example.cn: 这位老人感激警察找到了他丢失的汽车。

example.en: I've never seen such a polite clerk.
example.cn: 我从未见过这样有礼貌的店员。

example.en: "Would you please stop smoking?"the little girl said to the man politely.
example.cn: 小女孩有礼貌地对那个男子说：“请你不要吸烟好吗？”

example.en: Politics was one of his university subjects.
example.cn: 政治学是他大学的课程之一。

example.en: The environment will be seriously polluted if people don't take any action.
example.cn: 如果人们不采取任何行动，环境将受到严重污染。

example.en: All the students in Shanghai should help fight against pollution to protect the environment.
example.cn: 上海所有的学生都应该为保护环境与污染作斗争。

example.en: After the heavy rain there were pools on the road.
example.cn: 大雨过后路上有一些小水塘。

name: poor
trans: adj. 贫穷的；可怜的；不好的
词组 be poor at不擅长

example.en: My family used to be poor.
example.cn: 我家过去很穷。

example.en: The poor couple dreamed of having a flat of their own some day in the future.
example.cn: 这对贫穷的夫妻梦想在未来的某一天拥有一套自己的房子。

example.en: My brother is poor at history.
example.cn: 我哥哥历史不好。

name: popular
trans: adj. 流行的；大众喜爱的；广受欢迎的；当红的

example.cn: 城市漫步在上海当地人中变得极为流行。

example.en: Now she is quite popular with her friends and she has also gained more confidence.
example.cn: 现在她很受朋友欢迎，也获得了更多的自信。

name: population
trans: n. （地区、国家等的）人口，人数
