example.cn: 在未来几年将建造更多的养老院，以应对人口老龄化。

example.en: How much pork do you need to make dumplings for the family and the guests?
example.cn: 为家人和客人包饺子你需要多少猪肉？

example.en: Is such a thing possible?
example.cn: 这种事可能吗？

example.en: Mary is good at writing. She will possibly be a reporter in the future.
example.cn: 玛丽擅长写作。她将来可能会成为一名记者。

name: post
trans: 词组 an online post一个网上的帖子

example.en: If you could get the book, please send it to me by post.
example.cn: 如果你能弄到那本书，请邮寄给我。

example.en: If I write a letter, would you post it for me?
example.cn: 如果我写封信，你能替我寄出去吗？

example.en: She posted a photo of her vacation on social media to share with her friends.
example.cn: 她在社交媒体上发了一张度假照片，与朋友分享。

example.en: He sent me a postcard from the United Nations.
example.cn: 他从联合国给我寄来一张明信片。

example.en: He put up a poster advertising the circus.
example.cn: 他贴出了一张宣传马戏团的海报。

example.en: His ambition is to be a postman.
example.cn: 他的志向是成为一名邮递员。

example.en: Most of the flower pots were moved into the house by Mrs. Green last night.
example.cn: 昨晚大多数的花盆都被格林太太搬进了房子里。

example.en: They bought some fresh potatoes at the supermarket yesterday.
example.cn: 昨天他们在超市买了一些新鲜的土豆。

example.en: I bought two pounds of apples at the supermarket.
example.cn: 我在超市买了两磅苹果。

example.en: Will you change me five ten-pound notes?
example.cn: 你给我换5张10英镑的纸币好吗？

name: power
trans: n. 电源；能源；动力；电力；电力供应
词组 power station发电站；发电厂

example.en: They have built three nuclear power stations this year.
example.cn: 今年他们建造了3座核电站。

example.en: The powerful engine powered the car up the steep hill effortlessly.
example.cn: 强大的引擎驱动汽车轻松地爬上了陡峭的山坡。

example.en: Her voice was so powerful that it reached every corner of the concert hall.
example.cn: 她的声音如此响亮，以至于传到了音乐厅的每个角落。

name: practice
trans: 谚语 Practice makes perfect.熟能生巧。
点拨 practice是常考单词，所以学生一定要牢记practice后面跟动名词。

example.en: Only practice can achieve mastery.
example.cn: 只有实践才能达到精通。

name: praise
trans: n. & v.赞扬； 表扬； 称赞
词组 praise sb. for sth.为某事表扬某人

example.en: His good behaviour deserves praise.
example.cn: 他的好品行值得表扬。

example.en: I was praised for my progress last night. And my father was pleased with me, too.
example.cn: 昨晚我的进步受到表扬，我的父亲对我也很满意。

name: precious
trans: adj. 宝贵的， 珍贵的

example.en: Time is precious.
example.cn: 时间是宝贵的。

example.en: People cannot predict how things will pan out.
example.cn: 人们无法预料事情会有什么样的结果。

name: prefer
trans: v. 宁愿（选择）， 更喜欢， 喜欢······多于······
词组 prefer... to ...（比起······来）更喜欢······

example.en: I prefer running to swimming.
example.cn: 比起游泳，我更喜欢跑步。

name: prepare
trans: 词组 prepare for 准备

example.en: We are preparing for the party.
example.cn: 我们在为派对做准备。

name: present
trans: presentation n. 展示会；介绍会
词组 at present 现在，目前

example.cn: 在玛丽30周岁生日时，约翰给了她一个精美的礼物。

example.en: Mr. Smith is on holiday at present.
example.cn: 史密斯先生现在在休假。

example.en: He insists on being present.
example.cn: 他一定要出席。

example.en: To prove his point, Paul presented detailed evidence in his presentation.
example.cn: 为了证明自己的观点，保罗在介绍中展示了详细的证据。

name: president
trans: n. 总统；主席；校长；董事长

example.en: The president will give a speech on the morning of the National Day.
example.cn: 总统将在国庆节的上午发表讲话。

example.en: Please press this button.
example.cn: 请按这个按钮。

example.en: She closed her eyes and pretended to be asleep.
example.cn: 她闭上眼睛装睡。

example.en: What a pretty doll it is!
example.cn: 多漂亮的洋娃娃！

example.en: He did pretty well on his exam.
example.cn: 他考试考得相当不错。

name: prevent
trans: v. 防止，预防；阻止，阻挡，阻碍

example.en: How to prevent disease?
example.cn: 怎么预防疾病？

example.en: The heavy rain prevented us from going on our planned hike.
example.cn: 大雨阻止了我们原计划的徒步旅行。

example.en: Nowadays people complain that food prices are higher than before.
example.cn: 现在人们都抱怨食品价格比以前高了。

name: primary
trans: adj. 初等的，初级的；主要的；最重要的；基本的

example.en: She studies in a primary school.
example.cn: 她在上小学。

example.en: The primary goal of this project is to reduce environmental pollution.
example.cn: 该项目的主要目标是减少环境污染。

example.en: Print the word in italics.
example.cn: 用斜体印刷这个字。

example.en: The building over there is a prison.
example.cn: 那边的那幢建筑是一座监狱。

name: private
trans: adj. 私人的；私有的；个人的

example.en: Some young people are now rich enough to buy private cars.
example.cn: 现在有一些年轻人有能力买私家车。

example.en: Andy was surprised to know that his science project won the first prize.
example.cn: 得知自己的科学项目获得了一等奖，安迪感到十分惊讶。

name: probable
trans: adj. 很可能发生（或存在等）的；很可能的；大概的

example.cn: 很可能他把一切都告诉她了。

example.en: John probably told his father all about the matter.
example.cn: 约翰很可能把这一切都告诉了他父亲。

name: problem
trans: n. 棘手的问题，难题，困难；习题

example.en: I'm sure you will succeed in working out the problem unless you give up.
example.cn: 我相信你会成功解决这个问题，除非你放弃。

example.en: How fast does the computer process the data?
example.cn: 这台计算机处理数据有多快？

example.en: Learning is a process of trying and failing and trying and succeeding.
example.cn: 学习是一个尝试、失败、再尝试，最后成功的过程。

name: produce
trans: 谚语 花有重开日，人无再少年。

example.en: The new factory will produce goods for export.
example.cn: 这家新工厂将生产出口产品。

example.en: A plant may produce new flowers;man is young but once.
This plan was the product of many hours of careful thought.
example.cn: 这个计划是经过长时间仔细思考的产物。

example.en: After graduation,she became a professional accountant.
example.cn: 毕业以后，她成为一名专业会计。

name: programme
trans: n.节目（单）；项目；计划；方案；活动安排；【计】程序

example.en: I love the programme"Schools in students'eyes"made by Shanghai Educational TV Station.
example.cn: 我喜欢由上海教育电视台制作的《学生眼中的学校》这个节目。

example.en: The personal trainer will programme a customised workout plan for each client.
example.cn: 私人教练将为每位客户量身定制训练计划。

name: progress
trans: 词组 make progress取得进步

example.en: You can make much progress in your study if you work hard.
=You can't make much progress in your study unless you work hard.
example.cn: 如果努力学习，你就会取得很大进步。

name: project
trans: n. 工程；课程；作业；项目；规划

example.en: Linda did her project on Chinese traditional food far more carefully than I did.
example.cn: 琳达在做中国传统食物这个项目时，远远比我仔细。

name: promise
trans: n. 答应；承诺；保证；诺言

example.en: Not only did he make a promise, but also he kept it.
example.cn: 他不仅作出了许诺，而且履行了诺言。

example.en: The police promised to catch the kidnappers and rescue the actor.
example.cn: 警方承诺会抓获绑匪并救出这位演员。

example.en: He can pronounce this word correctly.
example.cn: 他能正确地念这个字。

name: properly
trans: adv. 正确地；恰当地，合适地

example.en: Healthy food is very important to help our minds work properly.
example.cn: 健康食品对我们大脑的正常运转非常重要。

name: protect
trans: 词组 protect… from保护…免受

example.en: It's necessary for us to know how to protect ourselves in an earthquake.
example.cn: 我们有必要知道在地震中如何保护自己。

example.en: She had an umbrella to protect her from the rain.
example.cn: 她带了把伞来遮雨。

name: proud
trans: 词组 be proud of为…而感到自豪

example.en: After winning the game, the team felt very proud of themselves.
example.cn: 赢得比赛后，队员们感到无比自豪。

example.en: It is unnecessary to prove your ability to anyone. Just focus on your own progress.
example.cn: 没必要向任何人证明你的能力，专注于自己的进步就好。

example.en: Most people are familiar with the proverb: Rome was not built in a day.
example.cn: 大多数人都熟悉这个谚语：罗马不是一天建成的。

example.en: To protect the environment, supermarkets don't provide free plastic bags for shoppers.
example.cn: 为了保护环境，超市不再为顾客提供免费塑料袋。

example.en: The organisation provides poor children with educational resources.
example.cn: 这个组织向贫困儿童提供教育资源。

name: public
trans: adj. 公共的，公众的，公立的

example.en: Mary's father rarely smokes in public places, does he?
example.cn: 玛丽的父亲很少在公共场所抽烟，是吗？

example.en: The museum is open to the public.
example.cn: 这家博物馆是对公众开放的。

example.en: By the age of ten, the little girl had published her first collection of poems. She's now very famous.
example.cn: 这个小女孩在10岁的时候已经出版了她的第一本诗集。她现在很出名。

example.en: Many old houses around our school will be pulled down next year and a large green area will appear.
example.cn: 明年我们学校周围许多旧房子要被拆除，将出现一片大型的绿化区域。

example.en: The main purpose of the charity project is to offer help to homeless people.
example.cn: 这个慈善项目的主要目的是帮助无家可归的人。

name: push
trans: v. &n.推动（人或物）；移动（身体部位）

example.en: Push your chair in gently.
example.cn: 轻轻地把你的椅子推进去。

example.en: The students were encouraged to push their hips back in downward dog pose.
example.cn: 学员们在做下犬式时被鼓励着推臀。

example.en: In its push for economic growth it has ignored projects that would improve living standards.
example.cn: 在努力追求经济增长的同时，它却忽视了那些能改善生活水平的项目。

name: put
trans: 词组 put on穿上；戴上；上演
词组 put up举起；挂起

example.en: One of their tasks is to put an ice radar in the station.
example.cn: 他们的任务之一是把冰雷达放在雷达站里。

example.en: Henry didn't put on his scarf before he left the office.
example.cn: 亨利在离开办公室之前没有戴上围巾。

example.en: In production, we demand not only quantity but also quality.
example.cn: 我们的产品不但要求数量而且要求质量。

example.en: It's a quarter to seven.
example.cn: 现在是6点45分。

example.en: The queen was sad.
example.cn: 皇后很伤心。

example.en: Well done! You have answered all the questions correctly.
example.cn: 干得好！你已正确回答了所有的问题。

name: quick
trans: adj. 快的；敏捷的；迅速的
quickly adv. 很快地；迅速地

example.en: Among the boys, Tom is the quickest to learn new things.
example.cn: 在男孩中，学习新事物学得最快的是汤姆。

example.en: When he heard a cry for help, he ran out as quickly as he could.
example.cn: 一听到呼救声，他就尽快跑了出来。

example.en: Online team-buying services are developing quickly in China, aren't they?
example.cn: 在中国，网上团购服务正在迅速发展，不是吗？

name: quiet
trans: 词组 keep quiet保持安静

example.en: I'm going to move somewhere quiet. It's too noisy in our neighbourhood.
example.cn: 我打算搬到一个安静的地方。我们的小区太吵了。

example.en: The patient lay on his bed quietly when the doctor came to examine him.
example.cn: 当医生来给这位病人检查时，他静静地躺在床上。

name: quite
trans: adv. 完全；十分；相当；非常

example.en: This arrangement is quite satisfactory, so far as I am concerned.
example.cn: 就我来说，这样的安排相当好。

example.en: We'll have a quiz at the end of class.
example.cn: 下课前我们将进行一次测试。

example.en: Are you going to race your horse at Newmarket next week?
example.cn: 你准备让你的马参加下周在纽马克特的赛马会吗？

example.en: Peter and Bill each say they came first in the race.
example.cn: 彼得和比尔都说自己跑了第一。

name: radio
trans: n. 无线电（广播）；收音机

example.en: Father bought her a stereo radio.
example.cn: 父亲给她买了台立体声收音机。

example.en: The railway is still under construction.
example.cn: 这条铁路仍在建设之中。

example.en: In fact, there isn't so much rain in the city as they think.
example.cn: 事实上，这座城市不像他们想的那样有这么多的雨水。

example.en: We will go to the Happy Valley tomorrow unless it rains.
example.cn: 如果明天不下雨，我们会去欢乐谷。

example.en: Most tropical areas have rainy and dry seasons.
example.cn: 大多数热带地区有雨季和旱季。

name: raise
trans: v. 举起，使升高，提升，增加；饲养，抚养；筹钱，筹集；提起
点拨 raise是常考单词，所以学生一定要比较raise与rise的用法区别：
点拨 raise是及物动词；rise是不及物动词。
点拨 例如：raise your hand举起你的手

example.en: The government plans to raise the living standard of citizens.
example.cn: 政府计划提高市民的生活水平。

example.en: It is not easy to raise three children on a small income.
example.cn: 靠微薄的收入抚养三个孩子并不容易。

example.en: The charity event successfully raised enough money to help the homeless.
example.cn: 这场慈善活动成功筹集到了足够的资金来帮助无家可归的人。

example.en: The government's decision on building a factory in the city centre has raised many questions among the local people.
example.cn: 政府决定在城市中心建造一家工厂，这在当地人中已经引发了许多质疑。

example.en: He raised his hat to me yesterday.
example.cn: 昨天他向我举帽致意。

name: rarely
trans: adv. 罕有； 很少； 不常

example.en: People in western countries rarely talk loudly in public, do they?
example.cn: 在西方国家，人们很少在公共场所大声说话，是吗？

example.en: They have been friends for years and have rarely argued.
example.cn: 他们成为朋友已经好几年了，很少发生争执。

name: rather
trans: adv. 相当， 颇； 宁可； 反而； 有点儿， 稍微

example.en: I'm feeling rather sleepy.
example.cn: 我感到十分困倦。

example.en: She was not angry, but rather disappointed by his actions.
example.cn: 她没有生气，而是对他的举动很失望。

example.en: I rather suspect that he is not telling the truth.
example.cn: 我有点儿怀疑他没说实话。

name: reach
trans: v. 到达； 增加到； 达到

example.en: My uncle will send me postcards and stamps after he reaches France.
example.cn: 我的叔叔到达法国后，会给我寄一些明信片和邮票。

example.en: He reached a high level of proficiency in playing the piano.
example.cn: 他在演奏钢琴方面达到了高水平的熟练程度。

example.en: It's easy to memorise the words if we know how to read them correctly.
example.cn: 如果我们知道如何正确地读出这些单词，就很容易记住它们了。

example.en: Tommy asked me if I was interested in reading science fiction.
example.cn: 汤米问我是否对读科幻小说感兴趣。

example.en: Jenny was reading the text of Lesson Three at 8:00 last night.
example.cn: 昨天晚上8点珍妮正在读第3课的课文。

example.en: Reading makes a full man.
example.cn: 读书长见识。

name: ready
trans: adj. 准备好的；准备完毕的；乐于
词组 be 为……作准备

example.en: He is ready for the trip.
example.cn: 他已准备好去旅行。

name: real
trans: adj. 真实的，确实的；真正的
really adv.真正地，确实；事实上
realize v.认识到；实现(=be aware of)

example.en: The real value of the book lies in its wonderful characterisation.
example.cn: 这本书真正的价值在于精彩的人物塑造。

name: realize
trans: v. 认识到，意识到；实现

example.en: If you want to realize your dream, study hard from now on.
example.cn: 如果你想实现自己的梦想，从现在开始就要努力学习。

name: really
trans: adv. 真正地，确实；事实上

example.en: It's really impossible for a child of five to take care of himself.
example.cn: 要5岁儿童自己照顾自己，这真的是不可能的。

example.en: That is the reason why we must go now.
example.cn: 那就是我们现在必须走的理由。

name: receive
trans: 点拨 receive是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：receive one's letter与hear from sb.意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 =I heard from my aunt the other day.

example.en: By the end of last month, Mrs. Lin had received many interesting comic strips created by the students.
example.cn: 到上月底，林老师收到了许多由学生创作的有趣的漫画。

example.en: It is better to give than to receive.
example.cn: 给予比索取更伟大。

example.en: I received my aunt's letter the other day.

name: recent
trans: adj. 近来的，最近的，新近的

example.en: There have been many changes in our school in recent years.
example.cn: 近几年，我们学校发生了许多变化。

example.en: Recently, we have all worked harder to improve ourselves in many ways.
example.cn: 最近，我们所有人都更加努力，在各个方面提升自己。

example.en: She had changed so much that I could hardly recognize her.
example.cn: 她的变化这么大，我简直认不出来了。

example.en: Several world records were broken by Bolt at the Olympics.
example.cn: 博尔特在奥运会上打破了多项世界纪录。

example.en: She has recorded some popular songs.
example.cn: 她录了一些通俗歌曲。

name: recycle
trans: v. 回收利用；使再循环

example.en: We should recycle garbage, not burn it.
example.cn: 我们应该回收利用垃圾，而不是焚烧。

example.en: He was wearing a white shirt and a red tie.
example.cn: 他穿着一件白衬衫，系了一条红领带。

example.en: I prefer red to blue.
example.cn: 比起蓝色，我更喜欢红色。

example.en: We have reduced the number of classes from eight to six.
example.cn: 我们已将班级数量由8个减少到6个。

example.en: The author does not give references.
example.cn: 作者没有注明参考（所引资料的）出处。

example.en: I don't know why he refused the job offer.
example.cn: 我不明白他为什么拒绝那份工作。

example.en: The proud lady refuses to accept any advice.
example.cn: 这位高傲的女士拒绝接受任何建议。

name: regular
trans: adj. 规则的；经常的；固定的

example.en: Regular exercise is an effective way to stay healthy and reduce stress.
example.cn: 规律运动是保持健康、缓解压力的有效方法。

example.en: She found it impossible to extricate herself from the relationship.
example.cn: 她发现自己不可能从这种关系中解脱出来。

example.en: Today we visited our relative.
example.cn: 今天我们探望了我们的亲戚。

name: relax
trans: v. （使）放松， 轻松； 休息
relaxed adj.放松的， 自在的

example.en: Sam needs to relax, so he is looking forward to a holiday.
example.cn: 萨姆需要放松，所以他期待着假期。

name: release
trans: v. & n.释放， 排放； 发行， 发表

example.en: It helps us release anxious thoughts.
example.cn: 它能帮助我们释放焦虑情绪。

example.en: The movie will be on release from Christmas.
example.cn: 影片将从圣诞节开始上映。

example.en: You can always rely on Jim, he won't fail you.
example.cn: 你可以永远依靠吉姆，他不会让你失望的。

name: remember
trans: 点拨 remember是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其习惯用法，及比较rememberdoing与remember to do的用法区别：
点拨 1) remember doing表示记得做过某事（已做）。
点拨 2) remember to do表示记住去做某件事（还没做）。

example.en: The famous singer died, but her sweet voice will be remembered for ever.
example.cn: 这位著名歌手去世了，但她甜美的声音将永远被铭记。

example.en: I remembered turning off the lights when I left the room.
Please remember to close the door when you go to bed.
He reminded me that I ought to do it at once.
example.cn: 他提醒我应该现在就去做这件事。

example.en: The house is in need of repair.
example.cn: 那幢房子需要整修。

example.en: The students can not only operate the machines with safety but also repair them.
example.cn: 学生们不仅能安全地操作这些机器，而且还能修理这些机器。

example.en: Though I repeated the phone number many times, the foreigner still couldn't write it down.
example.cn: 虽然我把电话号码重复了好多次，这个外国人还是不能把它写下来。

name: reply
trans: 词组 receive a reply 收到一条回复

example.en: He never replied to the letters.
example.cn: 他从来都不回信。

example.en: Silence is the best reply to calummination.
example.cn: 沉默是对诽谤的最有力回击。

name: report
trans: n. 报道；报告；成绩单；（新闻）报道；调查报告

example.en: She has given us a progress report on how the project is going.
example.cn: 她给我们作了关于项目进程的报告。

example.en: John reported the two robberies to the police just now.
example.cn: 刚刚约翰向警方报告了这两起抢劫案。

example.en: It is reported that two-thirds of the fruits in that supermarket are from Hainan Island.
example.cn: 据说，该超市三分之二的水果来自海南岛。

example.en: The reporter described the accident in detail.
example.cn: 记者详尽地描述了那起意外事件。

example.en: the People's Republic of China
example.cn: 中华人民共和国

name: require
trans: v. 需要；要求；依靠；依赖
requirement n. 所需的东西；必备的条件

example.en: All passengers are required to fasten their seat belts during takeoff.
example.cn: 所有乘客在起飞时都被要求系好安全带。

example.en: Learning a new language requires time and patience.
example.cn: 学习一门新语言需要时间和耐心。

name: research
trans: v. & n. 研究；调查；探讨；探索

example.en: The historical background to the play has been very carefully and thoroughly researched.
example.cn: 已对这个剧本的历史背景进行了细致全面的研究。

example.en: The latest research shows that regular exercise can improve mental health.
example.cn: 最新研究表明，定期锻炼可以改善心理健康。

example.en: This country is rich in natural resources.
example.cn: 该国自然资源丰富。

example.en: I respect him for his diligence.
example.cn: 我敬佩他的勤奋。

example.en: The Double Ninth Festival reminds us to respect the elderly.
example.cn: 重阳节提醒我们要尊重老人。

name: response
trans: respond v. 作出反应；回应

example.en: She has received a response from that college to her application.
example.cn: 她已经收到那所大学对她申请的答复。

name: responsibility
trans: n. 责任；负责；职责；责任心
responsible adj. 负责的；有责任的；可信任的

example.en: We need to take responsibility for looking after our own health.
example.cn: 我们必须对自己的健康负责。

name: responsible
trans: adj. 负责的；有责任的；可信任的
词组 be responsible for 对…负责任

example.en: Being responsible means taking ownership of your mistakes and learning from them.
example.cn: 有责任感意味着要对自己的错误负责，并从中吸取教训。

name: rest
trans: n. 休息；休息时间；剩余部分；其余的人（物）

example.en: The doctor advised him to take a rest for a few days.
example.cn: 医生建议他休息几天。

example.en: The rest of us were allowed to go home.
example.cn: 我们中的其他人被允许回家。

example.en: You need to rest from your labour. You look very tired.
example.cn: 你看上去很疲劳，需要放下工作休息一下。

example.en: I shall leave the restaurant unless the waiter comes soon.
=I shall leave the restaurant if the waiter doesn't come soon.
example.cn: 除非服务员马上来，否则我就离开饭店。

name: result
trans: 词组 result in造成；导致

example.en: Remember, the harder you work, the more good results you will get.
example.cn: 记住，你越努力工作，你越会得到好的结果。

example.en: The retired workers receive money from the government till they die.
example.cn: 退休工人从政府那里领取养老金直到去世为止。

name: return
trans: v. & n. 回来； 返回； 归还； 偿还
词组 in return作为回报
点拨 return是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: return与 come back意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = The girl didn't fall asleep until her mother came back last night.

example.en: He returned the books to the library yesterday.
example.cn: 他昨天把书还给了图书馆。

example.en: After some time, small plants begin to grow. Animals return soon after the plants return.
The return of warm weather signals the arrival of spring.
example.cn: 温暖天气的回归预示着春天的到来。

example.en: The girl didn't fall asleep until her mother returned last night.

name: reuse
trans: v. 再利用； 重复使用
reusable adj.可重复使用的；可再次使用的

example.en: The same water was reused after chemical treatment.
example.cn: 原来的水经过化学处理之后被再度利用。

example.en: The college published a drama review.
example.cn: 学院出版了一份戏剧评论刊物。

example.en: Have you reviewed what we covered in class yesterday?
example.cn: 昨天我们课堂上讲的东西你们复习了吗？

name: reward
trans: n. 奖励； 奖赏； 报酬； 报答， 回报
v.奖励； 奖赏； 给······以报酬

example.en: He was given the job as a reward for running a successful leadership bid.
example.cn: 因为成功组织了领导职位竞选活动，他得到了这份工作。

example.en: Make the extra effort to impress the buyer and you will be rewarded with a quicker sale.
example.cn: 多用心去打动顾客，货物就会更快售出。

example.en: The southerners prefer rice and the northerners prefer food made from flour.
example.cn: 南方人比较喜欢吃米饭，北方人爱吃面食。

name: rich
trans: adj. 富裕的，有钱的；味道浓的；重油的；丰富的

example.en: A lot of people think that happiness is about being rich, but I disagree.
example.cn: 很多人认为幸福就是富有，但我不同意。

name: rid
trans: 词组 get rid of摆脱

example.en: It's not easy to rid oneself of a habit.
example.cn: 要改掉一个人的习惯是不容易的。

name: ride
trans: v. 骑（马、自行车等）；驾驶
n.乘车旅行；（乘车或骑车的）短途旅程

example.en: Now my father rides his bike to work every day instead of driving.
example.cn: 现在我的父亲每天骑自行车去上班而不是开车去。

example.en: Since it was raining heavily, John offered to give me a ride to work.
example.cn: 由于下大雨，约翰主动提出载我去上班。

name: right
trans: adj. 对的，正确的；恰当的；右边的
adv.正确地；恰恰；向右，在右边

example.en: I'll try to do whatever is right.
example.cn: 只要是正当的事，我都尽力去做。

example.en: It's quite late. We'd better go home by taxi right now.
example.cn: 太晚了，我们最好现在打车回家。

example.en: It's on your right.
example.cn: 它在你右边。

name: ring
trans: v. （钟、铃等）响；摇铃；打电话；回响

example.en: Let's hurry up. The electric bell is ringing.
example.cn: 我们快点。电铃响了。

example.en: Her laughter rang out in the room.
example.cn: 她的笑声在房间里回荡。

example.en: I will give you a ring tonight.
example.cn: 今天晚上我给你打电话。

name: rise
trans: v. 上升，上涨；升高；起立

example.en: The river is rising after the rain.
example.cn: 雨后河水涨了起来。

example.en: These factories are trying their best not to pollute the river any longer.
example.cn: 这些工厂正在尽力不再污染河流。

name: road
trans: 谚语 自信是走向成功的第一步。

example.en: We should drive carefully on the road.
example.cn: 在道路上我们应该小心驾驶。

example.en: Confidence in yourself is the first step on the road to success.
You've made a fire fit to roast an ox.
example.cn: 你生的火很旺，足以烤一头牛了。

example.en: She worked like a robot.
example.cn: 她工作起来如同一个机器人。

name: rock
trans: 词组 rock climbing 攀岩

example.en: Astronauts have brought back specimens of rock from the moon.
example.cn: 宇航员从月球带回了岩石标本。

example.en: She prefers rock music to classical.
example.cn: 比起古典乐，她更喜欢摇滚乐。

example.en: The boat rocked gently on the lake.
example.cn: 小船在湖面上轻轻摇晃。

example.en: This space rocket carries two satellites.
example.cn: 这枚宇宙火箭搭载了两颗卫星。

example.en: Three boys were unhappy because they got no roles to play last week.
example.cn: 三个男孩很不开心，因为上周他们没有分到表演角色。

name: room
trans: 词组 living room (=sitting room)客厅；起居室

example.en: This is a three-metre-high room.
example.cn: 这是一个3米高的房间。

example.en: There is no room for your piano in your room.
example.cn: 你房间里没地方放钢琴了。

example.en: The roots of this plant go deep.
example.cn: 这种植物的根扎得很深。

example.en: Money is the root of all evil.
example.cn: 金钱是万恶之源。

example.en: Maggie asked me to cut the rope to a length of two metres.
example.cn: 麦琪让我把绳子剪到两米长。

example.en: He picked her a rose.
example.cn: 他给她采了一朵玫瑰花。

name: rough
trans: adj. 粗糙的；不平的；风浪急的；令人不舒服的

example.en: It's just a very rough translation.
example.cn: 这只是一篇非常粗糙的翻译。

example.en: The child had a round face.
example.cn: 那孩子是圆脸。

example.en: A crowd soon gathered round.
example.cn: 很快围拢了一群人。

example.en: They were sitting round the kitchen table.
example.cn: 他们正围坐在餐桌旁。

example.en: A row of children are standing in front of a row of chairs.
example.cn: 一排小孩站在一排椅子前。

example.en: There is a pile of rubbish in the corner of the building.
example.cn: 在大楼的角落有一堆垃圾。

example.en: It's very rude of her to leave without telling us.
example.cn: 她不向我们打声招呼就走了，这是非常无礼的。

example.en: You should obey the traffic rules.
example.cn: 你应该遵守交通规则。

example.en: The king rules that country.
example.cn: 国王统治着那个国家。

name: run
trans: 词组 run away 逃跑
词组 run out of用完，耗尽

example.en: Rabbits run fast.
example.cn: 兔子跑得快。

example.en: He runs a company.
example.cn: 他经营一家公司。

example.en: After a six-mile run, Jackie returns home for a substantial breakfast.
example.cn: 跑了6英里之后，杰姬回家吃一顿丰盛的早餐。

name: rush
trans: 词组 rush down 冲下来，冲过去

example.en: The students rushed into the classroom as soon as the bell rang.
example.cn: 铃声一响，学生就奔跑进教室。

example.en: He left the house in a rush.
example.cn: 他匆匆忙忙离开了家。

name: sad
trans: sadly adv.悲哀地；忧愁地；令人遗憾地；不幸地

example.en: We are very sad and angry to hear that our football team suffered a defeat again.
example.cn: 听到我们的足球队又输球了，我们非常难过，非常生气。

name: sadly
trans: adv. 悲哀地；忧愁地；令人遗憾地；不幸地

example.en: Sadly, after eight years of marriage they had grown apart.
example.cn: 不幸的是，结婚8年后，他们的感情日渐淡漠了。

example.en: Friends are the people you feel safe because you know they care about you.
example.cn: 朋友就是那些能让你有安全感的人，因为你知道他们关心你。

example.en: Only her husband knows the number to open the safe.
example.cn: 只有她丈夫知道打开保险柜的密码。

example.en: The plane landed safely at last after flying in the storm for about one hour.
example.cn: 这架飞机在风暴中大约飞行了一个小时以后，最终安全着陆。

example.en: All pilots are responsible for their passengers' safety.
example.cn: 所有飞行员都应对乘客的安全负责。

example.en: He had a steak and a green salad.
example.cn: 他要了一块牛排和一份生菜色拉。

example.en: He was engaged at a salary of $1,000 a month.
example.cn: 他以月薪1000美元受聘。

example.en: Our school organized a charity sale for the homeless in that area.
example.cn: 我们学校在该地区为无家可归者组织了一场慈善义卖。

example.en: Salt occurs naturally in sea water.
example.cn: 盐天然存在于海水中。

example.en: The dish is too salty.
example.cn: 这道菜太咸了。

name: same
trans: adj. 同样的，一样的；同一的
词组 at the same time 同时

example.en: James, Catherine and I have been friends since we were at the same primary school.
example.cn: 自从我和詹姆斯还有凯瑟琳在同一所小学读书起，我们就一直是朋友。

example.en: Girls were given the same chance as boys to apply for the job by the manager.
example.cn: 经理给了女孩和男孩一样的机会去申请那份工作。

example.en: —The same to you.
To make a ham sandwich, you put a slice of ham between two slices of bread.
example.cn: 把一片火腿夹在两片面包之间就做成了火腿三明治。

name: satisfied
trans: satisfy v. 使满意；使满足
satisfying adj. 令人满意的；令人满足的
词组 be satisfied with 对…感到满意

example.en: When she had finished her meal, she gave a satisfied smile.
example.cn: 吃完饭后，她露出了满意的笑容。

name: satisfying
trans: adj. 令人满意的；令人满足的

example.en: It's very satisfying to see so many of you here.
example.cn: 在这里见到大家，我感到非常满意。

example.en: He went abroad last Saturday.
example.cn: 他上星期六出国了。

name: sauce
trans: 词组 soy sauce(=soya sauce)酱油

example.en: The sauce tastes too sweet.
example.cn: 这酱汁味道太甜。

name: save
trans: v. 救，挽救；节省；节约；保存
词组 save one's life挽救某人的生命

example.en: Although the doctors did everything they could to save the sick boy, they failed at last.
example.cn: 虽然医生们尽力挽救这个生病的孩子，但最终还是失败了。

example.en: A stitch in time saves nine.
example.cn: 小洞不补，大洞吃苦。

example.en: “There's still a long way to go before you succeed,” the teacher said to the class.
example.cn: 老师对全班学生说：“在你们成功之前还有很长的路要走。”

example.en: Last but not least, at the end of the interview, don't forget to thank the interviewer and say goodbye.
example.cn: 最后但同样重要的是，在面试结束时，别忘了感谢面试官并说再见。

name: saying
trans: n. 谚语，俗语；格言；警句

example.en: “There's no smoke without fire”, as the saying goes.
example.cn: 常言道：“无风不起浪。”

name: schedule
trans: n. 时间表；节目表；工作计划；日程安排

example.en: Because of her busy schedule, it is impossible for her to spend much time travelling.
example.cn: 由于她的日程安排很紧，她不可能花很多时间旅行。

example.en: A presidential election was scheduled for last December.
example.cn: 总统大选原定去年12月举行。

example.en: —John was seriously injured in the school bus accident.
Though he is only eight years old, he knows more about science than his father.
example.cn: 虽然只有8岁，但他比他父亲更了解科学。

example.en: Mr. Ren, a Chinese scientist, began to study global climate change more than a decade ago.
example.cn: 中国科学家任先生在10多年前就开始研究全球气候变化。

example.en: Nick didn't do very well in the final exam, but his scores are better than last year's.
example.cn: 虽然尼克期末考试考得不是很好，但他的分数比去年要好。

example.en: He scored the winning goal in the fourth round of the football matches.
example.cn: 他在足球比赛的第4轮中打进了制胜一球。

example.en: You can see him on the TV screen quite often.
example.cn: 你可以经常在电视屏幕上见到他。

example.en: We generally go to the sea for our holidays.
example.cn: 我们通常去海边度假。

example.en: There's an excellent seafood restaurant near here.
example.cn: 离这儿不远有一家非常不错的海鲜餐馆。

name: search
trans: v. & n.搜寻；搜查；搜索；查找
词组 search for搜寻；搜查

example.en: We searched here and there, but could not find her.
example.cn: 我们到处找她，但还是找不到。

example.en: —To read the news and search for the information they need.
The lost book came to light after a long search.
example.cn: 经过长时间的寻找，那本遗失的书得以重见天日。

example.en: Let's go to the seaside at the weekend!
example.cn: 周末我们去海滨吧！

example.en: The seasons change, independent of anyone's wishes.
example.cn: 四季变化不受任何人约束。

example.en: The teacher made me move my seat to the front of the classroom.
example.cn: 老师把我的座位换到了教室的前面。

example.en: Our team gets a second.
example.cn: 我们队得了第二名。

example.en: The average flow of the river is 200 cubic metres per second.
example.cn: 这条河平均流量为每秒200立方米。

example.en: I finished in the second place in the 800-metre race, just behind Jack.
example.cn: 我在800米赛跑中获得第2名，仅次于杰克。

example.en: And second, we shouldn't substitute our personal feeling for policies.
example.cn: 其次，我们不应该拿个人感情代替政策。

example.en: In secondary school, children get more advanced knowledge.
example.cn: 在中学，孩子获得更深一些的知识。

example.en: She made no secret of her greed.
example.cn: 她毫不掩饰自己的贪婪。

example.en: He asked that the matter should be kept secret.
example.cn: 他要求对这件事保秘。

example.en: She is secretary to the master.
example.cn: 她是校长的秘书。

example.en: The chapter falls into three sections.
example.cn: 这一章共分3节。

example.en: The events were faithfully recorded in a section of the local museum's files.
example.cn: 这些事件被如实记录在当地博物馆的一份档案卷宗里。

name: see
trans: v. 看见，看到；领会，理解；拜访，会见；理会
谚语 Seeing is believing.眼见为实。

example.en: The light is on. I see them watching a slide show.
example.cn: 灯亮着。我看见他们正在看幻灯片。

example.en: The farmers are scattering seed.
example.cn: 农夫们在播种。

example.en: The baby seems to be asleep.
example.cn: 那婴儿好像是睡着了。

example.en: I don't like western food. I seldom eat it unless I go to MacDonald with my daughter.
example.cn: 我不喜欢吃西餐。我很少吃，除非与我的女儿去麦当劳。

example.en: Kitty seldom read detective stories before going to school, did she?
example.cn: 上学前姬蒂很少读侦探故事，是吗？

example.en: Which place in the world would you select as your perfect home?
example.cn: 你会选择世界上哪个地方作为你最理想的安家之地呢？

example.en: The book written by that writer didn't sell well last year.
example.cn: 那位作家写的这本书，去年销售情况不好。

name: send
trans: v. 打发；派遣；送；邮寄；发送

example.en: China first sent scientists to Antarctica in 1980.
example.cn: 中国在1980年首次派出科学家到南极。

name: senior
trans: adj. 年长的；高年级的；高级的

example.en: Honours were automatically awarded to senior officials just because they were senior.
example.cn: 荣誉顺理成章地授予资深官员，就因为他们资格老。

example.en: I haven't got a very good sense of direction, so I easily get lost.
example.cn: 我的方向感很差，因此我容易迷路。

example.en: The dog sensed danger and started barking loudly.
example.cn: 狗意识到危险，开始狂叫。

example.en: Please make a whole sentence when you answer the question.
example.cn: 回答问题时请说完整的句子。

example.en: Our school will begin on September 1.
example.cn: 我们学校将在9月1 日开学。

name: serious
trans: adj. 严肃的；严重的；认真的
seriously adv.严肃地；严重地；认真地

example.en: If you have a serious disease, such as heart disease, you'd better not travel there.
example.cn: 如果你有严重的疾病，如心脏疾病，你最好不要去那里。

name: seriously
trans: adv. 严肃地；严重地；认真地

example.en: The 70-year-old man was seriously ill and died a few months later.
example.cn: 那个70岁的男子患了重病，几个月后就去世了。

example.en: Our teacher asked us to take the exam seriously and avoid careless mistakes.
example.cn: 老师要求我们认真对待考试，避免出现粗心错误。

name: serve
trans: v. 招待（顾客等）；为⋯⋯服务

example.en: The waiter did his best to serve the customers politely and promptly.
example.cn: 那位服务员尽量礼貌及时地招待顾客。

example.en: Peter has served the company for 25 years, first as office boy and finally as sales manager.
example.cn: 彼得在这家公司服务了25年，开始是办公室工作人员，最后成为销售经理。

example.en: The customers are pleased with the service of the restaurant.
example.cn: 顾客对这家餐厅的服务很满意。

name: set
trans: v. 释放；安置，摆放；树立（榜样）；创造（纪录）
n.摄影场；一套；电视机；收音机
词组 set off出发；动身；启程
词组 set out动身，出发；着手做
词组 set up建立；建造；创立

example.en: He set an example of wholehearted service to the people.
example.cn: 他树立了全心全意为人民服务的榜样。

example.en: The director was impressed with the details of the set.
example.cn: 导演对场景的细节印象深刻。

example.en: The meeting will take place in the set conference room.
example.cn: 会议将在指定的会议室举行。

example.en: Both sides are looking for ways to settle their differences.
example.cn: 双方都在寻求消除分歧的方法。

example.en: Dr. Hu has collected several proofs to show the conclusion is correct.
example.cn: 胡博士收集了若干证据，以证明这个结论是正确的。

name: shake
trans: v. 握（手）；摇（头）；使震动；抖动
词组 shake hands with与⋯⋯握手

example.en: Shaking hands is a traditional way to greet each other in many places.
example.cn: 在许多地方握手是一种传统的问候方式。

name: shall
trans: aux. v.& modal v.（同I和we连用，表示将来）将要；会；

example.en: Shall I get the key to the bike?
example.cn: 我去拿自行车钥匙好吗？

name: shame
trans: n. 令人遗憾的事；令人惋惜的事；羞愧

example.en: What a shame you couldn't attend the graduation ceremony!
example.cn: 你不能参加毕业典礼，太可惜了！

example.en: She felt a deep sense of shame.
example.cn: 她深感羞愧。

example.en: I keep practising yoga after work because it helps me keep in good shape.
example.cn: 我下班后坚持练习瑜伽，因为它有助于我保持良好的身材。

example.en: The artist shaped the metal into a delicate piece of jewellery.
example.cn: 艺术家将金属塑造成一件精致的珠宝。

example.en: Ideas are always shared by my students in class.
example.cn: 在课堂上，学生总是分享各自的想法。

example.en: The old man used to raise many sheep to make a living in the west of China.
example.cn: 老人过去常常靠养羊在中国的西部谋生。

example.en: You may choose any of the toys on the shelf. But only one for each.
example.cn: 你们可以选择架子上的任何玩具。但每人只能拿一个。

example.en: —The sun shines brightly.Why not go out for a walk in the Zhongshan Park?
Are you going to America by plane or by ship the day after tomorrow?
example.cn: 后天你去美国是乘飞机还是坐船？

example.en: Do you know the man wearing a white shirt?
example.cn: 你认识那个穿白衬衫的人吗？

example.en: You don't mind if I take my shoes off,do you?
example.cn: 你不介意我把鞋子脱了，是吧？

example.en: It's not available in the shops.
example.cn: 商店里都没货。

example.en: He always shopped at that shop.
example.cn: 他总在那家商店购物。

name: short
trans: 词组 in short总之；简言之

example.en: How could you do it in such a short period of time?
example.cn: 你是怎么在如此短的时间里做到的？

example.en: Sometimes I am not as brave as I should be.
example.cn: 有时我表现得不够勇敢。

example.en: We should not ask others to do what we can't do ourselves.
example.cn: 我们不应该要求别人做一些我们自己也做不到的事情。

name: shout
trans: v. & n.喊；高声呼喊；大声说；叫
词组 shout at大声喊叫

example.en: Don't shout at me!
example.cn: 不要对我大声叫喊！

example.en: The decision was greeted with shouts of protest from the crowd.
example.cn: 这项决定遭到了大众的大声抗议。

name: show
trans: v.给⋯⋯看，出示；显示；告知；表明
词组 show sb. around带某人参观

example.en: My parents showed me some old pictures that brought back sweet memories.
example.cn: 我的父母给我看了一些能唤起我甜蜜记忆的老照片。

example.en: Charlie can't go with us because he is showing a professor around our company.
example.cn: 查利不能和我们一起走，因为他正陪同一位教授参观我们公司。

example.en: She didn't go to see the dolphin show with us because she had seen it already.
example.cn: 她不和我们一起去看海豚表演，因为她已经看过了。

example.en: She took two showers a day.
example.cn: 她每天洗两次澡。

name: shut
trans: 词组 shut up 住口

example.en: Lucy shut her eyes.
example.cn: 露西闭上了眼睛。

example.en: The store was shut when we arrived.
example.cn: 我们到的时候商店关门了。

example.en: At first he was a little shy in class, but now he acts more naturally.
example.cn: 起初他在班里有点害羞，不过现在表现自然多了。

name: sick
trans: adj. 有病的，患病的；（想）呕吐的，恶心的

example.en: On the twelfth day, the sick boy came to life.
example.cn: 在第12天，患病的男孩活过来了。

name: side
trans: 词组 on one's side在某人一边

example.en: The students have put some flowers on either side of the corridor and hung some nice pictures on the wall.
example.cn: 学生们在走廊的两边摆了一些花，在墙上挂了一些漂亮的图片。

example.en: With a two-screen phone, you can watch movies on one side and check emails on the other.
example.cn: 有了双屏手机，你可以在一边看电影，另一边查看电子邮件。

example.en: both sides of the road
example.cn: 路的两边 either side of the road 路的两边

example.en: all sides of the square
example.cn: 广场的四周 every 广场的每一边

example.en: My sight is failing.
example.cn: 我的视力在下降。

example.en: Did you do any sightseeing there?
example.cn: 在那儿你游览观光了没？

name: sign
trans: n. 符号，标记；标牌，指示牌

example.en: Many people choose to have a baby in the year of the dragon because dragon is a sign of power and status.
example.cn: 很多人选择在龙年生孩子，因为龙是权力和地位的象征。

example.en: He persuaded her to sign the document.
example.cn: 他说服她在文件上签字。

example.en: A red lamp is often a danger signal.
example.cn: 红灯常常是危险的信号。

example.en: The alarm system signaled an intruder in the building.
example.cn: 警报系统示意大楼里有入侵者。

name: silent
trans: adj. 静的；无声的；不说话的；沉默的

example.en: He generally keeps silent at a meeting.
example.cn: 他通常在会上保持沉默。

trans: successful adj.达到目的的；有成效的；获得成功的

example.cn: 除非你付出努力并保持专注，否则就不会成功。

example.cn: 我认为我的朋友会在篮球赛中获胜。

example.cn: 那位年轻演员的处女秀取得了巨大成功。

example.en: Failure is the mother of success.
example.cn: 失败乃成功之母。

name: successful

name: sunny
