trans: n. （乐曲等的）名称， 标题， 题目

example.en: The title of the article is Aliens.
example.cn: 这篇文章的标题是《外星人》。

name: to
trans: 点拨 to是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其基本用法，及比较与on,in,at的用法区别：
点拨 to指的是一个范围和另一个范围之间隔了段距离，表示“在某范围之外”，强调两者是远离关系。
点拨 on指的是一个范围紧挨着另一个范围，表示“两地接壤”，强调两者为相邻关系。
点拨 in指的是在某范围之内，没有精确的地址。
点拨 at指在某一具体的地点，通常用于有精确的地址。

example.en: It is time to go to school.= It is time for school.
example.cn: 到上学的时间了。

example.en: Japan is to the east of China.
example.cn: 日本位于中国的东边。

name: today
trans: adv. & n.今天； 现在， 当前

example.en: The weather is pleasant today.
example.cn: 今天天气令人愉快。

example.en: Is there any news in today's newspaper?
example.cn: 今天的报纸上有什么新闻？

example.en: What a nice day! Let's go for a picnic on the beach together.
example.cn: 天气真不错啊！我们一起去沙滩上野餐吧。

example.en: Sally, together with some other students, is always ready to help others.
example.cn: 莎莉，连同一些其他学生，总是乐于帮助别人。

example.en: She spread some tomato paste on the fried fish.
example.cn: 她在炸好的鱼上涂了一些番茄酱。

example.en: Jane doesn't want to see the film War and Peace with her friend tomorrow.
example.cn: 简明天不想和她的朋友一起去看电影《战争与和平》。

example.en: Let me look carefully at tomorrow's arrangements.
example.cn: 让我仔细看一下明天的安排。

example.en: Tom asked me if I was going to see the film tonight.
example.cn: 汤姆问我今晚是否要去看电影。 Tonight is the opening night of the opera.今晚是这部歌剧的首演之夜。

name: too
trans: adv. 也；还；又；太， 过分； 很， 非常
词组 too ... to太⋯⋯以至不能
点拨 too是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其基本用法，及比较与either,also,as well的用法区别。这四个词都是副词，都含有“也”的意思，可是它们的具体用法却有比较明显的区别。
点拨 too表示“也”时，一般用在肯定句中，放在句末，前面通常用逗号。
点拨 either表示“也”时，一般只用于否定句中，放在句末，前面通常用逗号。
点拨 also经常放在句中，位于行为动词之前；位于系动词、助动词或情态动词之后。
点拨 as well的用法和too一样，通常放在句末，但它前面通常不用逗号。

example.en: It's not safe for teenagers to give out too much information about themselves on the internet.
example.cn: 青少年在互联网上提供太多有关自己的信息，这是不安全的。

example.en: Jim likes red. I like red,too.
example.cn: 吉姆喜欢红色，我也喜欢。

example.en: The gardener's tools are kept in the shed.
example.cn: 花匠的工具放在小屋里。

example.en: It is necessary for everyone to brush his teeth after each meal.
example.cn: 对每个人来说，餐后刷牙是必要的。

example.en: If you don't clean your teeth regularly, you will get toothache.
= Unless you clean your teeth regularly, you will get toothache.
example.cn: 如果不定期清理牙齿，你会牙痛的。

example.en: On the top of the building, tourists can enjoy a nice view of the city.
example.cn: 在大楼的顶层，游客可以欣赏城市的美景。

example.en: Even the top students in our class can't work out this problem, so it must be very difficult.
example.cn: 甚至连我们班上的尖子生也答不出这个问题，所以一定很难。

example.en: Let's change the topic!
example.cn: 我们换个话题吧！

name: touch
trans: touching adj.令人同情的；感人的
词组 keep in touch(with)（与⋯⋯）保持联系

example.en: When the baby touched the hot pot, he was aware of the danger.
example.cn: 宝宝碰到热锅时，意识到了危险。

example.en: The blind man relied on his sense of touch to navigate through the unfamiliar room.
example.cn: 这个盲人靠触觉在陌生的房间里寻找方向。

name: tour
trans: n. &v.参观；观光；旅行；旅游；巡回演出

example.en: Shall we take a tour to the Summer Palace, Mrs.White?
example.cn: 怀特太太，我们去颐和园游览好吗？

example.en: The band plans to tour Asia this summer to promote their new album.
example.cn: 这个乐队打算今年夏天在亚洲巡回演出，以推广他们的新专辑。

example.en: Tourists enjoy swimming in the sea at the beautiful beaches in Bangkok.
example.cn: 在曼谷美丽的海滩，游客享受着在海中游泳的乐趣。

example.en: She walked towards the door.
example.cn: 她向门口走去。

name: tower
trans: v.高于，超过（附近的人或物）

example.en: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower has attracted tens of millions of visitors since 1995.
example.cn: 自1995年以来，东方明珠电视塔已吸引了数千万名游客。

example.en: The ancient oak tree towers above the rest of the forest.
example.cn: 这棵古老的橡树比森林里其他树都高。

example.en: We went to look around the town.
example.cn: 我们去参观了这个小镇。

example.en: —Shall I buy this toy for little David?
Countries in the world differ in historical tradition.
example.cn: 世界各国在历史传统上各有不同。

example.en: Some Western people have traditional turkeys for Christmas dinner.
example.cn: 一些西方人会在圣诞晚餐时享用传统的火鸡。

example.en: We should obey traffic rules.
example.cn: 我们应该遵守交通规则。

example.en: It is cheaper to travel by train than by air.
example.cn: 乘火车旅游比乘飞机便宜。

example.en: Has the train from Xizang arrived? I'm looking forward to meeting my old friends.
example.cn: 从西藏来的火车到了吗？我期待着见到我的老朋友们。

example.en: He is training for the astronaut.
example.cn: 他为成为宇航员正在接受培训。

example.en: The students were asked to translate this text into English yesterday.
example.cn: 学生昨天被要求把这篇文章翻译成英文。

name: transport
trans: n.运输；输送；运送；运输机器；交通车辆；旅行方式

example.en: A helicopter was used to transport the wounded.
example.cn: 一架直升飞机被用来运送伤员。

example.en: The extra money could be spent on improving public transport.
example.cn: 多余的资金可以用于改善公共交通。

name: transportation
trans: n. 运输；交通；交通工具

example.en: The company will provide transportation.
example.cn: 公司会提供交通工具。

example.en: Travel broadens the mind.
example.cn: 旅行使人心胸开阔。

example.en: Most people think that travelling abroad can enrich one's knowledge.
example.cn: 大多数人认为，出国旅游可以丰富自己的知识。

example.en: I would rather travel by train than by plane.
example.cn: 我宁愿乘火车也不愿乘飞机旅行。

example.en: How often do the students in our school plant trees?
example.cn: 我们学校的学生多久种一次树？

name: trick
trans: n. 恶作剧； 诡计， 花招； 戏法； 把戏

example.en: He played a dirty trick on me by refusing to do what he had promised.
example.cn: 他对我耍了个伎俩，拒绝做他所许诺的事。

name: trip
trans: n. （尤指短程往返的）旅行；旅程；旅游； 出行

example.en: We will have a one-week family trip to Harbin in the coming February.
example.cn: 在即将到来的二月，我们将有一次为期一周的家庭之旅去哈尔滨。

name: trouble
trans: n. 问题； 烦恼； 麻烦； 困难
词组 in trouble处于困境中

example.en: I wonder how I can deal with the trouble.=I wonder how to deal with the trouble.
example.cn: 我想知道怎样解决这个麻烦。

example.en: Losing a little money doesn't trouble me.
example.cn: 损失一点钱，我并不在意。

name: trousers
trans: 点拨 trousers是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道: trousers,glasses,jeans,pants,scissors,shoes,socks等词多以复数形式出现，后接复数动词；但以上这类名词前如用了a pair of，后面动词的单复数则取决于pair这一单词本身在句中的单复数形式。

example.en: I'm afraid this pair of trousers is too small. Would you please show me another pair?
example.cn: 恐怕这条裤子太小了。请您另外拿一条给我看看好吗？

example.en: He has been driving a truck for years and never had an accident.
example.cn: 他开了好几年卡车，从没出过岔子。

name: true
trans: adj. 真的；真实的；正确的
truly adv. 确实地；真诚地
truth n. 真理；真相，实际情况；实情；事实

example.en: The golden fish said to the fisherman,"All your wishes will come true."
example.cn: 金鱼对渔夫说：“你所有的愿望都会成真。”

example.en: There's a feeling of warmth and trust here.
example.cn: 这里有一种温暖和信任的感觉。

example.en: Ben didn't trust anyone to look after his pets properly.
example.cn: 本不相信有人能照看好他的宠物。

name: truth
trans: n. 真理；真相，实际情况；实情；事实

example.en: The police will try to find out the truth of the traffic accident.
example.cn: 警方将试图查明这起交通事故的真相。

example.en: Danny opened his heart to Mrs. Morgan and told her the truth.
example.cn: 丹尼向摩根夫人敞开心扉，告诉她真相。

name: try
trans: 词组 try doing sth. 尝试某事
词组 try to do sth. 努力去做某事
词组 try on 试穿
词组 try one's best 竭尽所能

example.en: Try to think how you will feel if you are hurt by others' unfriendly behaviours.
example.cn: 如果你被别人不友好的行为伤害，试着想想你会有怎么样的感受。

example.en: Rose still failed in the examinations, though she tried her best.
example.cn: 尽管露丝尽力了，她考试还是不及格。

example.en: Have another try!
example.cn: 再试一试！

example.en: This Tuesday is Earth Day.
example.cn: 本周二是世界地球日。

example.en: Many people eat turkey for Thanksgiving Day.
example.cn: 许多人在感恩节吃火鸡。

name: turn
trans: v. 旋转；翻转；转弯；转变；变得
词组 turn down 把音量）调低 高
词组 turn off关掉（电灯、电视、收音机等）
词组 turn on开，旋开（电灯、电视、收音机等）
词组 turn out结果是；证明是
词组 turn over翻（车）；翻（页）；翻身
词组 take turns轮流；依次

example.en: Leaves turn yellow in autumn.
example.cn: 秋天树叶变黄了。

example.en: Would you turn down the radio a bit? We are making a plan for the coming term.
example.cn: 你把收音机音量调低一点好吗？我们正在为即将到来的学期做一项计划。

example.en: When you are in trouble, you can always turn to your friends for help.
example.cn: 当你遇到麻烦时，总是可以向朋友们求助。

example.en: It's your turn.
example.cn: 轮到你了。

example.en: Our school newspaper is published twice a month.
example.cn: 我们学校的报纸每月出版两次。

example.en: Unemployment here is twice the national average.
example.cn: 这儿的失业率是全国平均数的两倍。

example.en: He has a twin brother.
example.cn: 他有一个孪生兄弟。

example.en: I love this type of book.
example.cn: 我喜欢这类书籍。

example.en: Could you type this letter for me?
example.cn: 你能为我打这封信吗？

example.en: The weather in London is changeable, so you should take an umbrella with you.
example.cn: 伦敦的天气多变，所以要随身带把伞。

example.en: My uncle began to learn Chinese painting in his forties.
example.cn: 我叔叔在40多岁时开始学画中国画。

example.en: He took a deep breath before he went under.
example.cn: 他下去之前，深深地吸了口气。

example.en: There are special tickets for children under the age of 12.12
example.cn: 岁以下儿童有特价票。

name: underground
trans: 词组 take the underground 乘地铁

example.en: I found a convenient spot in the underground car park.
example.cn: 我在地下停车场找到一个方便的停车位。

example.en: The underground is quicker than the bus.
example.cn: 地铁比公共汽车快。

name: underline
trans: v. 在······下面划线；强调，使突出

example.en: Read the passage and underline the topic of each paragraph.
example.cn: 阅读这篇文章，划出每段的主题。

example.en: Please pay attention to the underlined words.
example.cn: 请注意划线部分的单词。

example.en: I didn't understand what my teacher said in class, so I raised my hand.
example.cn: 我没听懂老师在课堂上讲的内容，所以我举手了。

name: unfair
trans: adj. 不公正的；不公平的；违反规则或准则的

example.en: It seems unfair on him to make him pay for everything.
example.cn: 让他承担一切费用似乎对他不公平。

example.en: The surfing was an unforgettable experience for both of us.
example.cn: 那次冲浪运动是我们两人都难以忘怀的经历。

example.en: Unfortunately, my time is limited.
example.cn: 可惜的是，我的时间有限。

name: unhappy
trans: adj. 不开心的；不幸福的；难过的

example.en: Though I felt unhappy, I chose to smile and start a new day.
example.cn: 尽管我感到不开心，我还是选择微笑，开启新的一天。

example.en: The public got angry when they knew unhealthy food was fed to children at school.
example.cn: 当公众得知孩子们在学校吃了不健康的食物时，他们很愤怒。

example.en: John is fat and unhealthy because he doesn't take enough exercise.
example.cn: 约翰又胖又不健康，因为他没有进行足够的锻炼。

example.en: In our school, every student has to wear a uniform from Monday to Friday.
example.cn: 在我们学校，每个学生从星期一到星期五都必须穿校服。

name: unit
trans: n. 单元； 单位； 部件； 装置； 机件

example.en: The family is a social unit.
example.cn: 家庭是一个社会单位。

name: united
trans: adj. 联合的； 统一的

example.en: They got united as one man.
example.cn: 他们团结得就像一个人。

example.en: My uncle is a university teacher. He is loved by all his students.
example.cn: 我的叔叔是一名大学教师。学生们都爱他。

name: unless
trans: 点拨 unless是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
点拨 1) unless与 if ... not...意思相同， 在句中可以互换。
点拨 = If I don't finish my homework, I won't be allowed to play computer games.
点拨 = You will be late for school if you don't leave now.
点拨 2) unless与祈使句+or意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = Work harder, or you' ll not succeed in your new job.

example.en: I' ll be able to finish the project on time unless there are unexpected delays.
example.cn: 除非出现意外延误，否则我能按时完成这个项目。

example.en: I won't be allowed to play computer games unless I finish my homework.
You will be late for school unless you leave now.
Unless you work harder, you' ll not succeed in your new job.

name: until
trans: 点拨 until是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: not……until与……when 意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = The boys stopped playing basketball when it was dark.
点拨 = Kitty will believe it after she has seen it with her own eyes.

example.en: We shan't know the results of the test until tomorrow.
example.cn: 我们明天才能知道考试结果。

example.en: We didn't start our discussion until everybody arrived.
example.cn: 等大家都到了，我们才开始讨论。

example.en: The boys didn't stop playing basketball until it was dark.
Kitty won't believe it until she has seen it with her own eyes.

name: unusual
trans: usual adj.通常的，平常的，寻常的

example.en: April Fool's Day is an unusual holiday. You can play a trick on anybody around you.
example.cn: 愚人节是一个不寻常的节日。你可以捉弄身边任何人。

example.en: "How are you?" is a very unusual question. It's a question that often doesn't need an answer.“
example.cn: 你好吗？”是一个很不寻常的问题。这个问题往往不需要回答。

name: up
trans: adv. & prep.向上； 在上方；起来

example.en: He always gets up late.
example.cn: 他总是很晚起床。

example.en: They were climbing up a narrow mountain road.
example.cn: 他们正爬上一条狭窄的山路。

name: upset
trans: adj. 心烦的， 难过的

example.en: What makes you so upset?
example.cn: 是什么让你心烦意乱？

name: upstairs
trans: adv. 在楼上； 到楼上

example.en: You' ll find it upstairs.
example.cn: 你能在楼上找到。

name: use
trans: v. 利用； 使用； 应用
n.利用； 使用； 应用
词组 be used to doing sth.习惯于做某事
词组 used to do sth.过去常常做某事

example.en: Her job is to show the customers how to use the computer.
example.cn: 她的工作是教客户如何使用电脑。

example.en: Is this book any use?
example.cn: 这本书有用吗？

example.en: It is a very useful book for language learners to improve writing skills.
example.cn: 对语言学习者提高写作能力来讲，这是一本非常有用的书。

example.en: What a useful tool the computer is!
example.cn: 电脑是多么有用的工具啊！

example.en: His advice was useless because he didn't understand my real problem.
example.cn: 他的建议毫无用处，因为他根本不了解我真正的问题。

name: usual
trans: adj. 通常的，平常的，寻常的
词组 as usual像往常一样；照例

example.en: He came home later than usual.
example.cn: 他回家比平时晚。

example.en: I usually go to school by underground.
example.cn: 我通常乘地铁去学校。

name: value
trans: n. 价值；价格；数值；价值观；用途；积极作用
valuable adj.很有用的；很重要的；宝贵的

example.en: Our value system does not match theirs.
example.cn: 我们的价值体系与他们的并不相同。

example.en: These old bottles have no practical value, but we can reuse them for decoration.
example.cn: 这些旧瓶子没有实际用途，但我们可以再次利用来做装饰。

example.en: I' ve done business with Mr. Weston before. I value the work he gives me.
example.cn: 我以前和韦斯顿先生有过业务往来，我很重视他给我的业务。

name: variety
trans: n. 种种；种类；（同一事物的）不同种类，多种式样
various adj.各种各样的；不同的

example.en: We have a variety of electronic products.
example.cn: 我们经营各种电子产品。

name: various
trans: adj. 各种各样的；不同的

example.en: At the Import Expo, you can see various new products from different countries.
example.cn: 在进博会上，你能看到来自不同国家的各式各样的新产品。

example.en: I prefer vegetables to meat because they are good for my health.
example.cn: 比起肉我更喜欢吃蔬菜，因为它们对我的身体健康有好处。

example.en: Tony's words made his mother feel very excited.
example.cn: 托尼的话让他的母亲感到非常兴奋。

example.en: The football team's victory brought great excitement to the entire city.
example.cn: 这支足球队的胜利让整座城市兴奋不已。

name: video
trans: n. 录像；视频；音乐短片

example.en: The video cameras are so nice. I really don't know which to choose.
example.cn: 这些摄像机都这么好。我真的不知道该选哪个。

name: view
trans: n. （个人的）看法，见解；风景，景色，（尤指）乡间美景；视野

example.en: I am in favour of your view on spending pocket money. It's reasonable.
example.cn: 我赞成你有关花零用钱的看法。这是合理的。

example.en: Water pollution is one of the most serious problems in that village.
example.cn: 在那个村里，水污染是最严重的问题之一。

example.en: Mary plays the violin very well.
example.cn: 玛丽小提琴拉得很好。

example.en: We started our visit to the United States on February 13.
Many foreign tourists come to China primarily to visit the Great Wall.
example.cn: 许多外国游客来中国主要是参观长城。

example.en: Every day, we examine the visitors' passports carefully before they check in.
example.cn: 每天旅客入住前，我们都要仔细检查他们的护照。

name: voice
trans: n. 嗓音；说话声；歌唱声

example.en: She speaks in a soft voice.
example.cn: 她说话声很柔和。

example.en: We play volleyball after class.
example.cn: 放学后我们打排球。

name: volunteer
trans: n. 志愿者，义务工作者
v.自愿（做）；义务做；无偿做；自愿提供

example.en: The volunteers run with the runners to make sure they arrive safely in the end.
example.cn: 志愿者们跟随运动员一起跑，以确保他们最终安全到达。

example.en: Why don't you volunteer the information?
example.cn: 为什么你不自愿提供消息呢？

name: wait
trans: 词组 wait for等候；等待

example.en: As we all know,it's not polite to keep others waiting for a long time.
example.cn: 我们都知道，让别人久等是不礼貌的。

example.en: Time and tide wait for no man.
example.cn: 时不我待。

example.en: Mary's brothers work as waiters in a five-star hotel.
example.cn: 玛丽的兄弟在一家五星级酒店当服务员。

example.en: We asked the waitress for another glass of wine.
example.cn: 我们请那位女侍者再来一杯酒。

name: wake
trans: awake v.（使）醒来；唤起；激发起
词组 wake up醒来；叫醒

example.en: Dona woke up and found herself in a hospital bed.
example.cn: 多娜醒来发现自己躺在医院的病床上。

example.en: While we were walking around our neighbourhood after supper, it began to rain.
example.cn: 晚饭后，我们在家附近散步时，天开始下雨了。

example.en: Why not have a walk?
example.cn: 为什么不出去走走呢？

example.en: The wall was painted blue.
example.cn: 墙壁被漆成蓝色。

example.en: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true man.
example.cn: 不到长城非好汉。

example.en: There isn't much bread here,but you can take a little if you want to.
example.cn: 这里没有多少面包，但如果你想要你可以拿一点。

example.en: Susan wants to be an engineer.=Susan's wish
example.cn: 苏珊的愿望是成为一名工程师。

example.en: The war made millions of people homeless.
example.cn: 战争使数百万人无家可归。

name: warm
trans: 词组 warm up（体育活动等前的）适应性活动，准备活动；热身练习

example.en: It is warm in spring.
example.cn: 春天天气暖和。

example.en: The sun's rays helped warm the earth after a long winter.
example.cn: 漫长的冬季过后，太阳的光线帮助温暖了大地。

name: warn
trans: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意（可能发生的事）；使警惕

example.en: The police officer warned the children not to play near the busy road.
example.cn: 警察告诫孩子们不要在繁忙的马路边玩耍。

example.en: Mum has washed the carpet twice and now it's spotlessly clean.
example.cn: 妈妈把地毯洗了两次，现在是一尘不染。

example.en: I need to give my car a good wash this weekend.
example.cn: 这周末我得好好洗一下车。

example.en: Please take a short shower and don't waste water.
example.cn: 请快速冲个淋浴，不要浪费水。

example.en: What a waste to throw it away!
example.cn: 扔掉它多浪费！

name: watch
trans: 词组 watch out小心；留神；注意

example.en: Charlie found that he had the same watch as the driver.
example.cn: 查利发现他有块和司机一样的手表。

example.en: Watch your step! The floor is very slippery.
example.cn: 当心脚下！地板很滑。

example.en: Frank held his breath under the water to search for his ring in the swimming pool.
example.cn: 弗兰克在水下屏住呼吸，在游泳池里寻找他的戒指。

example.en: Please tell me whether you have watered the flowers.
example.cn: 请告诉我你是否已给花浇过水了。

example.en: He gave me a wave of the hand to say goodbye.
example.cn: 他向我挥手告别。

example.en: Jessica caught sight of Lois and waved to her.
example.cn: 杰茜卡看到了洛伊丝，向她挥手致意。

name: way
trans: n. 路； 路线； 路途； 方法， 手段
词组 in this way以这种方式
词组 on the 在去······的路上
词组 way of doing sth.做某事的方式

example.en: Beating and scolding a child is not a good way to make the child successful.
example.cn: 让孩子成才，打骂不是一个好方法。

name: weak
trans: adj. 弱的， 差的； 淡的； 虚弱的， 无力的

example.en: She spoke in a weak voice.
example.cn: 她用微弱的声音说话。

name: wealth
trans: n. 财产； 财富； 钱财

example.en: Good health is true wealth.
example.cn: 健康是真正的财富。

example.en: They can see the words on the blackboard clearly, so they don't have to wear glasses.
example.cn: 他们可以看清黑板上的字，所以不需要戴眼镜。

name: weather
trans: 点拨 weather 是常考单词，是不可数名词。学生同时也要牢记其他常考的不可数名词，如: advice（建议）,fun（乐趣）,furniture（家具）,homework（家庭作业），housework（家务）,information（信息）,music（音乐）,news（新闻）,progress（进步），space（空间）,tea（茶）,work（工作）。

example.en: I don't like the weather in February this year because there were many rainy days.
example.cn: 我不喜欢今年2月的天气，因为有很多雨天。

example.en: What fine weather! Let's go to fly kites.
example.cn: 多么好的天气啊！ 我们去放风筝吧。

example.en: Hundreds of internet service providers and web companies tested IPv6 on their websites.
example.cn: 数百家互联网服务商和网络公司在他们网站上对互联网协议第6版进行了测试。

example.en: I couldn't get much news of the exhibition of clean-energy products from the website.
example.cn: 我从网站上看不到很多关于清洁能源产品展览会的消息。

example.en: The meeting has been put off until next Wednesday afternoon.
example.cn: 会议已推迟到下星期三下午。

name: week
trans: 词组 the week after next下下周

example.en: Some questions were raised in their class meeting last week.
example.cn: 在上星期的班会上有人提了一些问题。

name: weekday
trans: n. 工作日（星期一到星期五的任何一天）
词组 on weekdays在工作日

example.en: He goes to school on weekdays.
example.cn: 他工作日去学校上学。

name: weekend
trans: n. 周末；星期六和星期日

example.en: We used to stay at the Browns' for the weekend.
example.cn: 我们常常待在布朗家过周末。

example.en: How much does that typewriter weigh?
example.cn: 那台打字机有多重？

example.en: She weighs the pros and cons before making any major decisions.
example.cn: 她在做任何重要决定前都会权衡利弊。

example.en: How can Lisa lose weight so successfully in such a short time?
example.cn: 莉萨如何能在这么短的时间内减肥成功？

example.en: Fruit and vegetables are sold by weight.
example.cn: 水果和蔬菜是称重出售的。

example.en: He received a warm welcome at Cambridge.
example.cn: 他在剑桥受到了热烈的欢迎。

example.en: The visitors will be welcomed when they come to Shanghai.
example.cn: 游客来到上海时将受到热烈欢迎。

example.en: Welcome, friends!
example.cn: 朋友们，欢迎你们！

example.en: Members who are no longer welcome can easily be frozen out.
example.cn: 不再受欢迎的成员很容易被排挤掉。

name: well
trans: int.（表示同意、惊讶等）好，好吧；那么

example.en: I don't feel well today.
example.cn: 我今天感到不舒服。

example.en: How well Charles did at the school sports meeting this year!
example.cn: 查尔斯在今年的学校运动会上表现得多好啊！

example.en: An encyclopedia is a well of knowledge.
example.cn: 百科全书是知识的源泉。

example.en: Well,perhaps that's true.
example.cn: 嗯，也许那是真的。

example.en: Well done!
example.cn: 做得好！干得好！

example.en: The wind was blowing lightly from the west.
example.cn: 风从西面轻轻吹来。

example.en: The West Lake is famous for its beautiful scenery.
example.cn: 西湖以风景优美著称。

example.en: He decided to travel west to explore new territories.
example.cn: 他决定向西前行，探索新的领地。

example.en: Which kind of food do you prefer,Chinese or Western?
example.cn: 你喜欢吃中餐，还是喜欢吃西餐？

example.en: It is wet in the South,while the North is dry.
example.cn: 南方雨水充沛，北方则比较干燥。

name: what
trans: pron. （表示疑问）什么；（表示建议）怎么样
adv.（表示感叹）多么；（表示疑问）什么
点拨 what是常考单词，常出现在感叹句中，所以学生一定要注意其在以下感叹句中的用法：
点拨 What a clever boy he is! = How clever the boy is!他是一个多么聪明的男孩啊！
点拨 What nice weather it is!= How nice the weather is! 多么好的天气啊！
点拨 What beautiful flowers(they are)!= How beautiful the flowers are!

example.en: What is your name?
example.cn: 你叫什么名字？

example.en: What about going for a walk?
example.cn: 去散散步怎么样？

example.en: What an important city Yan'an was in the history of China!
example.cn: 在中国历史上延安是一座多么重要的城市啊！

example.en: What does it matter?
example.cn: 这有什么关系？

example.en: We will discuss what to teach during the next term.
example.cn: 我们将讨论下学期要教什么。

example.en: Susan is terribly sorry for what she has done.
example.cn: 苏珊为她所做的事情感到非常抱歉。

example.en: What important information it is!
example.cn: 多么重要的信息啊！

example.en: What useful advice he gave us!
example.cn: 他给了我们多么有用的建议啊！

example.en: What interesting news it is!
example.cn: 多么有趣的新闻啊！

example.en: What beautiful music he is playing!
example.cn: 他在演奏多么美妙的音乐啊！

example.en: What good work he has done!
example.cn: 他干得多漂亮呀！

example.en: What great fun it is to fly a kite here!
example.cn: 在这儿放风筝多么有趣啊！

example.en: What an interesting news report it is!
example.cn: 多么有趣的新闻报道啊！

example.en: What a great help it is to know English!
example.cn: 掌握英语是多么有用啊！

example.en: What a good time they are having!
example.cn: 他们玩得多开心啊！

example.en: What a quick lunch he has had!
example.cn: 他午饭吃得多快啊！

example.en: What a happy life we are living!
example.cn: 我们过着多么幸福的生活啊！

example.en: What a heavy rain we had last night!
example.cn: 昨晚的雨下得多大啊！

name: when
trans: conj. & adv.什么时候； 当······的时候

example.en: A good friend always gives you a helping hand when you' re in trouble.
example.cn: 当你遇到麻烦时，好朋友总会向你伸出援助之手。

example.en: Could you tell me when they are going to set out?
example.cn: 你能否告诉我他们什么时候出发？

example.en: When did you last see Margaret?
example.cn: 你最近一次见到玛格丽特是什么时候？

name: where
trans: conj.在······的地方， 到······的地方

example.en: Joyce has a good memory. She still remembers where she lived in her childhood.
example.cn: 乔伊丝记忆力很好。她还记得童年生活过的地方。

example.en: Stand where I can see you.
example.cn: 站在我能看得到你的地方。

example.en: Where there is a will,there is a way.
example.cn: 有志者事竟成。

name: whether
trans: conj. 是否（表示选择或可能性）
点拨 whether是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道： whether与 if意思相同，在某 些情况下可以互换。
点拨 =I can't decide if I will go to my friend's birthday party.

example.en: I don't know whether you like flowers,sir.
example.cn: 我不知道您是否喜欢花，先生。

example.en: Sarah asked whether the boy had understood her instructions.
example.cn: 莎拉问这个男孩是否理解了她的指示。

example.en: I can't decide whether to go to my friend's birthday party.
Which T-shirt do you like better, the red one or the blue one?
example.cn: 你更喜欢哪件T恤衫，红色的还是蓝色的？

example.en: Which is the fifth day of a week?
example.cn: 一个星期的第五天是哪一天？

name: while
trans: conj. 在······的时候；正当······时；（对比两件事物）然而

example.en: My father was preparing for his speech while my mother was doing some washing last night.
example.cn: 昨晚当我母亲在洗衣服时，我父亲在为他的演讲做准备。

example.en: He excels in math, while his brother excels in art.
example.cn: 他擅长数学，而他的兄弟擅长艺术。

example.en: I'll be back in a while.
example.cn: 我一会儿就回来。

example.en: Another world-famous building in Washington is the White House.
example.cn: 华盛顿另一座世界著名的建筑物是白宫。

example.en: Angels are usually shown in pictures dressed in white.
example.cn: 画中的天使通常身穿白衣。

example.en: Who do you think will win the first prize?
example.cn: 你觉得谁会赢得第一名呢？

example.en: Although Yuan Longping has left us, his remarkable achievements in hybrid research will always have great influence on the whole world.
example.cn: 袁隆平虽然离开了我们，但他在“杂交水稻”方面的杰出贡献将对整个世界产生巨大影响。

example.en: Did you know whom Bill was waiting for?
example.cn: 你知道比尔在等谁吗？

example.en: Whose books are these?
example.cn: 这些书是谁的？

name: why
trans: 点拨 why是常考单词，常出现在对划线部分提问的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：当线划在because部分或to do表示目的的部分，要用Why 提问。

example.en: Nobody knows why Betty has become so forgetful in recent years.
example.cn: 没有人知道为什么近年来贝蒂变得如此健忘。

example.en: Why does he always have a headache?
example.cn: 为什么他总是头疼？

example.en: Why did she get up early?
example.cn: 她为什么起得这么早？

name: wide
trans: adj. 宽的； 宽阔的； 广泛的
widely adv.宽阔地；广泛地；普遍地

example.en: They came to a wide river.
example.cn: 他们来到了一条宽阔的河边。

name: widely
trans: adv. 宽阔地； 广泛地； 普遍地

example.en: With the development of China, Chinese has become an international language and is widely used all over the world.
example.cn: 随着中国的发展，汉语已成为一种国际语言，在世 界各地被广泛使用。

example.en: The town government has decided to widen this main street.
example.cn: 市政府决定拓宽这条主街。

example.en: Mr. Smith and his wife seldom drive their car to work, do they?
example.cn: 史密斯先生和他的妻子很少开车上班，是吗？

name: wild
trans: adj. 自然生长的， 野的，野生的； 荒凉的

example.en: We should protect wild animals.
example.cn: 我们应该保护野生动物。

name: will
trans: 谚语 Will is power.意志就是力量。

example.en: Our headmaster will make a speech to the parents on the School Open Day.
example.cn: 在学校开放日，我们的校长将向家长发表讲话。

example.en: Will you go to the zoo with us tomorrow?
example.cn: 你明天愿意和我们一起去动物园吗？

example.en: Nothing can stop a man with a strong will from achieving success.
example.cn: 没有什么能阻挡一个意志坚定的人获得成功。

example.en: Nobody knows which player will win the game until the last moment.
example.cn: 不到最后一刻没人知道哪位运动员会赢得这场比赛。

example.en: Wind is a motive power.
example.cn: 风是一种动力。

example.en: Could you possibly open that window for me?
example.cn: 你能为我打开那扇窗吗？

example.en: What fun it is to surf on a windy day!
example.cn: 在有风的日子冲浪是多么有趣啊！

example.en: You won't be able to make the best wine unless you choose the perfect grapes only.
=Choose the perfect grapes only, or you won't be able to make the best wine.
example.cn: 只有选用极好的葡萄，才能酿造出最好的酒。

example.en: Friendship is love without wings.
example.cn: 友谊是无翼之爱。

example.en: Wu Liangyong is one of the winners to get the State Preeminent Science and Technology Award.
example.cn: 吴良镛是国家最高科学技术奖的获奖者之一。

example.en: Miss Lin asked Dick if he was going to visit the Great Wall this winter.
example.cn: 林小姐问迪克今年冬天他是否要去游览长城。

name: wisdom
trans: 谚语 胸中有知识，胜于手中有金钱。

example.en: Wisdom is more precious than wealth.
example.cn: 智慧比财富更珍贵。

example.en: Wisdom in the mind is better than money in the hand.

name: wise
trans: adj. 聪明的；明智的；充满智慧的

example.en: They made a wise decision to leave there in a hurry before the heavy rain.
example.cn: 他们做了一个明智的决定，大雨前匆忙离开了那里。

name: wish
trans: 点拨 wish是常考单词，学生要掌握这个单词的用法，并且比较与hope的用法
点拨 1) wish sb.to do sth.或wish sb.sth.
点拨 2) hope to do sth.或者后接宾语从句。
点拨 例如：I wish you to write to me.=I hope you will write to me.

example.en: My wish is to become a scientist when I grow up. What is yours, Betty?
example.cn: 我的愿望是长大后成为一名科学家。贝蒂，你的愿望是什么？

example.en: I wish you good health and a long life.
example.cn: 祝您健康长寿。

name: with
trans: prep. 与⋯⋯一道；跟⋯⋯一起；带有；具有；关于；以；和；用；有

example.en: The famous actor often plays with his children in the park.
example.cn: 那位著名演员经常和他的孩子们在公园玩。

example.en: He passed me a knife to cut the birthday cake with.
example.cn: 他递过来一把刀，让我切生日蛋糕。

example.en: Although the expenses at Harvard University are high, students often pay less with the help of scholarships.
example.cn: 虽然哈佛大学的学费昂贵，但学生在奖学金的帮助下往往只要支付一点点。

example.en: The room is cooled with air conditioner.
example.cn: 这房间用空调降温。

name: within
trans: prep. 在⋯⋯范围之内；在（某段时间）之内

example.en: The house is within eyesight.
example.cn: 这幢房子在视线范围之内。

example.en: The firemen arrived at the scene within five minutes after the call.
example.cn: 消防员在接到电话后5分钟之内就赶到了现场。

example.en: Without the glasses, he can't see the words on the blackboard clearly.
example.cn: 没戴眼镜，他看不清黑板上的字。

example.en: Nobody can solve that complex case without gathering sufficient evidence.
example.cn: 缺乏足够的证据，没人能侦破那个复杂的案件。

example.en: They want to kill the wolf.
example.cn: 他们想要把狼打死。

example.en: These women doctors have saved many children's lives since they worked in the hospital.
example.cn: 自从这些女医生在医院工作，她们救了很多孩子的生命。

example.en: Many women are more independent than before because they have jobs and earn money.
example.cn: 许多妇女比以前更独立，因为她们有工作、能赚钱。

name: wonder
trans: v. 对⋯⋯感到疑惑；想知道；想弄明白；琢磨
wonderful adj.美妙的，精彩的；太好了
点拨 wonder是常考单词，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: wonder与want to know意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = Mike's parents want to know whether he likes his new job.

example.en: I wonder when the university campus in China will open to the public.
example.cn: 我想知道中国的大学校园什么时候将对公众开放。

example.en: Many people consider the internet to be one of the wonders of modern technology.
example.cn: 许多人认为，互联网是现代科技的奇迹之一。

example.en: Mike's parents wonder whether he likes his new job.

name: wonderful
trans: adj. 美妙的， 精彩的； 太好了

example.en: We had such a wonderful time at his birthday party.
example.cn: 在他的生日聚会上，我们度过了如此美好的时光。

example.en: How wonderful this kind of computer is!
example.cn: 这种电脑多棒啊！

example.en: Paper is made from wood.
example.cn: 纸是由木头制成的。

example.en: Mr. Smith has recently built a wooden bridge over his pool in the garden.
example.cn: 史密斯先生最近在花园里的池塘上建造了一座木桥。

name: word
trans: n. 词， 单词； 话
词组 in other words换句话说

example.en: I can't understand the sentence though there are no new words in it.
example.cn: 我无法理解这句句子的意思，尽管句中没有新单词。

example.en: Alice was so surprised to hear about the death of her good friend that she couldn't say a word.
example.cn: 爱丽丝听到她好友去世的消息时太惊讶了，以至于一句话也说不出来。

name: work
trans: v. 工作； （机器等）运转， 活动
词组 work as担任，从事
词组 work out做出；算出；制订出

example.en: The firemen didn't stop working until all the workers were saved.
= The firemen stopped working when all the workers were saved.
example.cn: 直到所有的工人都得救了，消防队员才停止工作。

example.en: The watch just stopped working.
example.cn: 这块手表刚坏了。

example.en: What important work the scientists are doing! Let's learn from them.
example.cn: 科学家所做的工作是多么重要啊！让我们向他们学习。

example.en: Nothing can be learned well without hard work.
example.cn: 不努力学习，什么也学不会。

example.en: In my opinion, this is Rembrandt's greatest work.
example.cn: 我认为这是伦勃朗最伟大的作品。

example.en: Work makes the workman.
example.cn: 勤工出巧匠。

example.en: The workers were asked to go back to work at once.
example.cn: 工人们被要求立刻回去工作。

example.en: Shanghai attracts a lot of visitors from all over the world every year.
example.cn: 每年上海吸引很多来自世界各地的游客。

example.en: We all have our places in the world.
example.cn: 天生我材必有用。

name: worry
trans: 词组 worry about为…而担心

example.en: You have already tried your best, so you needn't worry too much about the exams.
example.cn: 你已经尽力了，所以不必太担心这次考试。

example.en: Mother's illness was always a great worry to me.
example.cn: 母亲的病一直是我非常担心的事。

example.en: It isn't worth spending so much time on gardening.

name: would
trans: aux. v.&modal v.愿意；（客气地建议或邀请）将；将会
词组 would like 想要；（表示喜欢、愿意）很想；很愿意
词组 would rather宁愿，宁可

example.en: She said she would come.
example.cn: 她说过她会来的。

example.en: Would you like me to show you how to work out the math problem?
example.cn: 要我告诉你如何解答这道数学题吗？

example.en: My wound is still painful.
example.cn: 我的伤口还在痛。

example.en: This is the wounded soldier.
example.cn: 这就是那位受伤的战士。

example.en: He wrote his first symphony when he was 16.
example.cn: 他16岁时写了自己的第一部交响曲。

example.en: She has written four novels.
example.cn: 她写了4篇小说。

example.en: I wrote to let him know that I had arrived in Beijing.
example.cn: 我写信告诉他我已到达北京。

example.en: Who is the writer of the book War and Peace?
example.cn: 《战争与和平》这部书的作者是谁？

name: wrong
trans: adj. 错误的；不正常的；有病的

example.en: It's wrong of you to make fun of the disabled boy. You should apologise to him.
example.cn: 你取笑那个残疾男孩是不对的。你应该向他道歉。

name: year
trans: 词组 once every four years每四年一次

example.en: What changeable weather it is this year
example.cn: ！今年的天气真是多变啊！

example.en: Yellow is my favourite colour.
example.cn: 黄色是我最喜欢的颜色。

example.en: Grandma's garden is full of bright yellow flowers.
example.cn: 外婆的花园种满了明艳的黄色花卉。

example.en: In yesterday's games, Switzerland beat the United States two to one.
example.cn: 在昨天的比赛中，瑞士队2比1打败了美国队。

example.en: What an amazing story he told us the day before yesterday
Has Danny given up smoking yet?
example.cn: 丹尼戒烟了吗？

example.en: The girl hasn't finished the project herself yet.
example.cn: 这个女孩自己还没有完成项目。

example.en: Do you have any low-fat yogurt?
example.cn: 你有没有低脂的酸奶？

example.en: She must be at least forty, but she likes dressing up as a young girl.
example.cn: 她至少有40岁了，但她喜欢打扮成年轻的姑娘。

example.en: A young idler, an old beggar.
example.cn: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。

example.en: It's a sunny late winter day, just a few degrees above zero.
example.cn: 这是晚冬晴朗的一天，只有零上几度。

example.en: There are two zeros in 1008.
example.cn: 在1008中有两个零。

example.en: Please take me to the zoo.
example.cn: 请带我去动物园。

example.en: The patient became a bit better after taking some medicine.
example.cn: 服药后，病人感觉好点了。

example.en: Danny has worked as a newspaper reporter for a couple of years.
example.cn: 丹尼担任报社记者已有几年了。

example.en: Apple is a kind of fruit.
example.cn: 苹果是一种水果。

example.en: This shop sells all kinds of watches from different countries.
example.cn: 这家商店出售来自不同国家的各种手表。

example.en: Although the World Expo was over, a lot of visitors still go to the China Pavilion to enjoy themselves and take photos.
example.cn: 虽然世博会结束了，但还是有很多游客去中国馆参观、拍照。

example.en: There is a pair of glasses on the desk.
example.cn: 桌子上有一副眼镜。

example.en: What an important piece of information it is!
example.cn: 这是一个多么重要的信息！

example.en: Above all Susie is a good and tireless writer.
example.cn: 首要的一点，苏茜是一位优秀的、不知疲倦的作家。

name: according to
trans: 按照；根据；按（……所报道）；依照；据（……所说）
点拨 according to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: according to sb.与in one's opinion意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: According to the traffic rules, a baby can not sit on an adult's lap in a car.
example.cn: 根据交通规则，婴儿不能坐在车内成年人的腿上。

example.en: Taking a different route to school can add variety to your day.
example.cn: 走不同的路线去上学，能为你的一天增添趣味变化。

example.en: He failed after all.
example.cn: 最终他还是失败了。

example.en: After all, practice makes perfect, so keep working on improving your skills.
example.cn: 毕竟，熟能生巧，所以继续努力提高你的技能吧。

name: agree with sb.
trans: 点拨 agree with sb.是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: agree with sb.与have the same opinion with sb.意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: I agree with you.
example.cn: 我同意你的意见。

name: all over
trans: 点拨 all over是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: all over与everywhere意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: He was very well thought of all over the district.
example.cn: 他在整个地区评价很高。

example.en: All right,I accept your apology.
example.cn: 好吧，我接受你的道歉。

example.en: Did you run all the way here?
example.cn: 你是一路跑来的吗？

example.en: Disneyland is an amusement park.
example.cn: 迪士尼是一个游乐园。

example.en: She spends her day doing housework, watching television, reading, and so on.
example.cn: 她用一天的时间来做家务、看电视、看书，等等。

name: apologize to sb. for sth.
trans: 点拨 apologize to sb. for sth.是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: apologize to sb. for sth.与say sorry to sb. forsth.意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: You must apologize to her for having kept her waiting.
example.cn: 让她等了这么久，你必须为此向她道歉。

name: arrive at
trans: 点拨 arrive at 是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: arrive at 与get to 意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: I arrived in Shanghai yesterday.
example.cn: 我昨天到的上海。

name: as…as
trans: 点拨 as…as是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握其用法：
点拨 A is not as 形容词的原级as B =B is+形容词的比较级than A.
点拨 例如: The traffic in the countryside is not as
点拨 = The traffic in the city is more convenient than that in the countryside.
点拨 = Australia has fewer people than China.
点拨 = China has more people than Australia.

example.en: The food in Shanghai is not as hot as that in Sichuan.
example.cn: 上海的食物不像四川的食物那么辣。

example.en: Australia doesn't have as many people as China.
It's okay to disagree as long as we respect each other's views.
example.cn: 只要我们尊重彼此的观点，有不同意见没关系。

example.en: As soon as George heard the bad news, his face turned pale.
example.cn: 乔治一听到坏消息，脸色就变得煞白。

example.en: She sings beautifully, and she can dance as well.
example.cn: 她歌唱得好， 也会跳舞。

example.en: It is wonderful playing sports in this club and I have made lots of friends as well.
example.cn: 在这个俱乐部里运动太棒了，我还结交了很多朋友。

example.en: Miss Wu is our class teacher and our friend as well.
= Miss Wu is not only our class teacher but also our friend.
example.cn: 吴小姐不仅是我们的老师，还是我们的朋友。

example.en: I' ll ask for your help if I can't work out the problem.
example.cn: 如果我解不出这题，我会请你帮忙。

example.en: My family talk to each other at breakfast supper.
example.cn: 我的家人在早 午 晚餐时交流。

name: at first
trans: 起先；开始的时候 最后；终于

example.en: The election went against him at first, but he won at last.
example.cn: 选举开始时对他不利，但最终他获胜了。

example.en: I have nothing to do at home.
example.cn: 我在家没事可做。

example.en: If all businesses go paperless, at least one million tons of paper will be saved.
example.cn: 如果所有的企业实现无纸化，至少能节省100万吨的纸。

example.en: The work will be completed inside four hours at most.
example.cn: 这项工作至多在4小时内完成。

name: at once
trans: 点拨 at once是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: at once与immediately或right now,right away意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: If you see something strange, act at once and call the police.
example.cn: 如果你看到可疑情况，要立刻行动并报警。

name: at present
trans: 点拨 at present是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: at present与for the time being或now意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = You can leave your suitcase for the time being.
点拨 = Now, you can leave your suitcase.

example.en: More and more foreigners are living and working in Shanghai at present.
example.cn: 目前越来越多的外国人在上海生活和工作。

example.en: You can leave your suitcase at present.
At the end of August, many students are doing their homework in a hurry.
example.cn: 在8月底，许多学生在赶作业。

example.en: When playing basketball, we can enjoy the sunshine and fresh air at the same time.
example.cn: 打篮球时，我们可以同时享受阳光和新鲜的空气。

example.en: Willy doesn't do any housework with his mum at weekends.
example.cn: 威利周末不跟他妈妈一起做任何家务。

example.en: I'm at work.
example.cn: 我正在工作。

name: based on
trans: 以······为依据； 以······为基础； 基于

example.en: Success is based on diligence.
example.cn: 成功是建立在勤奋的基础上的。

name: be able to
trans: 点拨 be able to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握以下固定搭配。
点拨 I am not able to do = It is impossible for me to do, 在句中可以互换。
点拨 = It is impossible for me to run the 100-metr e race within 14 seconds.

example.en: If you save a few coins every day, you' ll be able to buy a mobile in a year.
example.cn: 如果你每天节省几个硬币，你就可以在一年内购买一部手机。

example.en: I am not able to run the 100-me tr e race within 14 seconds.

name: be afraid of
trans: 点拨 be afraid of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be afraid of与frighten意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Chemistry isn't very difficult. You needn't be afraid of it. You can come and ask for help.
example.cn: 化学不是很难。你不必害怕。你可以来寻求帮助。

example.en: "Tom, don't be afraid of speaking in public. You are no longer a small boy," said Mum.
example.cn: 妈妈说：“汤姆，不要害怕在公众场合讲话。你不再是个小男孩了。”

example.en: My father was extremely angry with me when he came back from the parents meeting last week.
example.cn: 上周父亲开完家长会回来，对我非常生气。

example.en: Digital life is convenient but we should be aware of its disadvantages.
example.cn: 数字生活十分便捷，但我们应当意识到它的弊端。

name: be bad for
trans: 点拨 be bad for是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be bad for与be harmful to意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: It is bad for your health.
example.cn: 这个对你的健康有害。

example.en: He was born in Shanghai in 1979.
example.cn: 他1979年在上海出生。

example.en: Better be born lucky than wise.
example.cn: 生不逢时，聪明无用。

example.en: He rarely goes to the gym recently because he is too busy with work.
example.cn: 他最近工作太忙，很少去健身房。

example.en: He is busy preparing for the examination.
example.cn: 他正忙着准备考试。

name: be careful with
trans: 点拨 be careful with是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be careful与take care意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Be careful with this knife, Richard, or you' ll hurt yourself.
example.cn: 理查德，小心这把刀，否则你会伤到自己。

example.en: His illness is believed to be connected to bad habits.
example.cn: 他的病被认为与不良习惯有关。

example.en: What makes you suppose him to be connected with them?
example.cn: 什么使你想到他和他们有联系？

example.en: The earth is covered with water.
example.cn: 地球被水覆盖。

name: be different from
trans: 点拨 be different from是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be different from与be not the same as意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: The textbooks you' re using are different from ours.
example.cn: 你们使用的课本和我们的不同。

name: be with
trans: 点拨 be with是常考词组，所以学生要知道: be 和be 的用法区别。
点拨 be 为某人所熟悉（主语是人或物）
点拨 be 熟悉某物或某人（主语是人）

example.en: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower is familiar to all Shanghai citizens.
example.cn: 东方明珠电视塔为所有上海市民所熟知。

example.en: Drivers should be very familiar with the traffic signs and rules.
example.cn: 司机应该通晓交通标志和规则。

example.en: Beijing is familiar to me.
example.cn: 北京对我来说很熟悉。

example.en: I'm familiar with Beijing.
example.cn: 我很熟悉北京。

example.en: This restaurant is famous for serving dishes in a romantic way.
example.cn: 这家餐厅以用浪漫的方式呈上菜肴而闻名。

name: be fond of
trans: 点拨 be fond of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be fond of与be keen on或enjoy意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Teenagers are very fond of cartoons.
example.cn: 青少年非常喜欢漫画。

example.en: Others may be fond of titles and honors, but I am not.
example.cn: 人皆好名， 我则不然。

name: be full of
trans: 点拨 be full of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be full of与be filled with意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: The hall is full of people.
example.cn: 大厅里挤满了人。

name: be good
trans: 点拨 be good 是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be good at与do well in意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Tim is good at singing and doing magic, so he is very popular at his friends' parties.
example.cn: 蒂姆擅长唱歌和变魔术，所以他在朋友的聚会上非常受欢迎。

example.en: He is poor at Chinese.
example.cn: 他的语文学科比较差。

example.en: Steve Jobs was interested in computers when he was very young.
example.cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯很年轻时就对电脑感兴趣了。

example.en: Angel is keen on all kinds of pop music.
example.cn: 安杰尔喜爱各种流行音乐。

example.en: If John doesn't get up immediately, he will be late for the meeting.
= Unless John gets up immediately, he will be late for the meeting.
example.cn: 如果约翰不马上起床，他开会将要迟到了。

example.en: John, please don't be late for school again.

name: be located
trans: 点拨 be located(in at)是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be located in与lie in意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Where will the Olympic Park be located?
example.cn: 奥林匹克公园将建在哪儿？

example.en: The bakery is located in the new shopping centre.
example.cn: 这家面包店位于新的购物中心内。

example.en: His house is located on the edge of the city.
example.cn: 他的房屋坐落在市区的边缘。

name: be made of
trans: 点拨 be made of是常考词组，所以学生一定要掌握其用法，及比较与be madefrom和be made into的用法区别：
点拨 be made of的意思是“由······制成”，表示制成成品后，仍可看出原材料是什么，保留原材料的质地形状，制作过程仅发生了物理变化。主语是成品，of后面是原材料。
点拨 be made from的意思是“用⋯⋯制成”，表示制成的东西完全失去了原材料的外形或特征，或原材料在制作过程中发生了化学变化，在成品中已无法辨认。主语是成品，from后面是原材料。
点拨 be made into的意思是“被制成”，是被动形式。所以主语是原材料，into后面是成品。
点拨 = Paper can be made from wood.纸可以用木材制造。
点拨 = We can make wood into paper.我们可以把木材制成纸。

example.en: The earth is mainly made of iron and silicon and things like that.
example.cn: 地球主要由铁、硅之类的物质构成。

example.en: The desks and chairs are made of wood.
example.cn: 这些课桌椅都是由木头制成的。

example.en: This kind of wine is made from rice.
example.cn: 这种酒是由米酿成的。

example.en: Wood can be made into paper.
example.cn: 木材可以制成纸。

name: be made up of
trans: 点拨 be made up of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be made up of与consist of意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = Desktop computers usually consist of three main parts.

example.en: The organisation is made up of ten people.
example.cn: 这个组织由10人组成。

example.en: Desktop computers are made up of three main parts.

name: be pleased with
trans: 点拨 be pleased with是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be pleased with与be satisfied with或be happy about意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 =I think the young man will be satisfied with 我认为年轻人会对这个新型手提箱满意的。

example.en: Helen's teacher was so pleased with the great progress she made this term.
example.cn: 海伦的老师对她这学期取得巨大进步很满意。

example.en: We are so pleased with what they have done in the Paris Olympic Games.
example.cn: 我们对他们在巴黎奥运会上的表现很满意。

example.en: I think the young man will be pleased with this new type of suitcase.
That famous hotel is proud of its spotless rooms, tasty food and good service.
example.cn: 那家著名的酒店以其一尘不染的房间、美味的食物和优质的服务引以为豪。

name: be ready for
trans: 点拨 be ready for是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be ready for与get ready for或prepare for意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: The order will be ready for delivery next week.
example.cn: 这批订货将于下周备好待发。

name: be responsible for
trans: 点拨 be responsible for是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be responsible for与take charge of意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: A headmaster is the person who is responsible for a school.
example.cn: 校长是学校的负责人。

name: be satisfied with
trans: 点拨 be satisfied with是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be satisfied with与be pleased with意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Alex was satisfied with Julia's honesty.
example.cn: 亚历克斯对朱丽亚的诚实很满意。

example.en: We expected them to be more similar to one another.
example.cn: 我们期望它们彼此间会更相似。

example.en: One should be strict with oneself.
example.cn: 一个人应该严格要求自己。

example.en: The whole conference as totally disorganised and nobody knew where they were supposed to be or what they were supposed to be doing.
example.cn: 整个会议安排混乱无序，既没人知道该 坐哪里，也没人知道该做什么。

example.en: Louise won the first prize in a maths contest. We were surprised at the news.
example.cn: 路易斯获得了数学竞赛一等奖。我们对这一消息感到惊讶。

example.en: I am thankful to you for all this help.
example.cn: 感谢你的所有帮助。

name: be used to
trans: 点拨 be used to是常考词组，所以学生一定要掌握以下固定搭配及用法：
点拨 1) sb. be used to跟动名词或名词，表示“某人习惯做某事”。
点拨 2) sth. be used to跟动词原形，表示“被用来做某事”(= sth. be used for doing sth.).
点拨 3) sb. used to跟动词原形，表示“某人过去习惯做某事”。

example.en: My grandmother used to wash clothes by hand, but now she is used to doing it with the washing machine.
example.cn: 我的祖母过去常常用手洗衣服，但现在她习惯用洗衣机了。

example.en: Because of the strong wind, a large number of leaves fell to the ground.
example.cn: 由于大风，许多树叶掉到了地上。

example.en: Aunt Liu says these books aren't hers. They belong to the gentleman over there.
example.cn: 刘阿姨说这些书不是她的。书属于那边那位绅士。

example.en: It might not seem like a big deal, but it can have an effect on how you see yourself and how others see you.
example.cn: 这也许并不是什么重要的事情，却可以对你如何看待自己以及他 人如何看待你产生影响。

name: both … and…
trans: 点拨 both……and……是常考词组，所以学生一定要掌握以下固定搭配及用法。
点拨 1) both……and……构成的词组作主语时，谓语动词用复数。
点拨 2) both……and……改为否定句时，要用neither……nor……。谓语动词遵循就近原则。

example.en: Both Rose and Danny went to the car exhibition yesterday.
Both his parents and he have already seen the film.
The virus caused the computer to break down(= stop working).
example.cn: 病毒导致计算机出故障了。

example.en: A thief broke into the shop in our neighbourhood last night and stole several expensive items.
example.cn: 昨晚一个小偷闯进了我们街区的商店，偷走了好几件贵重物品。

name: by bus plane
trans: 乘公共汽车 火车 飞机

example.en: I go to Beijing by bus plane.
example.cn: 我乘公共汽车 火车 飞机去北京。

example.en: Among all the Christmas cards, mine is the best. I made it by myself.
example.cn: 在所有的圣诞贺卡中，我的圣诞贺卡是最好的。这是我亲手做的。

example.en: By the way,what time is it?
example.cn: 顺便问一下，现在几点了？

example.en: Calm down,there's nothing to worry about.
example.cn: 你冷静一下，没有什么可焦虑的。

name: care for
trans: 点拨 care for是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: care for与look after或take care of意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Lucy thinks young people can learn how to care for others by keeping pets.
example.cn: 露西认为，年轻人可以通过养宠物来学习如何照顾他人。

example.en: I don't much care for sweets.
example.cn: 我不太喜欢吃糖果。

example.en: The weather in spring is so changeable that many of us have caught a cold.
example.cn: 春天的天气多变，我们中有很多人都感冒了。

example.en: Nothing can make me change my mind.
example.cn: 什么也不能使我改变主意。

example.en: I want to check in.
example.cn: 我想办理登机手续。

example.en: I come from China.
example.cn: 我来自中国。

example.en: Come on!
example.cn: 快来！

name: come to an end
trans: 点拨 come to an end是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: come to an end与complete,finish,be over意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: I think he will come to no good end.
example.cn: 我认为他没有好下场。

example.en: All good things must come to an end.
example.cn: 天下没有不散的筵席。

example.en: All things will come true if you can become hard-working.
example.cn: 只要努力， 一切都会实现。

name: come up with
trans: 想出（主意或计划）；提出；赶上

example.en: Several of the members have come up with suggestions of their own.
example.cn: 有几位成员提出了自己的建议。

name: communicate with
trans: 点拨 communicate with是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: communicate with与keep in touch with意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Computers are used to help us communicate with others easily.
example.cn: 电脑能帮助我们轻松地与他人进行交流。

example.en: Lin Lin often communicates with her American friend to practise English.
= Lin Lin often practises English by communicating with her American friend.
example.cn: 琳琳经常通过与她的美国朋友交流来练习英语。

example.en: She competed with her rival for a prize.
example.cn: 她为了奖品与对手展开竞争。

example.en: He never complained about working overtime.
example.cn: 他从来不抱怨加班。

example.en: Does the new product consist of four main parts inside?
example.cn: 这个新产品主要由四部分组成吗？

example.en: He cut the tree down.
example.cn: 他把这棵树砍倒了。

example.en: Why did Jeff cut down the expenses on clothes?
example.cn: 为什么杰夫减少了在衣服上的花销？

example.en: You must cut down on sugar to lose weight.
example.cn: 你必须少吃糖以减轻体重。

example.en: She spent years dealing with an unsolved case from history.
example.cn: 她花费数年时间处理了一个未解决的陈年旧案。

example.en: Would you please tell me how I should deal with it for the time being?
= Would you please tell me how to deal with it for the time being?
example.cn: 请您告诉我该怎么处理眼下这件事？

name: depend on
trans: 点拨 depend on是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: depend on与rely on意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: A friend is somebody that we can depend on when we are in trouble.
example.cn: 朋友是我们在遇到麻烦时可以依靠的人。

example.en: Don't do harm to animals.
example.cn: 别伤害动物。

example.en: We did our best, but he is still not pleased with us.
example.cn: 我们尽力了，可他还是对我们不满意。

example.en: Did the doctors do their best to operate on the wounded?
example.cn: 这些医生尽最大努力为伤员动手术了吗？

name: do sb. a favour
trans: 点拨 do sb. a favour是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中， 所以学生一定要知道: do sb. a favour与help sb. 意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Do me a favour and close the window.
example.cn: 帮我把窗户关上。

example.en: Can you do some shopping for me?
example.cn: 你能替我买些东西吗？

name: dream of
trans: 点拨 dream of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: dream of与think of或think about意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: I wouldn't dream of studying abroad in the near future.
example.cn: 近期内我不考虑出国留学。

example.en: They all dressed up to take part in the New Year's party.
example.cn: 他们都盛装打扮，去参加新年晚会。

example.en: John and Mary had known each other pretty well before they got married.
example.cn: 约翰和玛丽结婚前已经相当了解对方了。

example.en: Miss Green is kind and patient. She always encourages Roddy to put up his hand in her class.
example.cn: 格林老师和善又耐心。在她的课上她总是鼓励罗迪举手发言。

name: enjoy oneself
trans: 过得愉快；过得快乐；玩得高兴
点拨 enjoy oneself是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: enjoy oneself与have a good time意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: At the yesterday's English Evening, all of us enjoyed ourselves.
example.cn: 昨天的英语晚会上，我们都玩得很开心。

example.en: I can fall asleep anytime and anywhere.
example.cn: 随时随地我都能入睡。

example.en: He lives far away (from us).
example.cn: 他住的地方（离我们）很远。

example.en: He helped us to fill in a big gap in our knowledge.
example.cn: 他帮我们填补了知识上的巨大空白。

example.en: You can look up the dictionary and find out the meaning of the word.
example.cn: 你可以查词典找出这个词的意思。

example.en: We need to focus our efforts on getting the work done.
example.cn: 我们需要集中精力完成这项工作。

name: for example
trans: 点拨 for example和such as的意思都是“例如”，但在用法上是有区别的。
点拨 for example的位置较灵活，可放在句首、句中或句尾，通常用逗号与其所列举的部分隔开，另外，其后面可以是句子，也可以是单词词组。
点拨 such as只能放在其所列举部分的前面，而且不用逗号隔开，后面接的是名词。
点拨 例如，电动自行车可以避免污染。

example.en: For example, the performance of actors and actresses is very important in your film.
example.cn: 例如，在你的电影中，演员的表现是非常重要的。

example.en: For example, a bicycle driven by electricity can avoid pollution.
There are many sources of air pollution; exhaust fumes, for example.
You can get it for free.
example.cn: 你可以免费获取。

example.en: They tasted defeat for the first time.
example.cn: 他们第一次尝到失败的滋味。

example.en: She's staying with her aunt for the time being.
example.cn: 她暂时住在她姨妈那里。

example.en: I can see Hieks at the library from time to time.
example.cn: 我在图书馆有时能看见希克斯。

name: get along
trans: 进展；与⋯⋯相处；和睦相处；关系良好

example.en: I'm sure you' ll get on well with your classmates if you are kind and friendly to them.
example.cn: 如果你对同班同学和蔼友好，我敢肯定你会与他们相处融洽的。

example.en: We should get into the habit of keeping good hours.
example.cn: 我们应该养成早睡早起的习惯。

example.en: As soon as he got off the bus, the poor man realized he had left his wallet on it.
example.cn: 一下车，这个可怜人就意识到他把钱包遗忘在车上了。

example.en: The bus is coming. Be careful when you get on the bus.
example.cn: 车来了。上车时小心。

example.en: Our class teacher asked us if we had got ready for the final exams.
example.cn: 老师问我们是否已为期末考试做好了准备。

example.en: Jane gets angry easily. She'd better get rid of it.
example.cn: 简容易发怒。她最好改掉这个毛病。

example.en: I never get tired of watching the landscape.
example.cn: 我对这景色百看不厌。

example.en: Have we got to the zoo yet?
example.cn: 我们到动物园了吗？

example.en: Yesterday morning I got up early so as not to be late for the exam.
example.cn: 为了考试不迟到，昨天早上我很早起床。

example.en: The youth gave me his hand when I was lifting my baggage.
example.cn: 当我正要提起行李时，那个年轻人帮了我。

name: give up
trans: 点拨 give up是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: give up sth.与stop sth.意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Never giving up is certainly one of the key factors for the old man's achievement.
example.cn: 永不放弃无疑是这位老人取得成就的关键因素之一。

name: go ahead
trans: 先走；向前走；去吧；干吧；继续；着手做

example.en: Cross the street and go ahead.
example.cn: 过马路，一直往前走。

example.en: ——Not at all. Go ahead.
example.cn: 完全不会，你开吧。

example.en: I go to the gym for a swim.
example.cn: 我去健身房游泳。

example.en: They may go hiking around the island, or swimming in the ocean.
example.cn: 他们可以环岛徒步旅行或在海里游泳。

example.en: After the movie,we went home.
example.cn: 看完电影，我们就回家了。

name: go in for
trans: 点拨 go in for是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: go in for与take part in意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Which events is he going in for at the Olympics?
example.cn: 他将在奥运会上参加什么项目？

example.en: They wanted me to go in for film work.
example.cn: 他们要我从事电影工作。

example.en: Many people go in for golf.
example.cn: 许多人喜欢打高尔夫球。

name: go on
trans: 点拨 go on是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: go on与continue意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Now (that) he is well again, he can go on with his English study.
example.cn: 现在他既已恢复了健康，就可以继续学习英语了。

example.en: Maybe you need to go on a diet.
example.cn: 或许你应当节食了。

example.en: Mr. Smith will go on a picnic this Saturday unless the weather is bad.
example.cn: 史密斯先生将于本周六去野餐，除非天气不好去不了。

example.en: They went on with their basketball match in spite of the rain.
example.cn: 他们冒雨继续进行篮球比赛。

example.en: He went on reading the text.
example.cn: 他继续读这篇课文。

example.en: The concert lasted only a few minutes before the power went out.
example.cn: 音乐会只持续了几分钟就停电了。

example.en: You may fail to pass the examination unless you do your best to go over the lessons.
example.cn: 除非你尽力复习，否则你可能无法通过考试。

example.en: I want to go sailing to relax myself.
example.cn: 我想去航海放松一下。

example.en: Since the rain has stopped, why not go shopping now?
example.cn: 现在既然雨停了，为什么不去购物呢？

example.en: Did you go sightseeing last Sunday?
example.cn: 上星期天你是否去观光游览了？

example.en: It is time for me to go to bed.
example.cn: 我睡觉的时间到了。

example.en: I would like all my children to go to college.
example.cn: 我希望我的孩子们都考上大学。

example.en: How do you go to school?
example.cn: 你怎么去上学？

example.en: I am too excited to go to sleep.
example.cn: 我太兴奋了，睡不着。

example.en: She wished to go to the cinema
example.cn: 她昨天想去看电影。

example.en: After feeling unwell for several days, John decided to go to the hospital.
example.cn: 难受了几天，约翰决定还是去医院看一下。

example.en: Your computer will go wrong without any anti-virus software.
example.cn: 你的电脑没有任何杀毒软件会出问题的。

example.en: Children must be educated to serve their country when they grow up.
example.cn: 必须教育孩子长大后为国家效力。

example.en: You had better not forget to bring a power bank when you travel.
example.cn: 你去旅行最好不要忘了带充电宝。

example.en: What a disappointing excuse you've made when failing to hand in your project on time!
example.cn: 你没能按时交项目，找的借口太让人失望了！

example.en: We happened to discover that we had a friend in common.
example.cn: 我们碰巧发现我们有一个共同的朋友。

example.en: An odd thing happened to him this morning.
example.cn: 他今天早晨遇到一件怪事。

example.en: I'm afraid I must be going now. I have a class at ten.
example.cn: 我想我现在得走了。我10点有课。

example.en: You have eight lessons every day,don't you?
example.cn: 你每天有8节课，不是吗？

name: have a good time
trans: 玩得很愉快；过得很愉快
点拨 have a good time是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: have a good time与enjoy oneself意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 =I hope you' ll enjoy yourself

example.en: We had a very good time at the evening party.
example.cn: 我们在晚会上玩得很愉快。

example.en: I hope you' ll have a good time during your stay in Paris next month.
Peter doesn't have breakfast at school every day.
example.cn: 彼得不是每天都在学校用早餐的。

name: have no idea
trans: 点拨 have no idea是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: have no idea与don't know意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: I have no idea what to do.
example.cn: 我不知道该怎么办。

example.en: I always have pity on the beggars.
example.cn: 我总是对乞丐心怀怜悯。

example.en: Does he have sports every day?
example.cn: 他每天运动吗？

name: hear from
trans: 点拨 hear from是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: hear from sb.与receive a letter from sb.意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: I hear from her every week.
example.cn: 我每星期都能收到她的来信。

example.en: I heard of his death last week.
example.cn: 我上周听说了他的死讯。

example.en: Jane will help me with the maths problem.
example.cn: 简将帮助我做数学题。

name: here and there
trans: 点拨 here and there是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: here and there与everywhere意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: We went here and there looking for berries.
example.cn: 我们四处寻找浆果。

example.en: We' ll hold a meeting to exchange experiences.
example.cn: 我们将开个会来交流一下经验。

name: hold on
trans: 点拨 hold on是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: hold on与wait for a moment意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Could you please hold on?
example.cn: 请别挂电话好吗？

example.en: I can hold my breath for about one minute.
example.cn: 我大约可以憋气一分钟。

name: huge amounts of
trans: 点拨 huge amounts of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: huge amounts of与plenty of,a lot of或much意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: They have huge amounts of money.
example.cn: 他们很有钱。

name: in a hurry
trans: 点拨 in a hurry是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: do sth. in a hurry与hurry to do sth.或do sth. hurriedly意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Please dress up in a hurry!
example.cn: 请快点打扮！

example.en: The English teacher isn't here. She has gone to the office and she will be back in a minute.
example.cn: 英语老师不在这里。她已经去了办公室，一会儿就回来。

example.en: In addition, you can get to know a circle of people at your age while playing sports.
example.cn: 另外，在运动时，你可以认识一群同龄人。

name: in all
trans: 点拨 in all是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: in all与altogether意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: There are fifteen books on the first shelf, twenty-one on the second, that makes thirty-six in all.
example.cn: 书架的第一层有15本书，第二层有21本书，总共是36本书。

example.en: In brief, my hometown is a place which is worthy of being visited.
example.cn: 简而言之，我的家乡是一个值得游览的地方。

name: in charge of
trans: 点拨 in charge of是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: be in charge of与manage意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = Mr. Brown manages a large Disneyland Park in Japan.

example.en: The teacher is in charge of the class.
example.cn: 这位教师负责这个班。

example.en: Mr. Brown is in charge of a large Disneyland Park in Japan.
Tom pays attention in class.
example.cn: 汤姆上课非常专心。

example.en: Did the Red Cross provide any medical services to the victims in danger?
example.cn: 红十字会是否为处于危险中的受害者提供医疗服务？

example.en: He wrote a report in English yesterday.
example.cn: 昨天他用英语写了一份报告。

example.en: In fact,he has gone abroad.
example.cn: 事实上，他出国了。

example.en: Are you in favour of this plan?
example.cn: 你赞成这个计划吗？

example.en: Jane felt nervous when she made her first speech in front of the whole school.
example.cn: 当简在全校师生面前第一次演讲时，她感到紧张。

example.en: He was in hospital in Washington.
example.cn: 他在华盛顿住院了。

name: in one' s fifties
trans: 点拨 in one's fifties是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: in his sixties与when he was over sixty意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = My grandpa began to learn how to use a computer when he was over sixty.

example.en: Professor Brown is still very active and enjoys hiking even though he is already in his fifties.
example.cn: 尽管布朗教授已经50多岁了，他仍然非常活跃，喜欢徒步旅行。

example.en: My grandpa began to learn how to use a computer in his sixties.

name: in one' s opinion
trans: 点拨 in one's opinion是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: in one's opinion与I think意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 =I think that children can learn about responsibility from doing some housework.

example.en: In my opinion he is not right.
example.cn: 在我看来，他是错的。

example.en: In my opinion, children can learn about responsibility from doing some housework.

name: in order to
trans: 点拨 in order to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: in order to do与so as to do或so that sb. can do意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 例如: Farmers are using fires to clear the land in order to
点拨 = Farmers are using fires to clear the land so that they can plant crops.
点拨 = Grandma opened the window so that she could breathe the fresh air.
点拨 = Bob made up his mind to study English hard so that he could find a good job.

example.en: Jack provided some more evidence in order to prove his point.
example.cn: 杰克提供了更多证据来证明自己的观点。

example.en: Grandma opened the window in order to breathe the fresh air.
Bob made up his mind to study English hard in order to find a good job.
He became,in other words,a great hero.
example.cn: 换句话说，他成了一位伟大的英雄。

example.en: What did you give him in return?
example.cn: 你给他什么作为报答呢？

example.en: Are you surprised when someone looks at you in surprise?
example.cn: 当有人惊异地看着你时，你感到惊讶吗？

name: in the end
trans: 点拨 in the end是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: in the end与at last或finally意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: In the end, Tom successfully fixed his bicycle without the help of his father.
example.cn: 最后，汤姆没靠爸爸帮忙，成功修好了他的自行车。

example.en: He does not know what will happen in the future.
example.cn: 他不知道将来会发生什么事。

example.en: He positioned the lamp in the middle of the table.
example.cn: 他把灯放在桌子中间。

example.en: The book was banned in the past.
example.cn: 这本书过去是禁书。

example.en: What makes him behave in this way?
example.cn: 是什么原因使他这样做的？

example.en: You must hurry up or you cannot finish it in time.
example.cn: 你必须抓紧些，否则你来不及完成。

example.en: The young policeman always helps the old when they are in trouble.
example.cn: 这个年轻警察在老人有困难时总会帮助他们。

example.en: Lin Dong should learn to solve problems by himself instead of asking others.
example.cn: 林东应该学会独自解决问题，而不是求助别人。

example.en: The experienced detective never jumps to a conclusion when dealing with a new case.
example.cn: 这位经验丰富的侦探处理新案件时从不草率下结论。

name: just now
trans: 点拨 just now是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道：just now与a moment ago意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Oh, my goodness. I left my dictionary in the reading-room just now.
example.cn: 啊，天哪！我刚才把词典忘在阅览室里了。

example.en: I want to keep a diary,but I can't.
example.cn: 我想记日记，可我做不到。

name: keep doing sth.
trans: 点拨 keep doing sth.是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: keep doing sth.与go on doing sth.意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: The machine kept running.
example.cn: 机器一直在运转。

example.en: I practise yoga to keep fit.
example.cn: 我练瑜珈来保持健康。

name: keep … from
trans: 点拨 keep……from是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: keep……from与prevent……from或stop…from意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 例如: Sometimes pet dogs bar k at night and this keeps
点拨 = Sometimes pet dogs bar k at night and this stops their neighbours from sleeping.

example.en: I don't want to keep you from your work.
example.cn: 我不想耽误你的工作。

example.en: How does Jack keep in touch with his friends in America every week?
example.cn: 杰克每周是如何与美国朋友保持联系的？

example.en: The policeman told the boys to keep off the grass.
example.cn: 警察告诉男孩们勿踩草地。

example.en: If you won't keep quiet,you can get out!
example.cn: 如果你不保持安静，那就只好请你出去了！

example.en: That job will keep you busy for a long time.
example.cn: 那项工作会使你忙碌很长时间。

example.en: It's impolite to laugh at people in trouble.
example.cn: 嘲笑处于困境中的人们是不礼貌的。

example.en: She learned everything from me.
example.cn: 她什么都是向我学的。

example.en: May I leave a message,please?
example.cn: 请问，我可以留个口信吗？

example.en: I' ll leave for Beijing tomorrow.
example.cn: 我明天动身去北京。

example.en: I had to seek a living before I left secondary school.
example.cn: 我中学没毕业就去谋生了。

example.en: The production of this factory is less than that of that factory.
example.cn: 这个工厂的产量少于那个工厂。

example.en: I'm talking to you, Jack. Please listen to me carefully.
example.cn: 杰克，我在跟你说话，请仔细听我讲。

example.en: She still lives on her parents.
example.cn: 她仍依靠父母生活。

example.en: Most of Asians live on rice.
example.cn: 多数亚洲人以大米为主食。

name: look after
trans: 点拨 look after是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: look after与take care of意思相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = You'd better take care of your younger brother, Tom.

example.en: As middle school students, we should know how to look after ourselves.
example.cn: 作为中学生，我们应该知道如何照顾自己。

example.en: You'd better look after your younger brother, Tom.
The pupils are all looking at the chart on the wall.
example.cn: 学生都瞧着墙上的图表。

example.en: Her sister wanted to further her study instead of looking for a job.
example.cn: 她妹妹想要继续深造，而不是找工作。

name: look forward to
trans: 点拨 look forward to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: look forward to doing sth.与expect to do sth.意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Little Adam is looking forward to meeting his friend next week.
example.cn: 小亚当期待下周见到他的小伙伴。

example.en: He looks like a scholar.
example.cn: 他看上去像个学者。

name: look out
trans: 点拨 look out是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道:look out与be careful意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: The police reminded the public to look out for pickpockets in crowded areas.
example.cn: 警方提醒公众在拥挤区域要提防扒手。

example.en: You' d better not look up every new word in the dictionary because you can guess it from the context.
example.cn: 你最好不要用词典去查每一个新词，因为你能从上下文中猜到它的意思。

example.en: He had to look up to see the top of the skyscraper.
example.cn: 他不得不抬头才能看到摩天大楼的顶部。

name: lose one' s life
trans: 点拨 lose one'slife是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: lose one's life与die意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: He didn't want to lose his life in the battle field.
example.cn: 他不想在战场上送命。

example.en: If you don't take the map with you, you may lose your way to Shanghai Museum.
Father lost temper after he was told his daughter stole a mobile phone from her deskmate.
example.cn: 父亲得知女儿偷了她同桌的手机后，大发脾气。

example.en: Danny has decided to go on a diet because he wants to lose weight.
example.cn: 丹尼决定节食，因为他想减肥。

example.en: You can make a decision right now. You can also think it over for a couple of days.
example.cn: 你可以现在就做决定，也可以再考虑几天。

example.en: They want to make a film in Shanghai.
example.cn: 他们想在上海拍电影。

example.en: Then we started to make a fire.
example.cn: 然后我们开始生火。

name: make a living
trans: 点拨 make a living是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: make a living与earn money意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: He makes a living by writing.
example.cn: 他以写作为生。

example.en: Tom's father looked angrily at Tom because he had made so many mistakes.
example.cn: 父亲生气地看着汤姆，因为他犯了那么多错误。

example.en: If you make a noise,you' ll scare off the animals.
example.cn: 如果你弄出声响就会把动物吓跑。

example.en: Nobody likes to make friends with dishonest people.
example.cn: 没有人喜欢与不诚实的人交朋友。

example.en: We should not make fun of the weak.
example.cn: 我们不应该取笑弱者。

example.en: We begin to consistently make money.
example.cn: 我们开始持续地盈利。

example.en: It's nice of Andy to help me with my English and I' ve made some progress.
example.cn: 安迪真好，他帮我学英语。我已经取得了一些进步。

name: make sure
trans: 尽力做到；务请；确保；查明；确信

example.en: Please make sure the door is securely locked before you go to bed.
example.cn: 睡前请务必确认门已经牢牢地锁好。

example.en: Does she make the bed in the morning?
example.cn: 她早上整理床铺吗？

name: make up one's mind
trans: 点拨 make up one's mind是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: make up one's mind与decide意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: They made up their minds to sell the house.
example.cn: 他们决定把房子卖掉。

example.en: He forgot the charger for his mobile phone.
example.cn: 他忘了带手机充电器。

example.en: I sat next to a girl whose name was Diane.
example.cn: 我坐在一个名叫黛安的女孩旁边。

name: no longer
trans: 点拨 no longer 是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: no longer 暗含“过去曾是”used to be的意思，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = Shanghai used to be a small fishing village.

example.en: Tom, you are no longer a little boy. You should learn to be independent.
= Tom, you are not a little boy any longer. You should learn to be independent.
example.cn: 汤姆，你不再是一个小男孩了。你应该学会独立。

example.en: Shanghai is not a small fishing village any longer.
He is not worried at all.
example.cn: 他一点都不担心。

name: now and then
trans: 点拨 now and then 是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: now and then与from time to time意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: Now and then we heard shots in the woods.
example.cn: 我们不时听到从森林里传来的枪声。

example.en: He was quite polite, of course, but somehow I didn't like his manner.
example.cn: 当然，他相当有礼貌，但我就是有点儿不喜欢他的举止。

example.en: ——Yes, of course.
How many times do you dine out per week on average?
example.cn: 你每星期通常下几次馆子？

example.en: Has he gone to Paris on business or for pleasure?
example.cn: 他去巴黎是出差还是游玩？

example.en: Today they came here on foot.= Today they walked here.
example.cn: 今天他们是步行过来的。

example.en: I'm on holiday next week.
example.cn: 我下周休假。

example.en: I wish she would be on my side.
example.cn: 我希望她能站在我这边。

example.en: He is naughty,but on the other hand,he is clever.
example.cn: 他是调皮，但另一方面，他很聪明。

example.en: You are wanted on the phone.
example.cn: 有人打电话找你。

example.en: There is little bread in my fridge. Please buy some on your way home.
example.cn: 冰箱里没有面包了，请你在回家的路上买一些。

example.en: Remember to take the pills I gave you on time, one at a time.
example.cn: 记得按时服用我给你的药，一次一片。

example.en: The office is open from 9:00 a. m. to 5:00 p. m. on weekdays.
example.cn: 办事处工作日从上午9点到下午5点开放。

example.en: Olympic is held once every four years.
example.cn: 奥运会每四年举办一次。

example.en: I' ll repeat the question once more.
example.cn: 我把这个问题再重复一次。

example.en: They went into the classroom one after another.
example.cn: 他们一个接一个地走进教室。

example.en: She went out of the room, taking the flowers with her.
example.cn: 她带着花走出了房间。

example.en: A few of the tanks had run out of ammunition.
example.cn: 有几辆坦克的弹药已经用光了。

example.en: This kind of machine is out of date.
example.cn: 这种机器过时了。

name: over and over
trans: 点拨 over and over是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: over and over与again and again意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: He performed his experiment over and over, working till midnight.
example.cn: 他一次次地进行实验直到深夜。

example.en: The teacher told the student to pay attention to his spelling.
example.cn: 老师提醒那个学生要注意拼写。

name: pay for
trans: 点拨 pay for是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: sb. pay money for sth.与sb. purchased sth. for money, sb. spendmoney on 或sth. cost sb. money意思基本相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = Mr. Jones purchased a va se for 30,000 dollars last year.
点拨 = Mr. Jones spent 30,000 dollars on
点拨 =A vase cost Mr. Jones 30,000 dollars last year.

example.en: How much did you pay for the book?
example.cn: 那本书你付了多少钱？

example.en: Mr. Jones paid 30,000 dollars for a vase last year.
Let's pick out the bad potatoes from the basket.
example.cn: 我们把坏掉的土豆从篮子里挑出来吧。

example.en: I picked up your book by mistake.
example.cn: 我错拿了你的书。

example.en: Watching the old man, she was going to play a trick on him.
example.cn: 观察了一下这个老人，她决定捉弄他一把。

example.en: The kid was playing with his ball.
example.cn: 这个孩子在玩球。

name: plenty of
trans: 点拨 plentyof是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要掌握以下固定搭配的用法：
点拨 1) plenty of（很多）,a lot of(lots of)（大量）后面可跟可数名词， 也可跟不可数名词。
点拨 2) a little（一些）, much（许多）,a great(good) deal of（大量）, a large amount of（大量）后面跟不可数名词。
点拨 3) a few（一些）,many（许多）,a large number of（大量）后面跟可数名词。

example.en: She had plenty of imagination.
example.cn: 她有丰富的想象力。

example.en: He pointed out that there was little chance of success.
example.cn: 他指出成功的机会很少。

example.en: The teacher praised him highly for his honesty.
example.cn: 老师大大地表扬了他的诚实。

name: prefer… to
trans: 点拨 prefer……to是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: prefer……to与like……better than或would rather do than do意思基本相同，在句中可以互换。
点拨 = Tina liked watching TV better than reading comic books when she was young.
点拨 = Tina would rather watch TV than read comic books when she was young.
点拨 =I like playing sports outdoors better than watching TV at home.
点拨 =I would rather play sports outdoors than watch TV at home.

example.en: I prefer chemistry to physics.
example.cn: 我喜欢化学甚于物理。

example.en: I prefer staying at home to going outside on a wet day.
example.cn: 下雨天我宁愿待在家里，也不愿外出。

example.en: Tina preferred watching TV to reading comic books when she was young.
I prefer playing sports outdoors to watching TV at home.
The students in our school are busy preparing for our School Art Festival.
example.cn: 我们学校的学生正忙着准备学校的艺术节。

example.en: All of us should try to keep fit and prevent ourselves from eating too much.
example.cn: 我们大家应该努力保持健康，避免吃得过多。

example.en: Nobody can prevent him from running the risk.
example.cn: 没有人能够阻止他去冒险。

example.en: Trees should be well protected from the cold during winter.
example.cn: 冬天要保护好树木以防冻坏。

name: provide … with
trans: 点拨 provide……with是常考词组，常出现在保持句意基本不变的句型转换练习中，所以学生一定要知道: provide with food与get food ready（准备食物）意思相同，在句中可以互换。

example.en: This restaurant provides customers with various food choices.
example.cn: 这家餐厅为顾客提供各种各样的美食选择。

example.en: We' ve decided to put off the spring outing till next week because of the bad weather.
example.cn: 因为天气不好，我们已经决定将春游推迟到下周。

example.en: Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.
example.cn: 今日事， 今日毕。

example.en: Please put on your jacket.
example.cn: 请穿上夹克衫。

example.en: A film will be put on.
example.cn: 电影即将上映。

example.en: The firemen fought bravely and put out the forest fire in the end.
example.cn: 消防队员英勇奋战，最终扑灭了森林大火。

example.en: Please put up your hand if you have any questions.
example.cn: 谁有问题， 请举手。

example.en: We'd better put up a notice here.
example.cn: 我们最好在这儿贴一张通知。

example.en: We often refer to these books in our work.
example.cn: 我们工作中经常参考这些书。

example.en: Being independent means believing in yourself without relying on others.
example.cn: 独立意味着相信自己，不依赖他人。

example.en: When I saw a wolf,I ran away.
example.cn: 当我看见狼时，拔腿就跑。

example.en: We have run out of petrol.
example.cn: 我们的汽油已用完。

example.en: China is a developing country.
example.cn: 中国是一个发展中国家。

example.en: Can you give me an example of what you mean?
example.cn: 你能给我举个实例来解释你的意思吗?

example.en: He was absent from school yesterday.
example.cn: 他昨天没上学。

name: account
trans: n. 账户，账号；解释，说明
词组 account for(数量上、比例上)占

example.en: Using a password manager is a much safer way to protect your online accounts.
example.cn: 使用密码管理器是保护你网络账户的一种安全得多的方法。

example.en: The witness provided a clear account of what happened that night.
example.cn: 目击者对当晚发生的事情提供了清晰的说明。

example.en: Each of us must take responsibility for our own actions.
example.cn: 我们每个人都必须对自己的行为负责。

example.en: Everyone admires her strength of character and determination.
example.cn: 每一个人都钦佩她坚强的性格和决心。

example.en: We need more research to understand how AI can help us in language learning.
example.cn: 我们需要更多研究，以了解人工智能如何在语言学习方面帮助我们。

name: aid
trans: n. 援助；帮助；辅助物；援助款项

example.en: The UN has agreed to allow the supply of emergency aid.
example.cn: 联合国已达成协议，允许提供紧急援助。

example.en: Gentle exercise will aid your recovery.
example.cn: 轻度运动将帮助你康复。

example.en: The ancients were in the habit of reading aloud even when alone.
example.cn: 古人习惯于大声朗读，即使独处也不例外。

example.en: The ant is carrying a crumb.
example.cn: 蚂蚁正搬运着一粒面包屑。

name: anyway
trans: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样；不过；总之；而且；加之

example.en: Anyway, we need to finish this task.
example.cn: 无论如何，我们得完成这项任务。

example.en: Your old phone works perfectly well, and anyway, you should save money.
example.cn: 你的旧手机明明很好用，而且，你也该省点钱。

example.en: The apartment rents for $500 a month.
example.cn: 这套房每月租金500美元。

name: app
trans: n. 应用程序；应用软件

example.en: People can communicate easily with foreigners with the help of translation apps.
example.cn: 借助翻译软件，人们能够轻松地与外国人交流。

example.en: He was so exhausted that he fell asleep at his desk.
example.cn: 他太累了，竟伏在书桌上睡着了。

name: astronaut
trans: n. 宇航员；航天飞行员

example.en: He is determined to become an astronaut.
example.cn: 他立志要当一名宇航员。

example.en: Athletes need a good sense of balance.
example.cn: 运动员要有良好的平衡感。

example.en: Nothing can awake her interest in this subject.
example.cn: 什么都激发不了她对这门学科的兴趣。

example.en: The patient remains fully awake.
example.cn: 病人仍是醒着的。

name: aware
trans: 词组 be aware of 注意；意识到；知道

example.en: Everybody should be made aware of the risks involved.
example.cn: 应该让每个人都知道其中的风险。

example.en: I like playing badminton with my friends.
example.cn: 我喜欢和朋友们一起打羽毛球。

example.en: The panda eats bamboo.

example.cn: 她的帽子式样和我的相同。

example.cn: 这是一部经典电影。

example.cn: 小说《傲慢与偏见》被认为是英国文学经典。

example.cn: 你需要的是一位戏剧导师。

example.cn: 饺子也是传统的新年食物。

example.cn: 鹰在空中盘旋。
