example.cn: 学生们在操场上玩耍。

name: super-excited
trans: adj. 超级激动的；格外兴奋的

example.en: She was super-excited when she got the prize.
example.cn: 她获奖时超级激动。

example.en: The cake is very tasty.
example.cn: 这个蛋糕非常美味。

name: track
trans: 词组 keep track of追踪

example.en: The athletes are running on the track.
example.cn: 运动员在跑道上跑步。

name: warm up
trans: 适应性活动，准备活动；热身练习

example.en: You should warm up before doing exercise.
example.cn: 你在做运动前应该热身。

example.en: The sign is a warning of danger.
example.cn: 这个标志是危险警示。

example.en: Watch out!There is a car coming.
example.cn: 小心！有辆车来了。

example.en: You finished the work so quickly.Well done!
example.cn: 你这么快就完成了工作。干得好！

example.en: You look sad.What's the matter?
example.cn: 你看起来很伤心。怎么了?

name: announcement
trans: 词组 make an announcement发布公告

example.en: The school made an announcement about the upcoming sports meeting.
example.cn: 学校发布了一则关于即将召开的运动会的公告。

example.en: Beg your pardon, could you repeat what you just said?
example.cn: 抱歉，你能重复一下刚才说的话吗？

name: break out
trans: 点拨 happen通常指偶然发生。
点拨 take place指有计划、有安排地发生。

example.en: A fire broke out in the old building last night.
example.cn: 昨晚那栋旧楼突发火灾。

example.en: The war broke out unexpectedly.
example.cn: 战争毫无征兆地发生了。

name: broken
trans: adj. 破损的； 伤残的

example.en: Be careful of the broken glass on the ground.
example.cn: 小心地上的碎玻璃。

example.en: After the accident, he had to use a wheelchair due to a broken leg.
example.cn: 事故发生后他断了一条腿，不得不坐轮椅。

example.en: The bulb in the ceiling light has burned out. Could you please change it for me?
example.cn: 吸顶灯里的灯泡坏了，你能帮我换一下吗？

example.en: The temperature today is 25 degrees Celsius.
example.cn: 今天的温度是25摄氏度。

name: changer
trans: n. 改变者； 改进者

example.en: He is a changer in our school, bringing new ideas and methods.
example.cn: 他是我们学校的变革者，带来了新的点子和方法。

name: check out
trans: 察看，观察（有趣或有吸引力的人或事物）

example.en: Check out the new art exhibition at the museum. It's really amazing.
example.cn: 去看看博物馆的新艺术展览，真的很棒。

name: cloth
trans: 点拨 cloth,clothes和clothing的词义和用法区别， 可参考考纲词汇310. clothes.

example.en: This cloth feels very soft and comfortable.
example.cn: 这种布料摸起来非常柔软舒适。

example.en: Coal is still an important energy source in some regions.
example.cn: 在某些地区，煤仍然是重要的能源来源。

name: colourful
trans: adj. 颜色鲜艳的； 五彩缤纷的

example.en: The children drew a very colourful picture of a rainbow.
example.cn: 孩子们画了一幅色彩非常鲜艳的彩虹画。

example.en: Put the water into a plastic container.
example.cn: 把水倒入一个塑料容器里。

example.en: She has long curly hair that makes her look very cute.
example.cn: 她有一头长长的卷发，使她看起来非常可爱。

example.en: My new neighbour is very easy-going and we get along well.
example.cn: 我的新邻居非常随和，我们相处得很好。

name: environmental
trans: 词组 environmental protection环境保护
词组 environmental problem环境问题

example.en: We should take some environmental protection measures to save our planet.
example.cn: 我们应该采取一些环境保护措施来拯救我们的星球。

example.en: Take the escalator to the second floor, and you can find the clothing store.
example.cn: 乘自动扶梯到二楼，你就能找到服装店。

name: excite
trans: v. 使激动； 使兴奋

example.en: The news of the school trip excited all the students.
example.cn: 学校旅行的消息让所有学生都很兴奋。

name: extreme
trans: adj. 极度的； 极大的

example.en: We are facing extreme weather conditions, such as heavy snow and strong winds.
example.cn: 我们正面临极端的天气状况，比如大雪和强风。

example.en: It was a foggy morning, and the visibility was very low.
example.cn: 那是一个雾蒙蒙的早晨，能见度很低。

name: gap
trans: 词组 the gap between…and …和……之间的差距/间隙

example.en: There is a small gap between the two boards.
example.cn: 两块木板之间有个小缝隙。

name: harvest
trans: n. 收获； 收获季节
词组 harvest time收获时节
词组 busy with the harvest忙于收获

example.en: The farmers are very happy with the good harvest this year.
example.cn: 农民们因今年的好收成特别高兴。

example.en: The city was hit by a severe heatwave last summer.
example.cn: 去年夏天，这座城市遭受了严重的热浪袭击。

example.en: Many herbs are used in cooking to add flavour.
example.cn: 许多香草被用于烹饪以增添风味。

name: hurrah
trans: 点拨 hurrah是感叹词，用于表达欢呼、喜悦、庆祝等强烈的积极情绪。类似的表达还有hurray,yay等，通常用于口语和非正式写作中，书写时常用感叹号加强语气。

example.en: Hurrah! We won the first prize in the competition!
example.cn: 万岁！ 我们在比赛中获得了一等奖！

example.en: It's too cold outside, so we stay indoors and watch TV.
example.cn: 外面太冷了，所以我们待在室内看电视。

name: inexpensive
trans: adj. 廉价的； 不昂贵的

example.en: You can buy some inexpensive souvenirs at this local market.
example.cn: 你可以在这个当地市场买到一些便宜的纪念品。

example.en: She leaned on/ against her friend's shoulder when she felt sad.
example.cn: 她难过的时候靠在朋友的肩膀上。

example.en: The old house leant to one side.
example.cn: 这座老房子向一侧倾斜。

example.en: We should use more low-energy appliances to save resources.
example.cn: 我们应该使用更多低能耗的电器来节约资源。

example.en: According to the lunar calendar, the Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.
example.cn: 根据农历，春节是中国最重要的传统节日。

example.en: Mankind has made remarkable progress in science and technology.
example.cn: 人类在科学技术方面取得了显著的进步。

example.en: I usually go to bed before midnight to keep a good schedule.
example.cn: 我通常在午夜前上床睡觉，以保持良好的作息。

name: million
trans: 词组 millions of数以百万计的；很多
点拨 million前有具体数字时，无论数字是几，million都用单数形式；表示数量极多但不确切的情况时，用millions of，后接可数名词复数，类似的表达还有thousands of“数以千计的”、hundreds of“数以百计的”。

example.en: The company made a profit of three million dollars last year.
example.cn: 这家公司去年盈利300万美元。

example.en: The population of the city is over five million people.
There are millions of stars in the sky.
example.cn: 天空中有数以百万计的星星。

example.en: Millions of people travel abroad every year.
example.cn: 每年有数百万人出国旅行。

name: mostly
trans: adv. 主要地； 一般地； 通常

example.en: The students in this class are mostly from the local area.
example.cn: 这个班的学生大多来自当地。

name: musical
trans: 词组 musical performance音乐表演

example.en: She has a great musical talent and can play several instruments.
example.cn: 她有很棒的音乐天赋，会演奏好几种乐器。

example.en: We watched a wonderful musical in the theatre last night.
example.cn: 昨晚我们在剧院看了一场精彩的音乐剧。

example.en: The nightingale's song is very beautiful and can be heard in the forest at night.
example.cn: 夜莺的歌声非常美妙，晚上在森林里能听到。

example.en: Check the noticeboard regularly, as there are always some important announcements.
example.cn: 定期查看布告栏，因为总是有一些重要通知。

name: nut
trans: 词组 a hard nut to crack棘手的问题；难对付的人

example.en: Nuts are a good source of protein and healthy fats.
example.cn: 坚果是蛋白质和健康脂肪的良好来源。

name: pass on
trans: 传递；转交；（用后）递给，传给

example.en: Please pass on this message to your parents when you get home.
example.cn: 你到家时请把这个消息转告给你的父母。

example.en: After reading the book, pass it on to a friend.
example.cn: 读完这本书后，把它传给一位朋友。

example.en: The mother patted her baby gently on the back to make him stop crying.
example.cn: 妈妈轻轻地拍着宝宝的背，让他停止哭泣。

example.en: The peacock spread its colourful tail feathers to show off its beauty.
example.cn: 孔雀展开它色彩斑斓的尾羽来炫耀自己的美丽。

example.en: Penicillin has saved countless lives since it was discovered.
example.cn: 青霉素自被发现以来，拯救了无数生命。

example.en: Everyone has a unique personality, which makes them different from others.
example.cn: 每个人都有独特的个性，这使他们与众不同。

example.en: The power station provides electricity for the whole city.
example.cn: 这座发电站为整个城市供电。

name: regards
trans: 词组 with kind regards（常用于信件结尾）致以亲切的问候

example.en: Please give my regards to your parents when you see them.
example.cn: 见到你父母时，请代我向他们问好。

example.en: Jerry's family has made the fifth day of each month their reunion day.
example.cn: 杰瑞一家把每月的5号定为家庭团聚日。

name: reusable
trans: adj. 可重复使用的；可再次使用的

example.en: We should use more reusable bags instead of plastic bags to protect the environment.
example.cn: 我们应该多用可重复使用的袋子，而不是塑料袋，以保护环境。

example.en: The plane landed safely on the runway after a long flight.
example.cn: 经过长时间的飞行，飞机安全降落在跑道上。

example.en: The firefighters are the savers in the fire, rescuing people from danger.
example.cn: 消防员在火灾中是救助者，把人们从危险中解救出来。

name: sort
trans: 词组 sort out整理；解决
词组 sort sth. into…把某物分类为…
词组 sort sth. by…根据…对某物进行分类
词组 all sorts of各种各样的
词组 a sort of一种

example.en: You should sort your clothes by colour before putting them in the wardrobe.
example.cn: 你应该先把衣服按颜色分类，再放进衣柜。

example.en: What sort of music do you like best?
example.cn: 你最喜欢那种音乐？

example.en: Spring rolls are a popular snack during the Chinese New Year.
example.cn: 春卷是春节期间很受欢迎的小吃。

example.en: The storyteller can always attract a lot of children with his interesting stories.
example.cn: 这个讲故事的人总能用他有趣的故事吸引很多孩子。

example.en: We sat in the garden, enjoying the warm sunshine.
example.cn: 我们坐在花园里，享受着温暖的阳光。

example.en: "You swan, he frog"has become a popular internet catchphrase.
The symphony performed by the famous orchestra was really amazing.
example.cn: 著名管弦乐队演奏的这首交响乐真是太棒了。

example.en: We take turns to clean the classroom.= We clean the classroom in turn.
example.cn: 我们轮流打扫教室。

example.en: Einstein's theory of relativity is one of the most important scientific theories in history.
example.cn: 爱因斯坦的相对论是历史上最重要的科学理论之一。

example.en: Traditional Chinese Medicine has a long history and unique treatment methods.
example.cn: 中医药有着悠久的历史和独特的治疗方法。

example.en: Hamlet is one of Shakespeare's most famous tragedies.
example.cn: 《哈姆雷特》是莎士比亚最著名的悲剧之一。

name: unique
trans: adj. 唯一的；独一无二的

example.en: The old town tells lively stories about Shanghai's past and its unique culture.
example.cn: 这座古镇讲述着关于上海的过往和独特文化的生动故事。

example.en: My alarm clock goes off at 6:00 every morning.
example.cn: 我的闹钟每天早上6点响。

example.en: She has a very artistic taste.
example.cn: 她很有艺术品味。

example.en: The Great Wall is a major tourist attraction in China.
example.cn: 长城是中国主要的旅游胜地。

example.en: His belief in hard work led to his success.
example.cn: 他对努力工作的信念使他获得了成功。

example.en: She has a successful career in business.
example.cn: 她在商业领域有成功的事业。

example.en: The football fans chanted their team's name.
example.cn: 球迷们反复呼喊着他们球队的名字。

example.en: Good communication is very important in a relationship.
example.cn: 良好的沟通在人际关系中非常重要。

example.en: The actors wore beautiful costumes in the play.
example.cn: 演员们在剧中穿着漂亮的演出服。

name: countless
trans: adj. 无数的； 数不尽的

example.en: Modern technology has rescued countless lives in the medical field.
example.cn: 现代科技在医疗领域拯救了无数人的生命。

example.en: She is a well-known fashion designer.
example.cn: 她是一位著名的时装设计师。

example.en: My deskmate is very helpful.
example.cn: 我的同桌很乐于助人。

example.en: This is a new device for measuring temperature.
example.cn: 这是一种测量温度的新仪器。

example.en: To my disappointment,I didn't pass the exam.
example.cn: 令我失望的是，我没有通过考试。

example.en: Honesty is an important element in a friendship.
example.cn: 诚实是友谊中的一个重要要素。

name: enter for
trans: 点拨 enter for,attend,join,join in和take part in的用法区别，可参考考纲词汇843.join.

example.en: I decided to enter for the singing competition.
example.cn: 我决定报名参加歌唱比赛。

example.en: The clown entertained the children with funny tricks.
example.cn: 小丑用有趣的把戏逗孩子们开心。

name: firmly
trans: adv. 坚定地； 坚固地

example.en: He held the rope firmly.
example.cn: 他紧紧地抓住绳子。

example.en: The river flows through the city.
example.cn: 这条河流经这座城市。

example.en: The fireflies glow in the dark.
example.cn: 萤火虫在黑暗中发光。

example.en: The teacher's guidance helped me a lot.
example.cn: 老师的指导对我帮助很大。

example.en: I have an appointment with my hairdresser tomorrow for a haircut.
example.cn: 我明天约了理发师剪头发。

example.en: The handle of the cup is broken.
example.cn: 杯子的把手断了。

example.en: We have a lot in common, such as our hobbies.
example.cn: 我们有很多共同之处，比如我们的爱好。

example.en: The government is trying to improve the health care system.
example.cn: 政府正在努力改善医疗服务体系。

example.en: The heating in our house doesn't work well.
example.cn: 我们家的暖气设备不太好用。

name: holder
trans: 词组 phone holder手机支架

example.en: This is a pen holder.
example.cn: 这是一个笔筒。

example.en: Hopefully, we can finish the work on time.
example.cn: 我们有望按时完成工作。

example.en: Children usually have a rich imagination.
example.cn: 孩子们通常有丰富的想象力。

example.en: It's impolite to talk loudly in public places, but many people always seem to forget that.
example.cn: 在公共场所大声喧哗是不礼貌的行为，但许多人似乎总是忘记这一点。

example.en: Your answer is incorrect.
example.cn: 你的答案不准确。

example.en: We should keep track of our expenses.
example.cn: 我们应该追踪我们的开支。

example.en: There are several layers of clouds in the sky.
example.cn: 天空中有几层云。

example.en: He is one of the leading scientists in this field.
example.cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家之一。

example.en: Tourism is the lifeblood of this small town.
example.cn: 旅游业是这个小镇的生命线。

example.en: She spends a lot of time on her make-up.
example.cn: 她花很多时间化妆。

example.en: This is a meaningful activity.
example.cn: 这是一项有意义的活动。

example.en: The new mode of transportation is very convenient.
example.cn: 这种新的交通方式非常方便。

example.en: Paper cutting is a traditional Chinese art.
example.cn: 剪纸是中国的传统艺术。

example.en: He is a professional photographer.
example.cn: 他是一名专业摄影师。

example.en: The fifth book he wrote is my favourite because it has the most exciting plot.
example.cn: 他写的第5本书是我的最爱，因为它有最精彩的情节。

example.en: This is a busy port.
example.cn: 这是一个繁忙的港口。

example.en: There are many posters on the wall.
example.cn: 墙上有很多海报。

example.en: This is a very practical tool.
example.cn: 这是一个非常实用的工具。

example.en: We are making preparations for the party.
example.cn: 我们正在为聚会做准备工作。

example.en: The printing of this book is very good.
example.cn: 这本书的印刷质量很好。

example.en: He showed great readiness to help others.
example.cn: 他表现得很乐于助人。

example.en: He didn't respond to my question.
example.cn: 他没有回答我的问题。

example.en: We had a picnic by the riverside.
example.cn: 我们在河畔野餐。

example.en: The police arrived at the scene of the accident.
example.cn: 警察到达了事故现场。

example.en: The ship began to sink.
example.cn: 船开始下沉。

example.en: Solar cells can convert sunlight into electricity.
example.cn: 太阳能电池可以将阳光转化为电能。

example.en: The house is equipped with solar panels.
example.cn: 这幢房子安装了太阳能电池板。

example.en: The new cartoon is full of amazing special effects that make it fun to watch.
example.cn: 这部新动画片充满了令人惊叹的特效，看起来很有趣。

example.en: I saw a spider on the wall.
example.cn: 我在墙上看到一只蜘蛛。

example.en: The children like to collect stickers.
example.cn: 孩子们喜欢收集贴纸。

example.en: Don't talk to strangers.
example.cn: 不要和陌生人说话。

example.en: I usually watch English movies with Chinese subtitles.
example.cn: 我通常看带有中文字幕的英语电影。

example.en: The tailor made a beautiful dress for her.
example.cn: 裁缝为她做了一件漂亮的连衣裙。

example.en: I received a text message from my friend.
example.cn: 我收到了朋友的一条短信。

example.en: The trainer is teaching the athletes some new skills.
example.cn: 教练正在教运动员一些新技巧。

example.en: This problem is really troublesome. We need to find a way to solve it.
example.cn: 这个问题真令人烦恼。我们得想办法解决它。

example.en: I truly believe that he will succeed.
example.cn: 我确实相信他会成功。

example.en: The waterfall looks so magnificent.
example.cn: 瀑布看起来非常壮观。

example.en: He loves to windsurf on the sea during the holidays.
example.cn: 他喜欢在假期去海上做帆板运动。

example.en: We went for a walk in the woods.
example.cn: 我们去树林里散步。

example.en: The two men were wrestling on the mat.
example.cn: 这两个男人在垫子上摔跤。

example.en: She has a strong southern accent, which makes her words sound very charming.
example.cn: 她有很重的南方口音，这让她的话听起来很有韵味。

example.en: I accidentally met my old friend on the street yesterday.
example.cn: 我昨天在街上偶然遇到了我的老朋友。

example.en: We need to carefully analyse the problem before we find a solution.
example.cn: 在找到解决方案之前，我们需要仔细分析这个问题。

example.en: I submitted my application for the scholarship last week.
example.cn: 我上周提交了奖学金申请。

example.en: As usual, he gets up early and goes for a run in the park.
example.cn: 像往常一样，他早起去公园跑步。

name: best-known
trans: 点拨 best-known是well-known的最高级形式，用于强调某人或某物在某个范围内最广为人知。常与one of搭配,one of the best-known+名词复数，表示“最知名的⋯⋯之一”。

example.en: This is one of the best-known museums in the world.
example.cn: 这是世界上最知名的博物馆之一。

example.en: The tourist office provides a free booklet about the local attractions.
example.cn: 旅游局提供了一本关于当地景点的免费小册子。

example.en: Some volunteers have removed the broken branches from the road already.
example.cn: 一些志愿者已经把路上折断的树枝清理掉了。

example.en: He calmly faced the challenging situation.
example.cn: 他沉着面对这具有挑战性的情形。

name: cast
trans: v. 投（钓线）； 抛（钓钩）

example.en: He cast the line into the water, hoping for a big catch.
example.cn: 他把钓线抛入河中，希望能钓到大鱼。

example.en: The chart shows the changes in the company's sales over the past year.
example.cn: 这张图表显示了公司过去一年的销售变化。

name: check out
trans: 借阅；借出；查看；结账离开；核实

example.en: You can check out three books at a time from the library.
example.cn: 你一次可以从图书馆借阅三本书。

example.en: We need to check out of the hotel before noon.
example.cn: 我们需要在中午前退房。

example.en: Please check out the facts before you make a statement.
example.cn: 在发表声明前请先核实事实。

example.en: All the students cheered for their classmates in the sports meeting.
example.cn: 运动会上，所有学生都为他们的同学加油助威。

example.en: The chorus sang a beautiful song at the concert.
example.cn: 合唱团在音乐会上演唱了一首优美的歌曲。

example.en: Mozart's music is a typical example of classical music.
example.cn: 莫扎特的音乐是古典音乐的典型代表。

example.en: We need to donate some warm clothing to the poor in winter.
example.cn: 冬天我们需要给穷人捐赠一些保暖衣物。

example.en: I always read the sports column in the newspaper every morning.
example.cn: 我每天早上都会读报纸上的体育专栏。

example.en: This box contains all my old books.
example.cn: 这个箱子装着我所有的旧书。

name: coverage
trans: 词组 media coverage媒体报道
词组 insurance coverage保险范围

example.en: The coverage of this wireless network is very wide, reaching most areas of the city.
example.cn: 这个无线网络的覆盖范围很广，涵盖了城市的大部分地区。

name: cultural
trans: adj. 文化的；与文化有关的
词组 cultural heritage文化遗产
词组 cultural exchange文化交流

example.en: We should respect different cultural traditions when travelling abroad.
example.cn: 出国旅行时我们应该尊重不同的文化传统。

example.en: The museum has a special display of ancient artifacts.
example.cn: 博物馆有一个古代文物的特别展览。

example.en: She displayed her artwork at the local gallery.
example.cn: 她在当地画廊展出了自己的艺术作品。

example.en: He works hard to earn enough money to support his family.
example.cn: 他努力工作以挣得足够的钱来养家。

example.en: We should take good care of the elderly in our society.
example.cn: 我们应该好好照顾社会上的老年人。

example.en: He felt a great sense of embarrassment when he forgot his lines on stage.
example.cn: 他在舞台上忘词时感到非常难堪。

example.en: People often use emojis to express their emotions in online communication.
example.cn: 人们在网络交流中经常使用表情符号来表达自己的情感。

name: even though
trans: 点拨 even though引导让步状语从句，在书面和口语中表达转折、让步关系。它与although,though意思相近，但even though语气更强。

example.en: Even though it was raining heavily, he still went to school on time.
example.cn: 尽管雨下得很大，他仍然按时去上学。

example.en: Factory-farmed chickens are more common in the market these days.
example.cn: 如今，工厂化养殖的鸡在市场上更为常见。

name: fault
trans: 词组 at fault有过错；应负责任
词组 find fault with挑剔；找茬

example.en: It's not my fault that the plan failed.
example.cn: 计划失败不是我的错。

name: fellow
trans: adj. 同类的； 同伴的

example.en: We are fellow students,so we should help each other.
example.cn: 我们是同学，所以应该互相帮助。

example.en: He's a funny fellow who always knows how to make us laugh.
example.cn: 他是个有趣的家伙，总是知道如何引我们笑。

example.en: I received a flyer about a new restaurant opening nearby.
example.cn: 我收到了一张附近新开餐厅的广告传单。

name: freshwater
trans: 词组 freshwater ecosystem淡水生态系统
词组 freshwater resources淡水资源

example.en: Freshwater fish live in rivers, lakes and ponds.
example.cn: 淡水鱼生活在河流、湖泊和池塘里。

name: gesture
trans: 词组 make a gesture做手势
词组 gesture for/to sb.向某人做手势

example.en: He made a gesture of welcome when he saw his friend.
example.cn: 他看到朋友时做了一个欢迎的手势。

example.en: The tour guide gestured for the group to follow him.
example.cn: 导游做手势示意团队跟着他。

name: giant
trans: adj. 巨大的；特大的；伟大的

example.en: The giant pumpkin at the fall festival weighed over 500 pounds, breaking the previous record.
example.cn: 秋收节上这只巨大的南瓜超过了500磅，打破了之前的纪录。

example.en: The giant in the fairy tale lived in a castle high atop the mountain.
example.cn: 童话故事里的巨人住在山顶上的城堡里。

name: grateful
trans: adj. 感激的；表示感谢的
词组 be grateful to sb.for sth.因某事感激某人

example.en: I'm very grateful to my teacher for her help.
example.cn: 我非常感激老师对我的帮助。

name: habitat
trans: n. （动植物的）生活环境，栖息地

example.en: The destruction of the forest has greatly affected the habitat of wild animals.
example.cn: 森林的破坏极大地影响了野生动物的栖息地。

example.en: He hung his coat on the hook by the door.
example.cn: 他把外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

example.en: She hooked the picture frame on the nail on the wall.
example.cn: 她把相框挂在墙上的钉子上。

example.en: The weather in the south is often humid, especially in summer.
example.cn: 南方的天气通常很潮湿，尤其是在夏天。

name: impress
trans: v. 给⋯⋯留下深刻的好印象

example.en: The performance of the young singer impressed the audience deeply.
example.cn: 这位年轻歌手的表演给观众留下了深刻的印象。

example.en: You should go to the office and talk to the manager in person.
example.cn: 你应该去办公室亲自和经理谈谈。

example.en: The jasmine in the garden is in full bloom,filling the air with a sweet fragrance.
example.cn: 花园里的茉莉盛开了，空气中弥漫着甜甜的香气。

example.en: Eating too much junk food can lead to health problems.
example.cn: 吃太多垃圾食品会导致健康问题。

example.en: The act of distributing leaflets for advertising is outdated.
example.cn: 靠发传单打广告已经落伍了。

name: lifetime
trans: n. 一生；终身；有生之年
词组 in one's lifetime在某人的一生中

example.en: She has been passionate about painting all her lifetime.
example.cn: 她一生都热衷于绘画。

example.en: I like to look through magazines during my break.
example.cn: 我喜欢在休息时间浏览杂志。

example.en: Please lower your voice.We are in the library.
example.cn: 请你小声一点。我们在图书馆里。

example.en: The lower branches of the tree were easier to reach for picking fruits.
example.cn: 长在较低树枝上的果子更容易被摘到。

example.en: I love the lyrics of this song.They are so meaningful.
example.cn: 我喜欢这首歌的歌词。它们非常有意义。

example.en: The melody of this piece of music is very catchy.
example.cn: 这首曲子的旋律非常朗朗上口。

example.en: The ice will melt when the temperature rises.
example.cn: 温度升高时，冰会融化。

example.en: Don't misunderstand me. I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
example.cn: 别误解我。我没想伤害你的感情。

example.en: The birds are building a nest in the tree.
example.cn: 鸟儿们正在树上筑巢。

name: not only…but also…
trans: 点拨 not only……but also……用于连接两个并列的成分，可以是名词、动词、形 容词、副词等，强调递进关系，表示“不但⋯⋯而且⋯⋯”。当连接两个主语时， 谓语动词遵循就近原则，即与but also后的主语在人称和数上保持一致。例如：

example.en: The toy models at the store are not only for children but also for adults.
example.cn: 店里的玩具模型不仅适合儿童，也适合成年人。

example.en: Not only you but also he enjoys hiking in the mountains.
example.cn: 你和他都喜欢在山上徒步。

name: operator
trans: n. 电话员； 接线员

example.en: I called the operator to ask for help.
example.cn: 我打电话给接线员寻求帮助。

name: palm
trans: 词组 read one's palm看手相

example.en: He held the coin in the palm of his hand.
example.cn: 他把硬币握在手心里。

example.en: I created a new playlist with all my favourite songs.
example.cn: 我为所有喜欢的歌曲创建了一个新的音乐播放清单。

example.en: Pop is very popular among young people.
example.cn: 流行音乐在年轻人中非常受欢迎。

example.en: The pop song became a chart-topping hit within days of its release.
example.cn: 这首流行歌曲在发布的几天之内就成为了排行榜的热门单曲。

example.en: A squirrel popped out from behind the tree.
example.cn: 从树后突然蹿出一只松鼠。

example.en: The popularity of smartphones has changed our way of life.
example.cn: 智能手机的流行改变了我们的生活方式。

name: preference
trans: 词组 have a preference for偏爱…
词组 in preference to优先于

example.en: I have a preference for classical music rather than pop music.
example.cn: 比起流行音乐，我更喜欢古典音乐。

example.en: We should take measures for the protection of wild animals.
example.cn: 我们应该采取措施保护野生动物。

example.en: On the ninth page of the guide, you'll find recommendations for best restaurants.
example.cn: 在指南的第9页，你会找到最佳餐厅推荐。

name: request
trans: 词组 at sb.'s request应某人的要求
词组 make a request提出请求

example.en: I received a request from my boss to finish the report by tomorrow.
example.cn: 我收到老板的要求，明天前完成这份报告。

example.en: The customer requested a refund for the damaged product.
example.cn: 顾客就损坏的商品要求退款。

example.en: The rhythm of this dance music is very strong.
example.cn: 这首舞曲的节奏非常强烈。

example.en: I bought a second-hand bike, which is much cheaper than a new one.
example.cn: 我买了一辆二手自行车，比新的便宜多了。

name: smoothly
trans: smooth adj.光滑的；顺利的；平稳的

example.en: The presentation went smoothly, and everyone was satisfied.
example.cn: 演示进行得相当顺利，每个人都很满意。

example.en: Social media helps us get news, but it may also include false information.
example.cn: 社交媒体帮助我们获取新闻，但它也可能包含虚假信息。

example.en: She performed the dance solo, attracting everyone's attention.
example.cn: 她独自表演了这支舞蹈，吸引了所有人的注意。

example.en: His solo in the concert was really amazing.
example.cn: 他在音乐会上的独奏非常精彩。

example.en: Be careful not to spill the coffee on the table.
example.cn: 小心别把咖啡洒在桌子上。

example.en: He has a stutter,so he is a little shy to speak in public.
example.cn: 他有口吃，所以在公众场合说话有点害羞。

example.en: He stuttered when he tried to answer the teacher's question.
example.cn: 他试着回答老师的问题时结巴了。

name: suitable
trans: 词组 be suitable for适合…
词组 be suitable to do sth.适合做某事

example.en: This book is suitable for children aged 8-12.
example.cn: 这本书适合8到12岁的孩子。

example.en: He wiped the sweat from his forehead after running.
example.cn: 他跑步后擦去额头上的汗。

example.en: The intense heat made everyone sweat within minutes of being outside.
example.cn: 烈日炎炎使得每个人在外面待几分钟就开始出汗。

example.en: The theme of this symphony is about love and hope.
example.cn: 这首交响曲的主题是关于爱与希望。

example.en: The bird is singing happily on the treetop.
example.cn: 鸟儿在树梢上欢快地歌唱。

example.en: The sound of the trumpet filled the concert hall.
example.cn: 小号的声音充满了音乐厅。

example.en: The elephant used its trunk to pick up the log.
example.cn: 大象用它的鼻子卷起了木头。

example.en: (the unknown) n.
example.cn: 未知的事物；默默无闻的人

example.en: He was an unknown writer before his first novel was published.
example.cn: 在他的第一部小说出版之前，他是个不出名的作家。

example.en: Embracing the unknown can lead to unexpected opportunities and growth.
example.cn: 拥抱未知可能会带来意想不到的机遇和成长。

name: unluckily
trans: adv. 不幸地；遗憾地；倒霉地

example.en: Unluckily, we arrived at the station just after the last train left.
example.cn: 不幸的是，我们到达车站时，最后一班火车刚开走。

name: update
trans: v. 更新；向⋯⋯提供最新信息

example.en: We need to update the software to its latest version.
example.cn: 我们需要将软件更新到最新版本。

example.en: Have you received the update on the meeting schedule for next week?
example.cn: 你收到下周会议日程的更新了吗？

example.en: The smoke is rising upwards.
example.cn: 烟正向上飘。

example.en: We sat around the fire to enjoy the warmth.
example.cn: 我们围坐在火边享受温暖。

name: well-known
trans: 词组 be well-known for因⋯⋯而闻名
词组 be well-known as作为⋯⋯而闻名

example.en: He is a well-known scientist in the field of physics.
example.cn: 他是物理学领域一位众所周知的科学家。

name: wilderness
trans: 词组 in the wilderness在荒野中

example.en: They went deep into the wilderness to explore the unknown.
example.cn: 他们深入荒野去探索未知。

name: wildlife
trans: n. 野生动物；野生生物

example.en: We should protect the wildlife and their habitats.
example.cn: 我们应该保护野生动物及其栖息地。

example.en: I read a story about an alien visiting Earth.
example.cn: 我读了一个关于外星人访问地球的故事。

name: annoying
trans: 词组 an annoying noise令人烦躁的噪音

example.en: His annoying habit of tapping his foot makes me angry.
example.cn: 他跺脚的恼人习惯让我生气。

name: any more
trans: 点拨 例如: She doesn't work here any more. = She no longer works here. 她不再在这里工作了。
点拨 He isn't the leader of the team any more. = He is no longer the leader of theteam.他不再是团队领导了。

example.en: Can we trust his promises any more?
example.cn: 我们还能再信他的承诺吗？

example.en: You can call me any time you need help.
example.cn: 你需要帮助时可以随时给我打电话。

example.en: Please finish your homework ASAP.
example.cn: 请尽快完成你的作业。

name: awareness
trans: 词组 environmental awareness环保意识
点拨 awareness是不可数名词，常与raise搭配，表示“提高意识”。

example.en: We should raise our awareness of protecting the environment.
example.cn: 我们应该提高环保意识。

example.en: The singer waited backstage before the show.
example.cn: 演出前歌手在后台等待。

example.en: She got a backstage pass and met her favourite singer after the show.
example.cn: 她拿到了后台通行证，在演出结束后见到了她最喜爱的歌手。

example.en: The dog barks loudly when someone comes near.
example.cn: 有人靠近时，狗就大声吠叫。

name: bathe
trans: v. 用水清洗（尤指身体部位）
词组 bathe in沐浴在（阳光等中）

example.en: The nurse helped him bathe his wounded leg.
example.cn: 护士帮他清洗受伤的腿。

name: beyond
trans: 词组 beyond one's reach够不着
词组 beyond doubt毫无疑问地

example.en: He has no interests beyond reading.
example.cn: 除了读书，他没有其他爱好。

example.en: There are over eight billion people in the world.
example.cn: 世界上有八十多亿人。

example.en: The bomb may blow up at any moment.
example.cn: 炸弹随时可能爆炸。

name: bluetooth
trans: n. 蓝牙（用于手机、计算机等电子设备的短距离无线连接技术）

example.en: I use bluetooth to connect my phone to the speaker.
example.cn: 我用蓝牙把手机和扬声器连接起来。

name: connection
trans: 词组 have a connection with与⋯⋯有关联

example.en: There is a connection between the two machines.
example.cn: 这两台机器之间有连接。

name: continuous
trans: adj. 不断的；持续的；连续的

example.en: We had continuous rain for three days.
example.cn: 我们这连续下了三天雨。

example.en: Doctors are trying to find a cure for this disease.
example.cn: 医生们正努力寻找这种疾病的疗法。

example.en: It's impolite to cut in when others are talking.
example.cn: 别人说话时插嘴是不礼貌的。

example.en: Great changes have taken place in the past decade.
example.cn: 在过去的十年里发生了巨大的变化。

name: detect
trans: 词组 detect sb. doing sth.发现某人做某事

example.en: The machine can detect small changes in temperature.
example.cn: 这台机器能检测出温度的微小变化。

example.en: My mother bought a new dishwasher last week.
example.cn: 我妈妈上周买了一台新的洗碗机。

example.en: We heard some disturbing news last night.
example.cn: 昨晚我们听到了一些令人不安的消息。

name: DJ
trans: n. （电台、电视台、俱乐部）唱片节目主持人

example.en: The DJ played our favourite song at the party.
example.cn: 派对上，唱片节目主持人播放了我们最喜欢的歌。

name: dramatically
trans: adv. 突然地；巨大地；令人吃惊地

example.en: Her health improved dramatically after the treatment.
example.cn: 接受治疗后她的健康状况有了显著改善。

example.en: The children waited eagerly for the presents.
example.cn: 孩子们热切地等待着礼物。

example.en: We took the elevator to the top floor.
example.cn: 我们乘电梯到了顶楼。

example.en: We should use energy-saving lamps.
example.cn: 我们应该使用节能灯。

example.en: It's extremely cold today.
example.cn: 今天非常冷。

example.en: As students spend more time in front of screens, their eyesight becomes worse.
example.cn: 随着学生们看电子屏幕的时间增多，他们的视力变得越来越差。

example.en: I can't figure out this math problem.
example.cn: 我解不出这道数学题。

example.en: Quick response is very important in firefighting to prevent disasters.
example.cn: 在消防工作中，快速反应对防止灾难非常重要。

example.en: The balloon floated up into the sky.
example.cn: 气球飘向了天空。

example.en: Leaves float on the water.
example.cn: 树叶在水面上漂浮。

name: fully
trans: 词组 be fully aware of充分意识到

example.en: I fully understand your feelings.
example.cn: 我完全理解你的感受。

name: grown-up
trans: n. （尤指用于对儿童说话时）大人

example.en: The grown-ups are talking.
example.cn: 大人们在说话。

name: growth
trans: 词组 the growth of population 人口增长

example.en: Good food helps the growth of children.
example.cn: 良好的食物有助于儿童的成长。

example.en: The police found some handprints at the scene.
example.cn: 警方在现场发现了一些手印。

name: headset
trans: n. （尤指带麦克风的）头戴式受话器，耳机

example.en: He wears a headset to listen to music.
example.cn: 他戴着耳机听音乐。

name: heater
trans: n. 加热器； 炉子； 热水器

example.en: We use a heater to keep warm in winter.
example.cn: 冬天我们用加热器取暖。

example.en: When we visit some websites, hidden software may collect our personal information.
example.cn: 当我们访问一些网站时，隐藏软件可能会收集我们的个人信息。

example.en: He won the game three times in a row.
example.cn: 他连续三次赢得比赛。

name: in conclusion
trans: 点拨 in conclusion常用于议论文或演讲的结尾，总结观点。

example.en: In conclusion, we should work hard to achieve our goals.
example.cn: 最后，我们应该努力实现自己的目标。

name: in my opinion
trans: 近义 I think,I believe, as far as I'm concerned

example.en: In my opinion,English is very important.
example.cn: 依我看，英语非常重要。

example.en: He has an inborn talent for music.
example.cn: 他具有音乐天赋。

name: inconvenience
trans: n. 不便； 麻烦； 困难

example.en: I'm sorry for the inconvenience I caused.
example.cn: 我为造成的不便感到抱歉。

example.en: He gave me an indirect answer.
example.cn: 他给了我一个间接的回答。

name: inform
trans: 词组 inform sb. about/ of sth.通知某人某事

example.en: Please inform me of the result.
example.cn: 请告知我结果。

example.en: He works in the IT industry.
example.cn: 他在信息技术行业工作。

name: keep an eye on
trans: 近义 look after, take care of

example.en: Please keep an eye on my bag while I'm away.
example.cn: 我离开时请帮忙照看一下我的包。

example.en: This bottle holds two litres of water.
example.cn: 这个瓶子能装两升水。

example.en: Our living conditions have improved a lot.
example.cn: 我们的生活条件改善了很多。

name: magician
trans: n. 魔术师；变戏法的人

example.en: The magician performed some wonderful tricks.
example.cn: 魔术师表演了一些精彩的魔术。

example.en: The children played in the mud.
example.cn: 孩子们在泥里玩耍。

name: never-ending
trans: adj. 永无止境的；没完没了的

example.en: We have a never-ending supply of homework.
example.cn: 我们有做不完的作业。

example.en: We had an off-stage discussion.
example.cn: 我们进行了一次幕后讨论。

example.en: The actor waited off-stage.
example.cn: 演员在舞台外等候。

name: passion
trans: n. 酷爱；热衷的爱好（或活动等）
词组 have a passion for酷爱⋯⋯

example.en: She has a passion for dancing.
example.cn: 她酷爱跳舞。

example.en: We will have a presentation about this project tomorrow.
example.cn: 明天我们将有一个关于这次项目的展示会。

example.en: He received a punishment for his mistake.
example.cn: 他因犯错受到了惩罚。

example.en: Pandas are rare animals.
example.cn: 熊猫是珍稀动物。

name: rate
trans: 词组 rate sth. as把某物评为⋯⋯

example.en: Teachers rate students'work.
example.cn: 老师给学生的作品打分。

example.en: The researcher is working on a new project.
example.cn: 这位研究者正在从事一个新项目。

example.en: His carelessness resulted in the accident.
example.cn: 他的粗心导致了这场事故。

example.en: She bought a roll of paper.
example.cn: 她买了一卷纸。

example.en: The rain ruined our picnic.
example.cn: 这场雨破坏了我们的野餐。

name: rural
trans: 词组 rural life 乡村生活

example.en: He lives in a rural area.
example.cn: 他住在农村地区。

name: security
trans: n. 安全工作；保安部门

example.en: The security guard checked our bags.
example.cn: 保安检查了我们的包。

example.en: He is a self-important man.
example.cn: 他是个自负的人。

example.en: We will set off early tomorrow morning.
example.cn: 我们明天早上会早点出发。

name: severe
trans: adj. 极为恶劣的；十分严重的

example.en: He has a severe headache.
example.cn: 他头痛得很厉害。

example.en: Many people use smartphones to surf the internet.
example.cn: 很多人用智能手机上网。

name: smelly
trans: adj. 有难闻气味的；有臭味的

example.en: The smelly rubbish needs to be taken away.
example.cn: 这些发臭的垃圾需要被运走。

example.en: We need to install new software on the computer.
example.cn: 我们需要在电脑上安装新软件。

example.en: This train has a super-speed engine.
example.cn: 这列火车有一个超高速引擎。

example.en: It's surprising that he won the game.
example.cn: 他赢得比赛真令人吃惊。

name: talented
trans: adj. 有才能的；天才的；有才干的

example.en: She is a talented singer.
example.cn: 她是一位有天赋的歌手。

example.en: This computer has a touch screen.
example.cn: 这台电脑有触摸屏。

name: touching
trans: adj. 令人同情的；感人的

example.en: It's a touching story.
example.cn: 这是一个感人的故事。

name: treatment
trans: 词组 medical treatment 医疗

example.en: The treatment of wastewater is important.
example.cn: 废水处理很重要。

name: unbelievable
trans: adj. 难以置信的；惊人的

example.en: It's unbelievable that he ran so fast.
example.cn: 难以置信他竟跑得那么快。

name: unfamiliar
trans: 词组 be unfamiliar with 对…不熟悉

example.en: This is an unfamiliar word for me.
example.cn: 这个单词对我来说很陌生。

name: unlikely
trans: 词组 be unlikely to do sth.不大可能做某事

example.en: It's unlikely to rain tomorrow.
example.cn: 明天不大可能下雨。

name: unpleasant
trans: adj. 令人不快的；不舒服的

example.en: We had an unpleasant trip because of the bad weather.
example.cn: 因为天气不好，我们的旅行很不愉快。

example.en: The hotel has a special room for VIPs.
example.cn: 这家酒店有专门的贵宾室。

example.en: He enjoys playing VR games.
example.cn: 他喜欢玩虚拟现实游戏。

example.en: Factories shouldn't pour wastewater into rivers.
example.cn: 工厂不应该把废水排入河流。

example.en: He comes from a wealthy family.
example.cn: 他来自一个富裕的家庭。

example.en: The park is like a wonderland with many beautiful flowers.
example.cn: 这个公园就像一个开满美丽鲜花的仙境。

name: a great deal of
trans: 点拨 a great deal of仅修饰不可数名词。
点拨 a number of仅修饰可数名词复数，后接谓语用复数。
点拨 many仅修饰可数名词复数。
点拨 much仅修饰不可数名词。

example.en: She spent a great deal of time reading books.
example.cn: 她花了大量时间看书。

example.en: There is a great deal of water in the bottle.
example.cn: 瓶子里有大量的水。

example.en: A number of birds fly south in winter.
example.cn: 许多鸟类在冬天飞往南方。

example.en: Many students like playing basketball.
example.cn: 许多学生喜欢打篮球。

example.en: I don't have much time to rest.
example.cn: 我没有太多时间休息。

example.en: Reading accounts for a large part of our daily English study.
example.cn: 阅读在我们日常的英语学习中占很大一部分。

name: acting
trans: 词组 acting skills表演技巧

example.en: Her acting in the play won lots of praise.
example.cn: 她在剧中的表演赢得了许多好评。

name: advertising
trans: n. 广告活动；广告业；广告

example.en: The company will put more money into advertising.
example.cn: 这家公司会在广告宣传上投入更多资金。

example.en: He talks as if he knew everything about the plan.
example.cn: 他说话的样子好像对这个计划了如指掌。

example.en: She looks as if she were a princess.
example.cn: 她看起来仿佛是一位公主。

name: bad-tempered
trans: adj. 易怒的；爱发脾气的

example.en: My father is a little bad-tempered when he is tired.
example.cn: 我爸在累的时候会有点易怒。

example.en: He likes to wear baggy jeans in his daily life.
example.cn: 他日常生活中喜欢穿宽松的牛仔裤。

example.en: This ancient building was built in 300 BCE.
example.cn: 这座古老的建筑建于公元前300年。

name: be mean to sb.
trans: 点拨 mean此处为形容词，表“刻薄的”，区别于动词含义“意思是；打算”。

example.en: It's not polite to be mean to your classmates.
example.cn: 对同学刻薄是不礼貌的。

example.en: I met my primary school teacher by accident on the street.
example.cn: 我在街上偶然遇到了我的小学老师。

name: caring
trans: adj. 关心他人的； 体贴的

example.en: She is a caring nurse and all patients like her.
example.cn: 她是一位体贴的护士，所有病人都喜欢她。

example.en: This important event happened in 200CE.
example.cn: 这个重要事件发生在公元200年。

name: cheerful
trans: adj. 开朗的； 乐观的

example.en: She is always cheerful and brings joy to everyone around her.
example.cn: 她总是很开朗，给身边的人带来快乐。

name: cheerleader
trans: n. 拉拉队队员； 支持者

example.en: My sister wants to be a cheerleader for the school basketball team.
example.cn: 我妹妹想当校篮球队的拉拉队队员。

name: come across
trans: 点拨 come across无被动形式，后直接接人或物。

example.en: I came across an old photo album while I was cleaning the closet.
example.cn: 我打扫壁橱时偶然发现了一本旧相册。

example.en: He came across an acquaintance on his way home.
Drawing pictures can develop children's creativity.
example.cn: 画画能培养孩子的创造力。

example.en: We put some decorations on the Christmas tree.
example.cn: 我们在圣诞树上挂了一些装饰品。

name: discovery
trans: 词组 make a discovery发现，找到

example.en: The discovery of penicillin changed the world of medicine.
example.cn: 青霉素的发现改变了医学界。

name: doubtful
trans: adj. 怀疑的； 不确定的
点拨 doubtful后常接介词about,构成be doubtful about sth..

example.en: I'm doubtful about whether he can finish the work on time.
example.cn: 我怀疑他能否按时完成这项工作。

example.en: She is doubtful about the truth of the news.
example.cn: 她对这个消息的真实性表示怀疑。

example.en: The Tang dynasty is one of the most prosperous dynasties in China.
example.cn: 唐朝是中国最繁荣的朝代之一。

example.en: He plans to study economics when he goes to university.
example.cn: 他上大学后打算学习经济学。

name: economist
trans: n. 经济学家； 经济专家

example.en: Many economists gave their opinions on the country's economic development.
example.cn: 许多经济学家对国家的经济发展发表了看法。

name: even if
trans: 点拨 even if可与even though互换，引导让步状语从句。

example.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will still go for the picnic.
example.cn: 即使明天下雨，我们还是会去野餐。

example.en: Even if/ though he is busy,he will help us.
example.cn: 即使他很忙，他也会帮我们的。

name: expectation
trans: 词组 meet one's expectations达到某人的期望

example.en: His parents have high expectations for his study.
example.cn: 他的父母对他的学习抱有很高的期望。

name: exploration
trans: 词组 space exploration太空探索

example.en: The exploration of the deep sea is very challenging.
example.cn: 对深海的探索极具挑战性。

name: fashionable
trans: adj. 流行的； 时髦的
反义 unfashionable; out of date

example.en: Wearing silk scarves is fashionable in this winter.
example.cn: 今年冬天很流行戴丝巾。

name: firm
trans: adj. 坚定的； 坚决的

example.en: She has a firm belief that she will succeed in the exam.
example.cn: 她坚信自己能通过这次考试。

name: fishnet
trans: 词组 a piece of fishnet一张渔网

example.en: The fishermen mended the broken fishnet before going to sea.
example.cn: 渔民们出海前修补了破损的渔网。

name: flowery
trans: 词组 flowery pattern花卉图案

example.en: She received a flowery dress as her birthday gift.
example.cn: 她收到了一件带花卉装饰的连衣裙作为生日礼物。

example.en: She wants to get away from the noisy city for a few days.
example.cn: 她想离开喧闹的城市几天。

name: go off
trans: 点拨 go off为多义短语，还可表示“闹钟响；爆炸；变质”。

example.en: The lights went off suddenly because of the heavy rain.
example.cn: 因为大雨， 灯突然断电了。

example.en: My alarm clock goes off at six every morning.
example.cn: 我的闹钟每天早上6点响。

example.en: We heard a big noise when the balloon went off.
Check the date on the juice carton to make sure it hasn't gone off.

name: goods
trans: 词组 imported goods进口商品

example.en: The shop sells all kinds of daily goods.
example.cn: 这家商店出售各类日用品。

name: hang out
trans: 点拨 han g out是口语化的短语，后接地点时需加介词in/at.

example.en: Teenagers like to hang out with their friends in the mall.
example.cn: 青少年喜欢和朋友在商场闲逛。

example.en: We often hang out at the coffee shop near the school.

name: harmony
trans: 词组 in harmony with与……和谐相处

example.en: We should live in harmony with all living things on the earth.
example.cn: 我们应该和地球上的所有生物和谐共处。

name: image
trans: n. 形象； 印象； 图像
词组 public image公众形象
词组 image processing图像处理

example.en: This advertisement helps to build a good image of the brand.
example.cn: 这则广告有助于树立该品牌的良好形象。

name: in case
trans: 点拨 in case后接从句;in case of后接名词。

example.en: Take an umbrella with you in case it rains this afternoon.
example.cn: 带把伞吧，以防今天下午下雨。

example.en: We should keep some food in case of an emergency.

name: in short
trans: 近义 in a word; to sum up

example.en: In short, we need to take action to protect the environment right now.
example.cn: 总之，我们现在就应该采取行动保护环境。

example.en: She is a popular social media influencer with millions of fans.
example.cn: 她是一位拥有数百万粉丝的网红博主。

example.en: The man injured his brain and couldn't remember anything for a long time.
example.cn: 这名男子脑部受伤，很长一段时间里什么都记不起来了。

name: injured
trans: 词组 the injured伤员（复数概念）

example.en: The nurse in the rescue team treated the injured boy with great patience and care.
example.cn: 救援队的护士以极大的耐心与关怀照料着受伤的男孩。

example.en: He suffered a serious injury in the sports meeting.
example.cn: 他在运动会中受了重伤。

name: jewellery
trans: 词组 wear jewellery佩戴首饰

example.en: Her mother gave her a piece of jewellery on her birthday.
example.cn: 她妈妈在她生日时送了她一件珠宝。

name: life-saving
trans: 词组 life-saving equipment救生设备
词组 life-saving operation救命手术

example.en: Learning to swim is a life-saving skill.
example.cn: 学会游泳是一项救生技能。

name: light up
trans: 点拨 light up还可表示“（脸）露出喜色”。

example.en: Colorful lights lit up the whole street at night.
example.cn: 五颜六色的灯在晚上点亮了整条街道。

example.en: Her face lit up when she saw the birthday cake.
The low-lying areas are easy to be flooded when it rains heavily.
example.cn: 暴雨时低洼地区容易被淹。

name: magical
trans: adj. 魔法的； 神奇的

example.en: The little girl had a magical experience in the fairy tale park.
example.cn: 小女孩在童话公园有了一次神奇的经历。

name: mess up
trans: 出错；搞砸； （在某事上）处理不当

example.en: He messed up the important meeting because of his carelessness.
example.cn: 他因为粗心搞砸了这次重要的会议。

name: outfit
trans: n. 全套服装； 装束

example.en: She bought a new sports outfit for the PE class this term.
example.cn: 她为这学期的体育课买了一套新的运动服。

name: over the moon
trans: 近义 on cloud nine; extremely happy

example.en: She was over the moon when she heard she passed the exam.
example.cn: 听到自己通过了考试，她欣喜若狂。

name: payment
trans: n. 支付； 付款； 收款
词组 online payment在线支付
词组 payment method支付方式

example.en: You can make the payment online or in cash in this shop.
example.cn: 你可以在这家店在线支付或者用现金付款。

name: peaceful
trans: adj. 安静的； 宁静的

example.en: We spent a peaceful weekend in the small village in the mountains.
example.cn: 我们在山里的小村庄度过了一个宁静的周末。

name: percentage
trans: n. 百分率； 百分比
点拨 percentage后接“of+名词”，谓语动词的单复数由主语中的名词决定。

example.en: What percentage of the students in your class walk to school?
example.cn: 你们班有百分之多少的学生步行上学？

example.en: A large percentage of the water is polluted.
example.cn: 很大一部分的水被污染了。

example.en: We use a pie chart to show the percentage of different fruits we bought.
example.cn: 我们用饼形图展示所购买的不同水果的占比。

example.en: I save my pocket money to buy a new storybook every month.
example.cn: 我每个月都存零花钱买一本新的故事书。

name: pottery
trans: n. 陶器； 制陶技艺

example.en: She learned pottery from a famous artist last year.
example.cn: 她去年向一位著名的艺术家学习了制陶技艺。

name: rapidly
trans: adv. 迅速地； 快速地； 快捷地

example.en: The city is developing rapidly in recent years.
example.cn: 这座城市近年来发展得很迅速。

name: rather than
trans: 点拨 rather than连接两个并列成分，后接动词常用原形。

example.en: He chose to stay at home rather than go out with his friends.
example.cn: 他选择待在家里，而不是和朋友出去。

example.en: I prefer to read books rather than watch TV after dinner.
My home is on Park Rd. near the central supermarket.
example.cn: 我家在公园路上，靠近中心超市。

name: relaxed
trans: adj. 放松的； 自在的

example.en: She felt relaxed after listening to the soft music for a while.
example.cn: 听了一会儿轻音乐后，她感觉很放松。

name: rescue
trans: 词组 come to one' s rescue前来营救某人

example.en: The rescue of the lost hiker took three days in the mountain.
example.cn: 在山里营救迷路的徒步旅行者花了3天时间。

example.en: The firefighters rushed to rescue the people in the burning building.
example.cn: 消防员赶赴现场营救着火大楼里的人。

name: sample
trans: n. 样品； 试用产品

example.en: The company gave away free samples of the new drink to customers.
example.cn: 这家公司向顾客赠送了新饮料的免费样品。

name: scared
trans: adj. 害怕的； 恐惧的； 担心的
点拨 scared后常接介词of,构成be scared of(doing) sth..

example.en: The little boy is scared of the dark when he is alone at home.
example.cn: 小男孩独自在家时怕黑。

example.en: She is scared of speaking in front of many people.
example.cn: 她害怕在很多人面前讲话。

name: sculptor
trans: n. 雕塑家； 雕刻家

example.en: The famous sculptor made a statue of a little girl in the park.
example.cn: 这位著名的雕塑家在公园里雕刻了一座小女孩的雕像。

name: sculpture
trans: n. 雕塑； 雕塑作品

example.en: There is a beautiful stone sculpture in the centre of the square.
example.cn: 广场中央有一座精美的石雕。

example.en: Painting is a good way of self-expression for many artists.
example.cn: 绘画对很多艺术家来说是一种很好的自我表达方式。

name: stare
trans: v. 盯着看； 凝视； 注视

example.en: He stared out of the window.
example.cn: 他凝视着窗外。

example.en: It's impolite to stare at strangers in the street.
example.cn: 在街上盯着陌生人看是不礼貌的。

name: terribly
trans: adv. 非常糟地； 严重地

example.en: He felt terribly sorry for his mistake in the project.
example.cn: 他为自己在项目中犯的错误感到非常抱歉。

example.en: To my surprise, he passed the difficult exam with full marks.
example.cn: 令我惊讶的是，他以满分通过了这次很难的考试。

name: totally
trans: adv. 全部地； 整个地

example.en: I totally agree with your opinion about this important matter.
example.cn: 我完全同意你对这件重要事情的看法。

example.en: He wears a pair of white trainers to school every day.
example.cn: 他每天穿一双白色运动鞋上学。

name: tube
trans: n. （金属、塑料、橡皮制成的）管， 管子
词组 a tube of toothpaste一管牙膏

example.en: The water flows through a plastic tube to the garden in the backyard.
example.cn: 水通过一根塑料管流到后院的花园里。

example.en: A strong typhoon will hit the coastal city next week.
example.cn: 一场强台风将在下周袭击这座沿海城市。

name: urge
trans: 词组 urge sb. to do sth.敦促某人做某事
词组 urge sb. into doing sth.力劝某人做某事

example.en: The teacher urged us to finish our homework on time every day.
example.cn: 老师敦促我们每天按时完成作业。

name: valuable
trans: adj. 很有用的；很重要的；宝贵的

example.en: We gained a lot of valuable experience from this interesting competition.
example.cn: 我们从这个有趣的比赛中获得了很多宝贵的经验。

name: vivid
trans: adj. 生动的； 逼真的

example.en: The writer described the beautiful scene with vivid language in the novel.
example.cn: 作者在小说中用生动的语言描绘了这处美景。

name: whoever
trans: pron. 无论谁；不管什么人
点拨 whoever可引导让步状语从句(= no matter who),也可引导名词性从句。
点拨 例如: Whoever you ask, no one will reveal the secret.

example.en: Whoever comes to the party will get a small and lovely gift.
example.cn: 无论谁来参加派对，都会得到一份小巧可爱的礼物。

example.en: Whoever breaks the rule will be punished.
example.cn: 无论谁违反规则都会受到惩罚。
